raw.excerpt: Treewalk is an innovative and entrepreneurial mid-size accounting firm headquartered out of Vancouver with an expanding presence across the country.
raw.description:
Treewalk is an innovative and entrepreneurial mid-size accounting firm headquartered out of Vancouver with an expanding presence across the country. We are a CPABC pre-approved training office that supports CPA students through their journey to designation. If you want to work with a great team of accounting professionals, you’ve found the right place.

We are looking for recent, or soon to be, graduates passionate about accounting that are looking to start in 2027 or 2028. Our ideal candidate is a self-motivated individual that is excited about challenging work, is obsessively organized, and has a commitment to continuous improvement. You have a knack for problem solving and are always seeking to learn more about accounting and bookkeeping. If you take immense satisfaction from getting a difficult reconciliation to balance or solving what feels unsolvable you would be a good fit for our team.

Who We Are

Treewalk is an advisory practice based out of downtown Vancouver specializing in financial reporting and corporate services for public companies. We offer clients a complete service package to assist them with timely and accurate disclosures. Our clients are from all industry sectors and are issuers on the TSX-V, CSE, NASDAQ, and the OTC.

We are one of the fastest growing accounting firms in Canada, and we’ve got some big goals that are going to send us to the top. We are a firm with an anti-firm culture - think tech startup, but accounting. We’re ditching the traditional top-down management hierarchy approach and are leaning into a Holacratic system of organizational governance. We are on a journey to become the go-to training place for accountants of all levels who want to work in industry. Our accounting practice specializes in assisting public companies with their financial reporting and accounting needs, and we help private companies navigate the waters of going and staying public. When it comes to clients, we are industry-agnostic. We never shy away from clients in new and emergent industries, and we’ve worked with companies in e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, cannabis, mining, and biotechnology, to name a few. We’ve got a lot on the go, and as far as we’re concerned, the only barrier to reaching our goals is finding exceptional talent to keep building out our team.

Our Core Values

Mastery: At Treewalk, we pursue knowledge. We aspire to be the best at our craft, and we create and pursue opportunities to build on our expertise.
Support: At Treewalk, you're never alone. Teamwork and collaboration are our bedrock, and constant support for each other and our clients is what sets us apart.
Ownership: At Treewalk, we fight to take responsibility. We own our mistakes and our oversights and are relentlessly committed to our responsibility to our colleagues and our clients.
Kaizen: At Treewalk, we don't settle. Kaizen is a business philosophy that means "change for the better", or "continuous improvement". We recognize that nothing is perfect, but we're striving for it anyway.

What will your days look like

 

  • Bookkeeping for multiple public and private clients that work in a variety of exciting industries - Have a particular industry of interest? We will do everything we can to get you the experience you want. Industries we work with include e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, cannabis, blockchain, mining and biotechnology
  • Regular maintenance of various audit working papers - though we don’t provide audit services, you will have ample opportunity to directly liaise with our clients’ external auditors and understand what that process entails.
  • Working with different functional currencies and foreign exchange transactions
  • Maintaining organized e-records of all invoices/statements
  • Managing commodity tax filings for clients (i.e., GST and PST)
  • Other requested administrative tasks as required.

Requirements

Our ideal candidate...

  • Has or is in progress of a Bachelors degree
  • Has or is in progress of a program that meets all of the prerequisites for the CPA Professional Education Program
  • Can navigate the tribulations of formatting documents in Word
  • Is comfortable working in Excel
  • Works well under the pressure of deadlines
  • Is interested in taking on challenging work to grow their skills within a supportive learning environment
  • Embraces new technology
  • Is extremely detail-oriented and meticulous, even to the point where some might find it annoying
  • Is planning on pursuing CPA designation.

Bonuses would be…

  •  Previous accounting or bookkeeping experience
  • Customer service or client service experience
  • Exposure to accounting software like QuickBooks and Sage 50 – even just through a course

Application Requirements

  • Resume
  • Transcript, official or unofficial, submit attached to resume
  • Indicate in your resume your desired start date to the end of your resume name (example Last.First – February2027.pdf)

Even if your graduation date isn’t for a little while we are still interested in talking with you!

Benefits

It’s Treewalk for a Reason

 

  • We will cover your CPA schooling, annual dues, and professional development courses. Better yet, we do not have a claw-back policy - if you decide to leave Treewalk at any point, we will never ask for that money back.
  • We’re flexible – we treat our team members like professionals and give them autonomy to exercise their judgment and manage their schedules as they see fit. Get that workout in, run those errands – we trust you to manage your workload and meet those deadlines.
  • We keep it fun! We encourage social activities outside of work, have company initiatives to keep you engaged with your peers, and have great technological tools to keep you connected.
  • We’ve got you covered from Day 1 - your extended healthcare and maternity leave benefits kick in on your first day of work!

Annual Salary - $65,000

raw.description:
**This is a direct hire for one of our clients. This role is fully remote. Eligible candidates must be authorized to work in the US without visa sponsorship.**

Our client is putting AI at the center of its product strategy and is seeking an experienced AI Architect to lead the architecture, roadmap, and delivery of customer-facing AI capabilities across its SaaS platform portfolio. This is a hands-on leadership role that combines AI strategy, software architecture, and team leadership. The ideal candidate has designed and delivered production AI solutions, led technical direction for AI initiatives, and remains actively involved in architecture, prototyping, and software development. You will guide a growing AI team while driving next-generation capabilities including agentic systems, personalization, MCP initiatives, and AI-powered product innovation.

Responsibilities

AI Architecture & Development

  • Define the architecture and technical direction for AI capabilities across the product portfolio.

  • Design and build scalable AI solutions, including agentic workflows, personalization, RAG, knowledge representation, and AI-driven customer experiences.

  • Establish reusable patterns and standards for prompts, memory, context management, evaluation, and AI orchestration.

  • Develop prototypes and reference implementations, remaining actively involved in software development.

  • Integrate AI capabilities across .NET, Node.js, Go, and Java platforms.

  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and infrastructure, including build-versus-buy decisions.

Collaboration & Innovation

  • Partner with Platform Engineering and product teams to move AI capabilities from concept through production.

  • Provide architectural guidance, design reviews, and hands-on support to engineering teams adopting AI.

  • Explore new AI use cases and emerging capabilities, including agent harnesses, personalized content generation, and MCP.

  • Identify practical AI opportunities that create measurable customer and business value.

  • Contribute to technical due diligence and AI capability assessments for potential acquisitions.

AI Governance & Security

  • Establish best practices for model selection, hosting, tenant isolation, data privacy, and responsible AI development.

  • Partner with Legal, Information Security, IT, and Platform Engineering to ensure AI solutions meet enterprise security, compliance, and regulatory requirements.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with significant architecture and technical leadership responsibilities.

  • Proven experience designing, deploying, and scaling production AI, machine learning, RAG, or agentic systems.

  • Deep understanding of modern AI architecture, including LLM applications, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), memory, context management, evaluation frameworks, knowledge graphs, ontologies, and other AI/ML techniques.

  • Experience with agentic AI, agent orchestration, agent harnesses, and MCP initiatives.

  • Experience working with graph databases, vector databases, knowledge representation frameworks, and semantic data models supporting AI applications.

  • Strong hands-on software engineering background with the ability to remain actively involved in development.

  • Experience leading technical strategy, architecture decisions, and AI roadmaps.

  • Ability to work across multiple technology stacks and integrate AI capabilities into existing platforms.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills with technical and executive stakeholders.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced, evolving SaaS environments.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Experience designing AI systems leveraging knowledge graphs, ontologies, semantic search, graph databases, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures.

  • Experience with Python, Node.js, or TypeScript.

  • AWS and AWS Bedrock experience.

  • Experience with evaluation platforms such as Braintrust, LangSmith, LangFuse, or similar tools.

  • Background as a Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, Architect, consultant, startup leader, or innovation lab contributor.

  • Experience conducting technical due diligence or evaluating acquisition targets.

  • Financial services, wealth management, insurance, or other regulated industry experience.

  • Experience supporting AI initiatives within high-growth or private-equity-backed SaaS organizations.

Our Vetting Process

At Emergent Staffing, we work hard to find the best tech candidates capable of developing high quality results for our clients. Here are the steps of our vetting process for this position:

  • Application (5 minutes)

  • Online Assessment (40-60 minutes)

  • Initial Phone Interview (30-45 minutes)

  • Virtual Interview with Hiring Manager (30-45 minutes)

  • Final Client Interview (60-90 minutes)

  • Job Offer!

#EmergentStaffing

#IND99

Highlights

Lead AI strategy, architecture, and delivery across a growing SaaS platform, building agentic, RAG-driven solutions and shaping next-generation AI products.

Description

The US Retail Markets (USRM) Personal Lines (PL) Auto State indications team is looking for a Senior Actuarial Analyst / Actuary to join our team. In this highly impactful role, you will play a pivotal role in producing quarterly rate indications to support rate decisions. This is a unique opportunity to help drive enhancements and sophistication to our processes and methodology. This position will work in a collaborative environment with partners and stakeholders in Risk Analytics and State Management.

**This is a ranged posting for a Senior Actuarial Analyst or an Actuary. Level offered is based on candidate experience at manager discretion.**

This role may have in-office requirements depending on candidate location.

As an Actuary, you will:

  • Lead work on state indications that serve as a foundation for rate guidance, ensuring that our rate actions and underwriting levers improve each state’s profit position.
  • Play a pivotal role in shaping state indication strategy, leveraging a robust suite of actuarial methods.
  • Help identify and propose enhancements to our existing processes and methodologies to drive for operational excellence.
  • Be an influential partner with other Risk Analytics subject matter experts to ensure a comprehensive understanding of unique state features, and collaborate with Directors of State Operations to develop customized state levers.
  • Share your insights and recommendations which will greatly influence state-level decision-making and contribute to our goal of achieving top-quartile profitability.
  • Build trust, credibility, and strong relationships will enable you to influence decisions and execution beyond the Auto Analytics team.
  • Be a senior member of the team and also contribute to fostering an inclusive, equitable, and high-performing culture.
  • Coach and mentor junior team members, sharing your expertise and supporting their development.

In this role, you can expect to:

  • Deliver state level indications to internal stakeholders to drive actions and influence decisions to achieve top quartile profitability.
  • Build indications tools and processes to increase our organizational understanding of our methodology and inform state level profitability position.
  • Proactively identify opportunities, drive analysis, and make recommendations for appropriate strategies to develop, evaluate and enhance state level profitability.
  • Act as a trusted partner to State Management to help inform and influence state-specific strategy and tactics, including pricing and underwriting levers.
  • Collaborate with Country Wide (CW) Indications, CW State Analytics, Actuarial, Finance, Claims and Data Science to gain better understanding and assess and improve profitability with a state focus.
  • Support cross-team initiatives to enrich the deliverables with state-specific insights.
  • Building trust and credibility with teams beyond State Analytics to drive decisions and execution.
  • Support an inclusive, equitable and high performing culture.
  • Coach and mentor junior team members.

Ideal candidate will have:

  • Strong technical proficiency in Excel (e.g., pivot tables, advanced formulas, data modeling) and SQL, with demonstrated experience querying and manipulating large datasets.
  • Ability to design and build scalable, repeatable processes for data extraction, transformation, and reporting.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to translate technical or analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to gather and interpret stakeholder requirements, ask clarifying questions, and respond to follow-up questions with confidence and clarity.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally and managing multiple stakeholder relationships simultaneously.
  • Detail-oriented mindset with strong organizational and prioritization skills.

Qualifications

This is a ranged posting. Qualifications are as follows for each level of consideration:

Senior Actuarial Analyst

  • Proven math and analytical skills, as normally acquired through the pursuit of a Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Actuarial Science, or related field.
  • Commitment to achieving Associateship or Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society.
  • Passing grades on a minimum of 5 Casualty Actuarial Exams is required.
  • Minimum 3-5 years relevant experience required.
  • Prior experience and solid knowledge of actuarial techniques and standards, as well as other business operations including financial, underwriting, legal, statistics, claims, sales, etc.
  • Solid oral and written and presentation communication skills and ability to interact effectively within and outside the organization.
  • Solid interpersonal skills and the ability to work in a team environment as well as independently.
  • Ability to motivate and mentor peers and motivate and train subordinates.
  • Ability to exercise discretion, and apply independent judgment and well-developed critical thinking skills in execution of assignments and projects.
  • Ability to balance multiple projects with minimal direction.
  • Advanced computing skills (MS Office Excel, SAS, etc.); Ability to build models of moderate complexity.

Actuary

  • Bachelor's degree required; Master’s degree preferred.
  • Associateship or Fellowship in the Casualty Actuarial Society (ACAS/FCAS) designation preferred or comparable education/designation with relevant experience.
  • Minimum 5-7 years relevant experience required.
  • Sound knowledge of actuarial techniques and standards, as well as other business operations including financial, underwriting, legal, statistics, claims, sales, etc.
  • Advanced communication and interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships and interact effectively with others within and outside the organization.
  • Ability to motivate and mentor peers and motivate and train subordinates.
  • Advanced computing skills (MS Office Excel, SAS, etc.) with ability to build complex models.

About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.At Liberty Mutual, our goal is to create a workplace where everyone feels valued, supported, and can thrive. We build an environment that welcomes a wide range of perspectives and experiences, with inclusion embedded in every aspect of our culture and reflected in everyday interactions. This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve. We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.Fair Chance Notices

Lavendo partners with startups and high‑growth companies to help them hire top‑tier sales, GTM, and technical talent. This role is with one of our clients; we’ll share full details about the company and interview process as we get to know you and confirm mutual fit.

About the Company

Our client is a seed-stage event commerce company with $16M in funding and backing from Andreessen Horowitz (a16z). The platform combines tickets, merchandise, drinks, tables, and sponsorship placements with affiliate tracking and automatic commission payouts. Organizers can manage more of their event business in one place and reward the people driving sales.

The Mission

Help organizers earn more from every event and make it easier for the people behind local events and nightlife to grow their businesses.

The Opportunity

As a Business Development Manager, you’ll help grow the local events and nightlife business by turning your relationships with promoters, venue owners, and organizers into new accounts. You’ll introduce a platform that gives them more ways to monetize their events, negotiate commercial terms, and own the customer relationship from first conversation through launch.

Reporting to the Head of Business Development, you’ll work directly with leadership and help shape the sales approach as the business grows. You’ll have autonomy over your pipeline and the opportunity to build on the company’s visibility across music and entertainment, including Lil Wayne featuring the platform in his Instagram bio and a signed WWE contract.

What You'll Do

  • Bring on new organizers and venues through your existing relationships.

  • Run product demos, build a compelling business case, and close deals.

  • Negotiate commercial terms, including fee splits, guarantees, and exclusivity.

  • Support onboarding and help new accounts get their first events running.

  • Grow your pipeline through referrals, targeted outbound, and direct outreach.

  • Build account plans grounded in realistic ticketing volume, current provider relationships, and contractual commitments.

  • Stay close to customers after signing and help resolve issues that affect adoption or the relationship.

What You Bring

  • 2–6 years in business development, partnerships, sales, or commercially focused account management or customer success within ticketing, events, or nightlife.

  • An active network of local venue owners, promoters, or organizers, including 10–20 people you could personally call when you start.

  • Direct access to business decision-makers and a clear understanding of how you could help their businesses.

  • Examples of business you personally sourced, negotiated, and closed.

  • Confidence leading demos, discussing commercial terms, and asking for the deal.

  • Working knowledge of ticketing economics, including fee splits, guarantees, advances, exclusivity, rebates, and bar minimums or splits.

  • Experience building pipeline beyond your initial network through outbound prospecting and referrals.

  • Availability to work full-time from the United States.

Why Join?

  • Compensation: 100K-200K OTE plus equity, with flexible packages that can include salary plus equity or a lower base with higher commission.

  • Funding and backers: Join a seed-stage company with $16M in funding and backing from a16z.

  • Experienced founders: Work with a team whose background includes building Lime and early roles at Google and Pinterest.

  • Commercial autonomy: Own sourcing, negotiation, closing, and post-sale support, with direct leadership access and minimal approval layers.

  • Remote flexibility: Work from anywhere in the United States. Client-event travel is encouraged, not required.

  • Team connection: Attend an optional monthly on-site “power week,” with room and board covered.

  • Visa support: Visa transfers and sponsorship considered.

Interviewing Process

  • Recruiter Screen

  • Intro call with the Hiring Manager

  • Conversation with a BD team member

  • Take-home assignment

  • Final presentation

  • Offer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation Range: $100K - $200K

About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for a Chief of Staff to help drive Doit's AI Neobank expansion across products, markets and teams. This is a senior execution role for someone who can align leadership, drive operating cadence, solve cross-functional problems and turn strategy into measurable progress.

raw.description:
As a Senior Accountant at Splitero, you will work across all business lines to help Splitero scale effectively, and you will partner with the Vice President of Finance and Accounting to inform strategic business planning. Day-to-day, you own traditional accounting functions while shaping the role into your own by collaborating on transformative projects. The robust financial reporting you create will drive data-driven decisions. You will identify and adopt AI-enabled tools and automation to streamline reporting workflows while ensuring that outputs meet our accuracy and internal control standards, thereby making a significant impact on achieving our long-term goals.

About the Job

  • Drive data and financially grounded decision-making and accountability company-wide
  • Leverage our existing financial infrastructure to help leadership make data-driven decisions
  • Assist with monthly, quarterly, and annual external and internal financial close and reporting processes
  • Act as liaison with external financial statement audit firm to prepare and assist in audit execution
  • Develop our global accounting policies, practices, procedures, and initiatives.
  • Ensure proper control, recording, and classification of all revenues and expenses
  • Own vendor management and have a direct impact on organizational efficiency
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams on periodic ad-hoc analytics projects

The salary range for this position is $110,000 - $125,000. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

About You

  • 3+ years of experience in either public accounting or high-growth tech preferred
  • Effective communication and presentation skills - the ability to share complex findings in a clear manner with a non-technical audience
  • Demonstrated experience preparing and delivering timely and accurate reporting - the ability over time to build compelling insights from facts and numbers
  • Familiarity (or quick study) with SalesForce, Quickbooks, and financial planning software a plus
  • Curiosity about AI and a willingness to learn and apply it in your work, paired with the judgment to verify results and protect sensitive financial data
  • Desire to participate in fast-paced early-stage startup
  • Adaptability: Embraces changing circumstances with resiliency and positivity
  • Team-Oriented: Prioritizes collaboration, inclusivity, and teammate support

About Us

Millions of homeowners in today’s economy are sitting on substantial home equity they are unable to access due to rising interest rates and strict qualification requirements of traditional lenders. That means millions of homeowners can’t convert their hard-earned equity into cash to pay off debt, start a home renovation, or pad their retirement to better their lives.

Splitero co-founders Michael Gifford and David Zvaifler witnessed the problem firsthand throughout their real estate careers. They set out to create a win-win product that could help those homeowners access their home equity but not make monthly payments like traditional financing options. And thus, Splitero was born.

As part of our team, you will join our quest to revolutionize the real estate industry while helping families in need. We offer a suite of benefits designed to help you thrive in all areas of life.

  • OneTeam Culture - We foster a culture of transparency, innovation, and inclusivity, where every voice is heard and every team member is valued. We believe in celebrating our successes, doing the right thing, and helping each other so we grow as a team and as individuals.
  • Generous Resources - We want to ensure you are set up to do your best work. In addition to a solid tech stack, and access to any WeWork location, you will receive a monthly cell and internet stipend.
  • Premium Healthcare - We offer comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family, which employees are eligible for on their first day.
  • Flexible PTO and Parental Leave - We offer a generous PTO and encourage employees to take time off to recharge. We're proud to offer a parental leave policy that allows you to welcome your new addition without worry.

We are a workforce composed of individuals with diverse backgrounds, abilities, minds, and identities. In keeping with our commitment to inclusion, we will ensure that people with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodations are required when applying, interviewing, or performing the essential functions of this position, please contact People Operations, at .

raw.title: Engineering Manager - Stock Trading App
raw.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

raw.description:
Über IMSM

IMSM (International Management Systems Marketing) ist ein weltweit tätiges Beratungsunternehmen im Bereich ISO-Managementsysteme. Wir unterstützen Organisationen nicht nur bei der Zertifizierung, sondern auch bei der nachhaltigen Optimierung ihrer Prozesse, Compliance-Strukturen und betrieblichen Leistungsfähigkeit.

Als Teil der Axiom GRC-Gruppe innerhalb der WorkNest-Gruppe und mit Unterstützung von Inflexion verfügen wir über die Reichweite und Ressourcen einer globalen Organisation. Mit Teams in Großbritannien, Europa, Nordamerika, APAC, Afrika und Kanada sowie einem Netzwerk von mehr als 85 Mitarbeitenden und über 350 erfahrenen Auftragnehmern bieten wir unseren Kunden weltweit hochwertige, ergebnisorientierte ISO-Beratung.

Die Chance

Wir suchen erfahrene ISO-Leadauditoren und ISO-Berater, die unser internationales Netzwerk auf selbstständiger Basis verstärken möchten.

Diese flexible Tätigkeit eignet sich besonders für Auftragnehmer, die Folgendes suchen:

  • Flexible, projektbasierte Tätigkeit ohne Garantie für eine stetige Pipeline an Kundenaufträgen

  • Remote-Arbeit mit gelegentlichen Vor-Ort-Einsätzen beim Kunden

  • Projektanfragen, die sich an Branchenexpertise und Zertifizierungsumfang orientieren

  • Zugang zu einem globalen Kundenportfolio und einem etablierten ISO-Beratungsnetzwerk

  • Unterstützung durch eine renommierte internationale ISO-Beratungsorganisation

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Durchführung von ISO-Beratungs- und/oder Auditprojekten gemäß den jeweils vereinbarten Projekt- und Vertragsbedingungen

  • Erstellung und Präsentation von Bewertungsberichten, Auditberichten und Präsentationen, die Ergebnisse, Feststellungen und Empfehlungen klar und verständlich darstellen

  • Formulierung konkreter, umsetzbarer Empfehlungen zur Behebung von Nichtkonformitäten und zur Verbesserung von Managementsystemen

  • Sicherstellung der vereinbarten projektspezifischen Dokumentation und Berichterstattung

  • Kontinuierliche Pflege und Weiterentwicklung Ihrer fachlichen Kenntnisse in Bezug auf Managementsysteme, Normen und regulatorische Anforderungen

Was Sie mitbringen

  • IRCA-Zertifizierung als Lead Auditor nach ISO 17025 oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation (unbedingt erforderlich)

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Implementierung und/oder Auditierung von Managementsystemen

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Stakeholder souverän einzubinden

  • Hohe Selbstorganisation, Zuverlässigkeit und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte parallel zu steuern

  • Flexibilität und Anpassungsfähigkeit im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Kundenanforderungen

Rahmenbedingungen der Zusammenarbeit (rechtliche Klarstellung)

  • Die Tätigkeit erfolgt ausschließlich auf selbstständiger, freiberuflicher Basis

  • Es besteht keine Verpflichtung zur Annahme von Aufträgen

  • Es besteht keine Garantie für kontinuierliche oder regelmäßige Beauftragungen

  • Keine fachliche, zeitliche oder organisatorische Weisungsgebundenheit

  • Die Leistungserbringung erfolgt eigenverantwortlich, projektbezogen und ergebnisorientiert

  • Keine Exklusivität; die Tätigkeit für andere Auftraggeber ist zulässig

Warum eine Partnerschaft mit IMSM?

  • Zugang zu Projektanfragen innerhalb eines internationalen Kundenportfolios, abhängig von Bedarf und Verfügbarkeit

  • Möglichkeit, branchenübergreifend und nach verschiedenen ISO-Standards tätig zu sein

  • Strukturierte Unterstützung durch Tools, Ressourcen und bewährte Methoden

  • Eine kooperative, professionelle und integrative Unternehmenskultur, geprägt von Qualität und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung

Werden Sie Teil unserer globalen Auftragnehmer-Community

Als Teil der WorkNest-Gruppe und der Axiom GRC-Division tragen Sie zu einem internationalen Netzwerk von über 800 Experten bei, die die Zukunft der Governance-, Risiko- und Compliance-Dienstleistungen aktiv mitgestalten.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener ISO-Experte sind und eine flexible, eigenverantwortliche Tätigkeit in Zusammenarbeit mit einem marktführenden Beratungsunternehmen suchen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme.

raw.title: Social-Media-Assistenz (m/w/d) - 100% Homeoffice, Teilzeit 25-30 h
raw.excerpt: WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast.
raw.description:
WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast. Ohne diese Erfahrung ist eine Bewerbung leider nicht sinnvoll.

Du bist auf Facebook und Instagram zu Hause, arbeitest gerne sorgfältig und verlässlich und suchst eine Aufgabe für rund 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche, die du zu 100% aus dem Homeoffice erledigen kannst?

Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, durch digitales Recruiting die besten Mitarbeiter zu finden. Dafür läuft bei uns ein eingespielter Prozess: Wir wissen, welche Werbeanzeigen funktionieren, wie die Texte aufgebaut sind und wie eine Kampagne aussehen muss und welche Handgriffe es in Meta für eine erfolgreiche Kampagne braucht.

Genau diesen Prozess sollst du bei uns abarbeiten - Schritt für Schritt, Kampagne für Kampagne.

Wir wachsen weiter und suchen deshalb Unterstützung bei der Durchführung unserer Projekte.

Deine Aufgaben

Grundvoraussetzung für diese Stelle: Anlegen von Kampagnen in Meta (Verwendung des Ad Managers von Meta)

Eingabe und Änderung von Meta/Facebook/Instagram Werbeanzeigen (Ads) im Meta Business Manager

Du legst unsere Kunden in BVS an und erstellst die Verknüpfungen, so dass die Bewerber auch an den Kunden weitergeleitet werden.

Betreuen unserer Recruiting-Kampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Projektleiterin, nach unserem bestehenden System

Als Urlaubsvertretung übernimmst du die Gestaltung von Kampagnen in Canva und erstellst die passenden Texte für neue Kampagnen. Du arbeitest mit unseren Vorlagen und setzt daraus ansprechende Anzeigen und Grafiken um.

Du musst nicht (!) zwingend Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, HR oder Projektmanagement haben

Das bringst du mit

Du hast eingehende Erfahrung im Umgang mit Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Du hast Freude daran Anzeigen anzulegen, zu ändern und zu kontrollieren.

Das Wichtigste vorweg: Unser Prozess steht, er funktioniert, und er ist in Vorlagen und Abläufen festgehalten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn sauber, genau und verlässlich abzuarbeiten - nicht, ihn neu zu erfinden.

Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sind uns wichtiger als originelle Einfälle. Wer gerne nach einem klaren System arbeitet, ist bei uns richtig.

Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann etwas ansprechend aussieht? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich.

Offenheit und Interesse an neuen Ideen, Programmen und Tools

Eigenständiges Denken und sauberes, strukturiertes Arbeiten mit Hausverstand sind für dich selbstverständlich und keine Ausnahme.

Du kannst gut damit umgehen, dass kurzfristige Todos immer wieder aufploppen, und priorisierst Aufgaben.

Du arbeitest nicht nach starren Zeiten – kannst dich gut organisieren und einteilen.

Sehr guter Umgang mit dem Computer (Windows oder Mac, MS Office)

Regelmäßige Kommunikation deiner Fortschritte in internen Online-Meetings

Ein Hinweis in eigener Sache: Ausgebildete und erfahrene Grafikerinnen und Grafiker sind bei uns unterfordert - die Aufgabe ist die Umsetzung mit Vorlagen, nicht die freie Gestaltung.

Das bieten wir

Teilzeit (25-30 Stunden / Woche), auf Wunsch später mehr

Gemeinsame Zusammenarbeit online im kleinen Team mit eigener Verantwortung

Du kannst nach unserem eigens entwickelten System arbeiten und bekommst alles beigebracht

100% Arbeit aus dem Home-Office möglich – bitte keine Digitalen Nomaden

Klare Abläufe statt ständig wechselnder Anforderungen - du weißt, was zu tun ist

Gehalt: Wir bezahlen das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt laut Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte im Gewerbe, Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung, Verwendungsgruppe 2, Einstieg ohne Vorerfahrung. Das sind € 2.059,41 brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit (40 Stunden), 14-mal im Jahr. Bei 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche entspricht das € 1.287,13 bis € 1.544,56 brutto pro Monat. Eine Überzahlung ist nicht vorgesehen.

Bitte beachte: Diese Stelle ist sehr begehrt - wegen der Freiheiten, die wir bieten, und weil du zu 100% im Homeoffice arbeitest. Eine Bewerbung ist deshalb nur dann sinnvoll, wenn du praktische Erfahrung mit Meta-Ads mitbringst, wenn das angegebene Gehalt für dich passt und dir bewusst ist, dass es in den ersten 2 Jahren nicht steigen wird (ausgenommen die jährliche kollektivvertragliche Anpassung). Andernfalls ist eine Bewerbung hinfällig.

Art der Stelle: Teilzeit, Freie Mitarbeit, Minijob

Interessiert? Melde dich bei uns und lass uns sprechen (Lebenslauf und deine Kontaktdaten reichen aus - kein Motivationsschreiben).

What You'll Do

  • Design and integrate robotic mechanisms, sensors, actuators, controllers, and drone payload systems.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a high-performing engineering team building and scaling products used by millions of users across the region.

This role is for a strong technical leader who can lead engineers, make sound architecture and engineering decisions, and drive products and systems from idea to production. You will be responsible for both the quality of the engineering team and the quality and speed of what the team ships.

You should be comfortable operating across people, product and technology — setting a high engineering bar while keeping the team focused on delivering real customer and business outcomes.

What You'll Own

  • Lead and manage a team of engineers across frontend, backend and full stack development.

  • Own engineering delivery for major product areas, ensuring the team ships quickly without compromising reliability and technical quality.

  • Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI teams to turn ambiguous product problems into clear technical execution.

  • Drive technical architecture and engineering decisions across APIs, databases, integrations, infrastructure and customer-facing systems.

  • Set engineering standards around code quality, system design, testing, observability, security and production reliability.

  • Stay close to the technical work through architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging and critical engineering decisions.

  • Develop engineers through regular feedback, coaching, performance management and clear expectations.

  • Identify performance gaps early and take ownership of raising the team's engineering and execution bar.

  • Improve engineering processes, tooling and automation to help the team move faster and operate at scale.

  • Own production outcomes beyond release: monitor systems, resolve incidents, identify root causes and ensure problems do not repeat.

  • Build a strong engineering culture focused on ownership, speed, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with experience building and shipping real production systems.

  • Experience leading or managing software engineers and owning engineering delivery.

  • Strong technical depth across backend, frontend, APIs, databases, distributed systems or cloud infrastructure.

  • Able to make sound architecture and technical trade-offs while balancing speed, scalability and maintainability.

  • Strong track record of taking products or systems from idea through development, launch and production.

  • Comfortable reviewing technical designs, challenging engineering decisions and debugging complex production issues.

  • Strong people leadership with the ability to coach engineers, manage performance and build high-performing teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect engineering decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity, establish priorities and drive teams toward clear outcomes.

  • Strong ownership mentality — when something breaks or delivery slips, you take responsibility for getting it back on track.

This Role Is Not For

  • Managers who want to manage people without staying close to the technology.

  • Engineers who want the title of Engineering Manager but do not want accountability for team performance.

  • Leaders who need complete specifications before their team can start.

  • Managers who measure success by meetings, processes or tickets instead of shipped outcomes.

  • People who avoid difficult technical decisions, performance conversations or production issues.

  • Candidates who make vague leadership claims without being able to explain what they personally built, led, improved or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for engineering leaders with real technology career highlights.

A strong highlight is not just managing a large team or working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or engineering organisation and can clearly explain your contribution.

You should be able to demonstrate both sides of engineering leadership: technical depth and the ability to build a high-performing team that consistently delivers.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical / engineering leadership interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Über IMSM

IMSM (International Management Systems Marketing) ist ein weltweit tätiges Beratungsunternehmen im Bereich ISO-Managementsysteme. Wir unterstützen Organisationen nicht nur bei der Zertifizierung, sondern auch bei der nachhaltigen Optimierung ihrer Prozesse, Compliance-Strukturen und betrieblichen Leistungsfähigkeit.

Als Teil der Axiom GRC-Gruppe innerhalb der WorkNest-Gruppe und mit Unterstützung von Inflexion verfügen wir über die Reichweite und Ressourcen einer globalen Organisation. Mit Teams in Großbritannien, Europa, Nordamerika, APAC, Afrika und Kanada sowie einem Netzwerk von mehr als 85 Mitarbeitenden und über 350 erfahrenen Auftragnehmern bieten wir unseren Kunden weltweit hochwertige, ergebnisorientierte ISO-Beratung.

Die Chance

Wir suchen erfahrene ISO-Leadauditoren und ISO-Berater, die unser internationales Netzwerk auf selbstständiger Basis verstärken möchten.

Diese flexible Tätigkeit eignet sich besonders für Auftragnehmer, die Folgendes suchen:

  • Flexible, projektbasierte Tätigkeit ohne Garantie für eine stetige Pipeline an Kundenaufträgen

  • Remote-Arbeit mit gelegentlichen Vor-Ort-Einsätzen beim Kunden

  • Projektanfragen, die sich an Branchenexpertise und Zertifizierungsumfang orientieren

  • Zugang zu einem globalen Kundenportfolio und einem etablierten ISO-Beratungsnetzwerk

  • Unterstützung durch eine renommierte internationale ISO-Beratungsorganisation

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Durchführung von ISO-Beratungs- und/oder Auditprojekten gemäß den jeweils vereinbarten Projekt- und Vertragsbedingungen

  • Erstellung und Präsentation von Bewertungsberichten, Auditberichten und Präsentationen, die Ergebnisse, Feststellungen und Empfehlungen klar und verständlich darstellen

  • Formulierung konkreter, umsetzbarer Empfehlungen zur Behebung von Nichtkonformitäten und zur Verbesserung von Managementsystemen

  • Sicherstellung der vereinbarten projektspezifischen Dokumentation und Berichterstattung

  • Kontinuierliche Pflege und Weiterentwicklung Ihrer fachlichen Kenntnisse in Bezug auf Managementsysteme, Normen und regulatorische Anforderungen

Was Sie mitbringen

  • IRCA-Zertifizierung als Lead Auditor nach ISO 17025 oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation (unbedingt erforderlich)

  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Implementierung und/oder Auditierung von Managementsystemen

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Stakeholder souverän einzubinden

  • Hohe Selbstorganisation, Zuverlässigkeit und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte parallel zu steuern

  • Flexibilität und Anpassungsfähigkeit im Umgang mit unterschiedlichen Kundenanforderungen

Rahmenbedingungen der Zusammenarbeit (rechtliche Klarstellung)

  • Die Tätigkeit erfolgt ausschließlich auf selbstständiger, freiberuflicher Basis

  • Es besteht keine Verpflichtung zur Annahme von Aufträgen

  • Es besteht keine Garantie für kontinuierliche oder regelmäßige Beauftragungen

  • Keine fachliche, zeitliche oder organisatorische Weisungsgebundenheit

  • Die Leistungserbringung erfolgt eigenverantwortlich, projektbezogen und ergebnisorientiert

  • Keine Exklusivität; die Tätigkeit für andere Auftraggeber ist zulässig

Warum eine Partnerschaft mit IMSM?

  • Zugang zu Projektanfragen innerhalb eines internationalen Kundenportfolios, abhängig von Bedarf und Verfügbarkeit

  • Möglichkeit, branchenübergreifend und nach verschiedenen ISO-Standards tätig zu sein

  • Strukturierte Unterstützung durch Tools, Ressourcen und bewährte Methoden

  • Eine kooperative, professionelle und integrative Unternehmenskultur, geprägt von Qualität und kontinuierlicher Verbesserung

Werden Sie Teil unserer globalen Auftragnehmer-Community

Als Teil der WorkNest-Gruppe und der Axiom GRC-Division tragen Sie zu einem internationalen Netzwerk von über 800 Experten bei, die die Zukunft der Governance-, Risiko- und Compliance-Dienstleistungen aktiv mitgestalten.

Wenn Sie ein erfahrener ISO-Experte sind und eine flexible, eigenverantwortliche Tätigkeit in Zusammenarbeit mit einem marktführenden Beratungsunternehmen suchen, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Kontaktaufnahme.

raw.title: Social-Media-Assistenz (m/w/d) - 100% Homeoffice, Teilzeit 25-30 h
raw.excerpt: WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast.
raw.description:
WICHTIG: Wir können nur Bewerbungen berücksichtigen, wenn du bereits selbst Werbeanzeigen im Meta Werbeanzeigenmanager (Facebook/Instagram) erstellt und bearbeitet hast. Ohne diese Erfahrung ist eine Bewerbung leider nicht sinnvoll.

Du bist auf Facebook und Instagram zu Hause, arbeitest gerne sorgfältig und verlässlich und suchst eine Aufgabe für rund 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche, die du zu 100% aus dem Homeoffice erledigen kannst?

Wir helfen Unternehmen dabei, durch digitales Recruiting die besten Mitarbeiter zu finden. Dafür läuft bei uns ein eingespielter Prozess: Wir wissen, welche Werbeanzeigen funktionieren, wie die Texte aufgebaut sind und wie eine Kampagne aussehen muss und welche Handgriffe es in Meta für eine erfolgreiche Kampagne braucht.

Genau diesen Prozess sollst du bei uns abarbeiten - Schritt für Schritt, Kampagne für Kampagne.

Wir wachsen weiter und suchen deshalb Unterstützung bei der Durchführung unserer Projekte.

Deine Aufgaben

Grundvoraussetzung für diese Stelle: Anlegen von Kampagnen in Meta (Verwendung des Ad Managers von Meta)

Eingabe und Änderung von Meta/Facebook/Instagram Werbeanzeigen (Ads) im Meta Business Manager

Du legst unsere Kunden in BVS an und erstellst die Verknüpfungen, so dass die Bewerber auch an den Kunden weitergeleitet werden.

Betreuen unserer Recruiting-Kampagnen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserer Projektleiterin, nach unserem bestehenden System

Als Urlaubsvertretung übernimmst du die Gestaltung von Kampagnen in Canva und erstellst die passenden Texte für neue Kampagnen. Du arbeitest mit unseren Vorlagen und setzt daraus ansprechende Anzeigen und Grafiken um.

Du musst nicht (!) zwingend Vorerfahrung im Recruiting, HR oder Projektmanagement haben

Das bringst du mit

Du hast eingehende Erfahrung im Umgang mit Meta (Facebook/Instagram). Du hast Freude daran Anzeigen anzulegen, zu ändern und zu kontrollieren.

Das Wichtigste vorweg: Unser Prozess steht, er funktioniert, und er ist in Vorlagen und Abläufen festgehalten. Deine Aufgabe ist es, ihn sauber, genau und verlässlich abzuarbeiten - nicht, ihn neu zu erfinden.

Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit sind uns wichtiger als originelle Einfälle. Wer gerne nach einem klaren System arbeitet, ist bei uns richtig.

Du hast ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann etwas ansprechend aussieht? Dann freuen wir uns auf dich.

Offenheit und Interesse an neuen Ideen, Programmen und Tools

Eigenständiges Denken und sauberes, strukturiertes Arbeiten mit Hausverstand sind für dich selbstverständlich und keine Ausnahme.

Du kannst gut damit umgehen, dass kurzfristige Todos immer wieder aufploppen, und priorisierst Aufgaben.

Du arbeitest nicht nach starren Zeiten – kannst dich gut organisieren und einteilen.

Sehr guter Umgang mit dem Computer (Windows oder Mac, MS Office)

Regelmäßige Kommunikation deiner Fortschritte in internen Online-Meetings

Ein Hinweis in eigener Sache: Ausgebildete und erfahrene Grafikerinnen und Grafiker sind bei uns unterfordert - die Aufgabe ist die Umsetzung mit Vorlagen, nicht die freie Gestaltung.

Das bieten wir

Teilzeit (25-30 Stunden / Woche), auf Wunsch später mehr

Gemeinsame Zusammenarbeit online im kleinen Team mit eigener Verantwortung

Du kannst nach unserem eigens entwickelten System arbeiten und bekommst alles beigebracht

100% Arbeit aus dem Home-Office möglich – bitte keine Digitalen Nomaden

Klare Abläufe statt ständig wechselnder Anforderungen - du weißt, was zu tun ist

Gehalt: Wir bezahlen das kollektivvertragliche Mindestgehalt laut Kollektivvertrag für Angestellte im Gewerbe, Handwerk und in der Dienstleistung, Verwendungsgruppe 2, Einstieg ohne Vorerfahrung. Das sind € 2.059,41 brutto pro Monat bei Vollzeit (40 Stunden), 14-mal im Jahr. Bei 25 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche entspricht das € 1.287,13 bis € 1.544,56 brutto pro Monat. Eine Überzahlung ist nicht vorgesehen.

Bitte beachte: Diese Stelle ist sehr begehrt - wegen der Freiheiten, die wir bieten, und weil du zu 100% im Homeoffice arbeitest. Eine Bewerbung ist deshalb nur dann sinnvoll, wenn du praktische Erfahrung mit Meta-Ads mitbringst, wenn das angegebene Gehalt für dich passt und dir bewusst ist, dass es in den ersten 2 Jahren nicht steigen wird (ausgenommen die jährliche kollektivvertragliche Anpassung). Andernfalls ist eine Bewerbung hinfällig.

Art der Stelle: Teilzeit, Freie Mitarbeit, Minijob

Interessiert? Melde dich bei uns und lass uns sprechen (Lebenslauf und deine Kontaktdaten reichen aus - kein Motivationsschreiben).

raw.description:
About the Role

Join an engineering and R&D team as a Robotics Engineer focused on autonomous systems. You will build and integrate drone-based robotic systems from prototype through field validation, supporting safe and reliable delivery operations.

What You'll Do

  • Design and integrate robotic mechanisms, sensors, actuators, controllers, and drone payload systems.

  • Develop control, navigation, path-planning, and obstacle-avoidance solutions.

  • Program robotics software with ROS or ROS 2 and C++ or Python, and validate solutions in simulation.

  • Integrate flight controllers, companion computers, communication links, and telemetry with drone systems.

  • Build, troubleshoot, and field-test prototypes, analyzing flight logs and sensor data.

  • Collaborate with mechanical, electronics, and software teams on prototype development and deployment.

What We're Looking For

  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience in robotics, UAV systems, or autonomous systems.

  • Strong foundations in kinematics, dynamics, control theory, PID, and system integration.

  • Proficiency in C++ or Python, ROS or ROS 2, and Linux; familiarity with MATLAB.

  • Practical experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, motors, ESCs, batteries, and flight controllers.

  • Knowledge of IMU, GPS or RTK, LiDAR, sensor fusion, and GPS-denied navigation.

  • Experience with embedded systems, microcontrollers, Raspberry Pi or Jetson, actuators, and hardware debugging.

  • Familiarity with CAN, UART, I2C, drone telemetry, simulation, field testing, and flight-log analysis.

  • Background in robotics, mechatronics, electrical engineering, aerospace, computer science, or a related field. Computer vision, machine learning, SLAM, Gazebo, Webots, CAD, or BVLOS experience is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

Visa sponsorship is not available.

raw.description:
Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
Consulting is changing, and we’re not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.
We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world’s leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.

The Role

The Global Analytics Business Consulting Team applies data science and AI to help customers turn commercial, medical, and regulatory data into action. We are seeking a Global Data Science Lead that will support execution of the Data Science AI strategy within this team. This role will lead a group of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and analysts, and partners with Global Analytics leadership to turn strategy into delivery — applying advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI/LLM techniques to life sciences data.

What You'll Do

    • Lead the Data Science function within the Global Analytics Team, in line with Veeva's Analytics Business Consulting goals
    • Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, and analysts within the Global Analytics Team
    • Partner with Global Analytics leadership to translate the broader Data Science AI strategy into team priorities and delivery plans
    • Own global methodology – model management, observability, testing, and deployment
    • Foster collaboration between consulting, data science, and engineering teams to ensure seamless integration of AI-driven data solutions
    • Oversee the design and implementation of advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI/LLM models within the Global Analytics Team's scope of work
    • Ensure the development and maintenance of robust, scalable, and efficient data and AI infrastructure supporting Global Analytics Team deliverables
    • Collaborate with cross-functional consulting teams to understand customer business requirements and translate them into AI-native, data-driven solutions
    • Work with product and business stakeholders to surface opportunities for applying AI within Global Analytics Team engagements
    • Enforce best practices for data quality, security, governance, and responsible AI use within the team
    • Implement and maintain rigorous testing procedures to validate the accuracy and reliability of data, ML, and AI models

Requirements

    • Ph.D. in Economics, Machine Learning, Applied Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, or other quantitative discipline with 5+ years of relevant industry experience, or equivalent M.S. with 8+ years of relevant demonstrable research experience
    • Experience with the Life Sciences industry and applying analytics and AI/ML to related data sets
    • Hands-on experience building or deploying LLM-based systems (prompt engineering, RAG, agentic workflows, or fine-tuning). Advanced, in-depth specialization in data science and AI techniques including classification, pattern recognition, clustering, feature analysis, NLP, fuzzy matching, sentiment analysis, A/B testing, active/adaptive learning
    • Proven leadership of teams of 10+ people
    • Intellectual curiosity, along with excellent problem-solving and quantitative skills, including the ability to disaggregate issues, identify root causes, and recommend solutions, even in situations with non-standard problems
    • Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to effectively explain complex technical and AI-driven solutions to other team members and clients
    • Must be comfortable with changing requirements and priorities
    • Must be results-oriented and able to move forward without complete information and with minimal supervision

Nice to Have

    • Advanced experience with AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks
    • Data pipeline building skills
    • Product development experience
    • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) or vector databases
    • Experience designing AI-native products or workflows, not just adding AI to existing systems

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.
  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • If moving to the interview stage, our process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A personality assessment
    3. A practical case exercise
    4. A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program
  • Unrivaled career progression in a fast-growing, global team
  • Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

Compensation

  • Base pay: $120,000 - $250,000
  • The salary range listed here has been provided to comply with local regulations and represents a potential base salary range for this role. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range above or below, depending on experience and location. We look at compensation for each individual and base our offer on your unique qualifications, experience, and expected contributions. This position may also be eligible for other types of compensation in addition to base salary, such as variable bonus and/or stock bonus.
Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances. Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks, particularly Playwright and Pytest, for API and/or UI testing
  • Experience validating low-latency / high-throughput systems, familiarity with performance tools such as k6 or Locust
  • Experience in crypto / Web3 or systematic-trading domains specifically
  • Applied use of AI in the QA workflow, e.g. LLM-assisted test generation, agentic failure triage, or LLM-output evaluation (LLM-as-judge, non-deterministic system testing), as an engineering practice, not just tool usage
  • Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL
  • Exposure to data warehouse / data lake / streaming-pipeline testing
  • Familiarity with monitoring/logging tools such as Datadog or Grafana

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. First Interview – An initial interview with the hiring manager to evaluate overall fit, experience, and mutual expectations.
  3. Test Assignment Review – A problem-solving session with the team, or a take-home assignment with a follow-up discussion of the candidate’s approach and solutions.
  4. Second Interview – Interview with the CTO to delve into your resume and skills and discuss your career goals.
  5. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

À propos d'IMSM

IMSM (International Management Systems Marketing) est un acteur mondial dans le domaine du conseil ISO. Nous aidons les organisations non seulement à obtenir la certification, mais aussi à transformer leur mode de fonctionnement. Nous travaillons en partenariat avec des entreprises de tous les secteurs afin d'améliorer leurs performances, de renforcer leur conformité et de leur permettre de bénéficier d'un avantage concurrentiel mesurable.

Désormais intégré à la division Axiom GRC du groupe WorkNest et soutenu par Inflexion, nous bénéficions de la portée et des ressources d'une organisation mondiale. Avec des équipes réparties au Royaume-Uni, en Europe, en Amérique du Nord, en Asie-Pacifique, en Afrique et au Canada, et un réseau croissant de 85 employés et plus de 350 experts sous contrat, nous sommes en mesure de fournir des services de conseil ISO de haute qualité et axés sur les résultats à des clients du monde entier.

L'opportunité

Nous recherchons des auditeurs principaux ISO et des consultants ISO expérimentés pour rejoindre notre réseau professionnel en tant qu'indépendants.

Ce poste flexible est idéal pour les contractants qui souhaitent :

  • Un flux constant de travail avec des clients

  • Travailler à distance avec des visites occasionnelles sur site

  • Des missions en adéquation avec leur expertise sectorielle

  • Le soutien d'un cabinet de conseil ISO mondialement reconnu

  • Préparer et présenter des exposés et des rapports d'évaluation qui communiquent clairement les conclusions et les décisions aux clients

  • Fournir des recommandations claires et concrètes pour remédier à toute non-conformité ou tout domaine à améliorer identifié.

  • Veiller à la mise à jour précise et en temps opportun des dossiers des clients et des systèmes internes afin de garantir l'intégrité et la conformité des données.

  • Maintenir et développer en permanence vos connaissances techniques et votre expertise en matière de systèmes de gestion et de normes pertinentes

Ce que vous apporterez

  • La certification IRCA d'auditeur principal selon la norme ISO 17025 (ou équivalent) est indispensable.

  • Expérience prouvée dans la mise en place, la maintenance de certification et l'audit de systèmes de management ISO.

  • Solides compétences en communication et en mobilisation des parties prenantes.

  • Solides compétences organisationnelles avec une capacité à mener plusieurs tâches de front et à établir efficacement les priorités.

  • Capacité d'adaptation et flexibilité pour répondre aux besoins variés des clients.

Pourquoi devenir partenaire d'IMSM ?

  • Flux constant de missions de conseil et d'audit

  • Possibilité de travailler dans plusieurs secteurs et selon différentes normes

  • Un soutien structuré, des ressources et des outils pour vous aider à fournir des résultats exceptionnels à vos clients

  • Une culture collaborative et inclusive fondée sur le professionnalisme, le respect et l'amélioration continue

Rejoignez notre communauté mondiale de prestataires

En tant que membre du groupe WorkNest et de la division Axiom GRC, vous contribuerez à un puissant réseau de plus de 800 experts qui façonnent l'avenir des services de gouvernance, de gestion des risques et de conformité.

Si vous êtes un professionnel ISO dévoué à la recherche d'un travail flexible et gratifiant au sein d'un cabinet de conseil leader sur le marché, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer.
