GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Strategic Account Executive, you’ll help expand GitLab’s presence across the Public Sector in Brazil by building trusted relationships with senior leaders at large organizations and guiding them through complex platform decisions. You’ll use a consultative sales approach to connect customer business needs with our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, helping teams improve developer productivity, reduce security and compliance risk, and move software delivery forward with more confidence. In this role, you’ll support strategic accounts across the full customer journey, from early conversations through adoption, while helping us position GitLab as a leading DevSecOps partner in the Brazilian market.

You’ll work across pre-sales, post-sales, partner, marketing, and support teams, and we’ll rely on you to bring strong account leadership, customer outcomes, and clear communication in English and Portuguese. Over your first year, your impact will come from building account plans for large organizations, developing new opportunities, and helping customers successfully adopt GitLab in ways that align to their business goals.

What you’ll do

  • Lead strategic account activity for prospects and customers across the Public Sector in Brazil, providing direction throughout pre-sales and post-sales engagements.

  • Develop opportunities within Public Sector accounts through prospecting, relationship building, and a consultative understanding of customer business needs.

  • Create account plans and customer proposals that clearly connect GitLab capabilities to organizational priorities and transformation goals.

  • Coordinate with pre-sales, post-sales, and support teams to support successful product rollout and customer adoption.

  • Generate qualified pipeline in partnership with strategic channel partners and support new customer development efforts.

  • Contribute customer feedback and product ideas to GitLab’s public issue tracker to represent the voice of the customer.

  • Prepare activity and forecast reports, and help analyze wins and losses to improve future sales execution.

  • Collaborate with marketing, account teams, product managers, and technical teams to share lessons learned and communicate customer needs clearly.

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years experience selling into large organizations and navigating complex Public Sector sales cycles with multiple stakeholders.

  • Ability to build and manage executive-level customer relationships with a high degree of ownership and follow-through.

  • Skill in consultative selling, including shaping proposals, presentations, and formal quotes around customer business needs.

  • Strength in negotiation, presentation, and closing conversations in a clear and effective way.

  • Comfort working independently on complex projects while coordinating with cross-functional teams.

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese for customer-facing and internal communication.

  • Familiarity with GitLab or related tools, including Git, software development tools, application lifecycle management, or security and application security tools.

  • Alignment with GitLab’s values, with openness to transferable experience from adjacent technical or software environments.

About the team

The team focuses on growing GitLab’s Public Sector business in Brazil by helping organizations adopt a single platform for software delivery, security, and collaboration. This role works closely with cross-functional partners across sales, solutions, support, marketing, and product, and contributes to an asynchronous, distributed way of working that values transparency, accountability, and shared customer insight. The team’s work sits at the intersection of strategic growth and customer transformation, with a focus on helping Public Sector organizations evaluate, adopt, and expand their use of GitLab across complex environments.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know during the recruiting process.

Know the Workday, SAP or Coupa ecosystem? We want to talk.

Relish is growing, and we're looking for experienced Enterprise Account Executives to join our Workday, SAP and Coupa sales teams.

We're hiring multiple AEs across all three channels, and we're specifically looking for sales professionals who know these ecosystems, understand how to navigate their partner networks, and have built strong relationships along the way.

If you've spent your career selling within or alongside Workday, SAP or Coupa, this is an opportunity to take those relationships, your enterprise sales expertise and your ambition into a business experiencing significant growth.

Who we are

At Relish, we're transforming how enterprises manage supplier relationships, third-party risk and financial operations.

Our AI-powered solutions help organizations maximize their enterprise software investments, streamline supplier data validation, improve invoicing processes and reduce risk.

Trusted by more than 100 global organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, we're growing at approximately 60% year on year.

And following our acquisition by Eftsure, we're entering an exciting new chapter, with expanded capabilities, new market opportunities and even greater potential to deliver value to enterprise customers.

Three channels. Multiple opportunities.

We're building out our sales teams across three enterprise technology ecosystems:

  • Workday: You'll have experience within the Workday ecosystem, whether selling Workday solutions directly, working with Workday partners or collaborating closely with Workday sales teams. Established relationships and an understanding of the Workday landscape are highly valued.

  • SAP: You'll bring experience selling SAP solutions, particularly SAP Ariba or S/4HANA, with an understanding of the SAP ecosystem, partner networks and enterprise customer landscape.

  • Coupa: You'll have experience selling Coupa solutions or working within the Coupa ecosystem, with established relationships and a strong understanding of enterprise procurement and spend management.

You only need experience in ONE of these ecosystems to be considered. We're hiring multiple Account Executives within each channel.

What you'll be doing

  • Own the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through to negotiation and closing.

  • Build and manage your own pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting, strategic networking and partner relationships, supported by our SDR team.

  • Leverage your existing ecosystem relationships to identify opportunities, build partnerships and accelerate deals.

  • Engage senior decision-makers and C-suite executives, positioning Relish's solutions against complex business challenges.

  • Develop strategic territory plans and identify opportunities across large enterprise accounts.

  • Collaborate with technology partners, alliance teams and internal stakeholders to drive new business.

  • Deliver compelling presentations, tailored proposals and commercial negotiations.

  • Own your sales targets, maintain accurate forecasts and consistently drive revenue growth.

What we're looking for

We're looking for experienced, commercially driven AEs who know how to create opportunities, not just wait for leads.

  • 5+ years of B2B software or SaaS sales experience, ideally selling into enterprise organizations.

  • Experience within at least one of the Workday, SAP or Coupa ecosystems, with an established network of relevant relationships.

  • A strong track record of achieving or exceeding sales quotas and closing complex, high-value deals.

  • Experience navigating enterprise sales cycles involving multiple stakeholders and senior executives.

  • Strong prospecting skills and a genuine willingness to build your own pipeline.

  • A structured, consultative sales approach with excellent discovery, presentation and negotiation skills.

  • The confidence to operate autonomously, manage a territory and build meaningful customer relationships.

Experience selling ERP, procurement, finance or enterprise technology solutions will be highly regarded.

Why join Relish?

Big opportunity. Real ownership. Uncapped earning potential.

  • High-growth business: Join a company growing approximately 60% year on year, with even greater opportunities following our acquisition by Eftsure.

  • Significant market opportunity: Large territories, established technology partnerships and plenty of untapped enterprise accounts.

  • Competitive earning potentialplus uncapped commission and accelerators.

  • 100% remote: Work from anywhere in the United States, with occasional travel for customer meetings, partner events and team activities.

  • Support to succeed: Dedicated SDR support, sales enablement and a structured ramp-up period.

  • Comprehensive benefits: Health, dental and vision insurance, 401(k) with employer match, flexible time off and more.

  • An exciting time to join: Be part of an expanding business with new capabilities, ambitious growth plans and genuine opportunities to make an impact.

Ready to make your next move?

If you know the Workday, SAP or Coupa ecosystem, have the relationships to open doors and the sales expertise to close complex enterprise deals, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and let us know which ecosystem you specialize in: Workday, SAP or Coupa.

raw.description:
Position Overview
The Security Cross functional SuccessArchitect serves as a strategic advisor who helps enterprise customers get the most value from their ServiceNow investments. This role combines deep technical expertise across the ServiceNow platform and its product portfolio with consultative skills to guide organizations in optimizing and maturing their solutions. The Product Excellence (PEx) team uses deep product expertise to solve implementation and adoption challenges for customers. We work with product and cross-functional teams, sharing customer insights to drive innovation, scale, and product improvements.

Security Cross-Functional Success Architect – Armis , ServiceNow Security & Risk Products

Job Description – Key Responsibilities

1. Drive Customer Success & Adoption: Lead technical engagements across Armis and ServiceNow Security products, helping enterprise customers accelerate adoption, optimize implementations, and achieve measurable business outcomes.

2. Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Sales, Professional Services, and Customer Success teams to resolve complex technical challenges and drive customer success.

3. Security Architecture & Integration: Provide architectural guidance on Armis integrations with ServiceNow SecOps, CMDB, ITOM, Vulnerability Response, and OT Security to deliver unified asset visibility and risk management.

4. Strategic Customer Engagement: Act as a trusted technical advisor for strategic accounts, proactively identifying implementation risks, managing escalations, and improving security posture and operational resilience.

5. Scale Best Practices & Enablement: Develop reusable accelerators, technical playbooks, health checks, and enablement content to improve implementation quality, drive product adoption, and scale customer success across the security portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic guidance on ServiceNow platform architecture and best practices across multiple product lines
  • Deliver enablement and best practice guidance for ServiceNow solutions such as, Security Products, Integrated Risk Management,
  • Assess customer implementations for performance, scalability, data quality, and upgrade readiness, and recommend improvements
  • Mentor technical teams and influence stakeholders on platform capabilities and optimization strategies
  • Lead discovery sessions and develop solution roadmaps aligned with customer business objectives
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to help customers achieve measurable business outcomes from their ServiceNow investment
  • Bring customer insights back to product and engineering teams to inform the roadmap and product improvements

Required QualificationsExperience

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience with the ServiceNow platform, with deep expertise in at least two product areas
  • Proven track record designing and implementing enterprise-scale ServiceNow solutions
  • Background in enterprise architecture, including authentication and identity systems, data modeling, REST/SOAP integrations, and security protocols
  • Experience in professional services or consulting roles with demonstrated ability to influence technical strategy

Technical Expertise

  • Product Knowledge: Deep knowledge of multiple ServiceNow product lines and how they share data and workflows across the platform
  • Platform Foundations: Strong understanding of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB), Common Service Data Model (CSDM), and data governance
  • Platform Skills: Advanced proficiency in ServiceNow configuration, JavaScript scripting, Flow Designer, Integration Hub, REST/SOAP integrations, and MID Server architecture
  • Performance and Scale: Experience diagnosing platform performance issues, including integration throughput, scheduled jobs, and database behavior
  • Strong understanding of enterprise workflows, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements
  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) required
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) required
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) in at least two product areas required

Preferred Qualifications

  • ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA)
  • Experience with Now Assist and generative AI capabilities on the ServiceNow platform
  • Experience with AI/ML platforms (Azure AI, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI) and understanding of AI model lifecycle management
  • Experience with ServiceNow upgrade management and release compatibility testing
  • Prior experience supporting NPI launches or beta programs for enterprise software

Consulting & Leadership Skills

raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge is building the intelligence layer for healthcare — and events are central to how we earn trust, build relationships, and drive growth. We're hiring a Senior Event Marketer to own and elevate how we show up in the world.

This is a high-ownership role at the intersection of creative execution and commercial impact. You'll be responsible for the end-to-end planning, logistics, and execution of experiences that bring Abridge's brand values to life — from trade shows to executive forums to owned events. The ideal candidate brings clear structure, meticulous organization, a business-driven mindset, and a genuine passion for building memorable experiences. You'll partner closely with our marketing, creative, sales, revenue operation teams, as well as external vendors and agency partners.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full lifecycle of events — from concept and budget planning through execution and post-event follow-up — across a portfolio of owned and third-party events including trade shows, executive forums, and owned events

  • Partner closely with commercial teams to align programs to account priorities and revenue goals, connecting every experience directly to pipeline outcomes.

  • Build and manage relationships with vendors, agencies, healthcare associations, and industry groups to deliver seamless, high-quality experiences that reflect Abridge's brand.

  • Drive measurement and analytics across events, reporting clearly to senior stakeholders and using insights to continuously sharpen strategy.

  • Support pre- and post-event email campaigns, social media storytelling, and ABM-informed engagement strategies to nurture leads and deepen relationships.

  • Manage multiple programs across markets and timelines with operational rigor and attention to detail — without ever sacrificing quality.

What You'll Bring

  • 6–8 years of event planning experience in a corporate or high-growth startup environment, with a proven track record of exceptional end-to-end execution.

  • Strong commercial mindset — you understand how events drive pipeline and have worked hand-in-hand with sales teams to make it happen.

  • Experience across both owned events and third-party conference strategy, from intimate executive dinners to large-scale conferences.

  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) and executive engagement strategies.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across functions and clearly articulate plans and results.

  • Willingness to travel domestically for events — you're energized by being on the ground, bringing programs to life and building relationships in-market.

  • Background in or passion for healthcare is a plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Hospitality, or related field (or equivalent experience).

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

Enterprise Implementation Services Senior Director

Full Time - Remote

US Midwest and East Coast remote

Travel 35%

Innovate with Benchmark Gensuite as an Enterprise Implementation Services Senior Director

About Benchmark Gensuite

Benchmark Gensuite is a unified, AI-native EHS, Sustainability, and Quality management platform trusted by 20%+ of the Fortune 500 and serving 8 million+ workers globally. Founded by EHS practitioners 25+ years ago, we've built our reputation on deep domain expertise, a 95% subscriber retention rate, and genuine partnership with the safety, environmental, and sustainability leaders we serve. Genny AI, our embedded AI layer, is redefining how enterprise risk and compliance work gets done

The Opportunity

We have historically executed deployment our platform and application solutions as a self-implementer, working together with specialty partners. As we sign larger enterprises, we are expanding our implementation services organization, with clear ownership of professional services, defined roles and skill levels, disciplined scoping and resourcing, accountability and AI-integrated methodologies for delivering on our implementation commitments.

We are hiring an experienced systems implementation leader to design, launch, and run the team that orchestrates the integration, configuration, and delivery of our platform within the client’s environment. This is a founding, and hands-on, leadership role. You will establish the operating model, help set the standards for how implementation work is scoped, priced, staffed, and delivered, and build a small team around it. You will work closely with executive leadership and the broader business to make it real.

What You Will Do

Build the professional services team for systems implementation

  • Define the operating model: service offerings, engagement structure, delivery methodology, governance, and handoffs between New & Expansion Growth, Product, and Customer Success.
  • Set standards and templates for scoping, estimation, staffing, change control, and project close-out, and make sure they are used consistently.
  • Establish clear role definitions, skill levels, and career paths for implementation consultants, project managers, and solution architects.
  • Define the metrics that matter (utilization, margin, schedule and budget variance, scope-change capture, customer satisfaction) and run the business against them.

Own scoping, SOWs, and commercial discipline

  • Partner with New Logo, Expansion Growth, and Finance to structure implementation budgets and SOWs that reflect the true effort required, with realistic assumptions, defined deliverables, and clear exclusions.
  • Establish a disciplined change-order and SOW-amendment process so that scope growth is identified, priced, and approved rather than absorbed.
  • Review and approve scope and pricing for large or complex deals before commitment.

Lead delivery on complex enterprise deployments

  • Serve as director and escalation point for the largest, highest-risk implementations, including multi-module, multi-region, and multi-system programs.
  • Guide solution design, integration approach (ERP, HRIS, IAM, data platforms, and other enterprise systems), data migration, and change management.
  • Hold delivery teams accountable for schedule, budget, quality, and customer outcomes, and resolve issues early.

Build and lead the team

  • Hire and develop a small, high-caliber team, and scale it deliberately as demand grows.
  • Coach delivery leads and consultants, and establish a culture of accountability, craft, and customer focus.
  • Determine the right mix of internal staff and partner or subcontractor capacity, and manage those relationships.

Be a senior voice to customers and the business

  • Engage customer executives and sponsors as a credible system implementation leader, setting expectations and building confidence in our ability to deliver at scale.
  • Provide input to Product and Leadership on what large customers need, and on lessons learned from delivery.
  • Work with Growth leadership to position our implementation capability in strategic pursuits.

What You Bring

Required

  • 12+ years’ experience in consulting, systems implementation, or professional services
  • 5+ years’ experience managing and leading the delivery of professional services in the EHS mgmt. systems and/or EHS digital platforms space.
  • Direct experience building, scaling, or materially reshaping professional services or implementation practices (offerings, methodology, pricing, resourcing, and delivery governance).
  • Strong commercial acumen: you have scoped, priced, and negotiated SOWs, managed change control, and been accountable for engagement margin and profitability.
  • Executive presence, with the ability to earn trust with customer executives, internal leadership, and delivery teams.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days

  • Assess current implementation practices, active engagements, and staffing, and identify the highest-impact gaps and risks.
  • Establish relationships with Strategic Subscriber Collaboration (SSC) team members, Growth, Finance, Product, and Customer Success.
  • Propose the target SI operating model, initial role and skill-level framework, and scoping/SOW standards.

First 6–12 months

  • Measurable improvement in scope capture, delivery predictability, and margin on large deployments.
  • Senior-level ownership of the portfolio of largest, most complex implementations.
  • Operating model, scoping standards, and change-control process in place and consistently applied on new deals.
  • Initial core team hired and onboarded.

Why This Role

  • A rare chance to build a services capability from the ground up with visible executive sponsorship.
  • Real influence with how the company packages, prices, and delivers its work.
  • Meaningful mission: helping organizations protect their people, communities, and the environment.

Questions about the position? Please contact our HR Team, at .

[We show compassion to heal minds.]

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatrists (MD or DO) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

🧰 Qualifications

  • An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation Range: $300K - $500K

raw.description:
Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities:

The successful candidate will be an authoritative voice on sustainable design within the practice, shaping projects from pre-concept through to post-occupancy evaluation. They will embed sustainability principles across all project disciplines, drive certification submissions to successful outcomes.

Sustainability Strategy & Advisory

Define and lead project-specific sustainability strategies tailored to client ambitions, budget constraints, and program requirements at each design stage.
Conduct sustainability workshops, charrettes, and design reviews with multidisciplinary project teams and clients.
Advise on passive design measures including building orientation, massing, façade performance, shading, natural ventilation, and daylighting to minimize mechanical loads.
Develop net-zero carbon roadmaps for projects targeting operational and/or embodied carbon reduction goals.
Conduct embodied carbon assessments (up front carbon, whole-life carbon) using One Click LCA, EC3, or equivalent tools.
Advise on sustainable materials selection, circular economy principles, and responsible sourcing standards (FSC, REACH, EPDs).

Green Building Certifications

Lead and manage certification programs across multiple frameworks: LEED v4/v4.1 (BD+C, ID+C, O+M), Estidama Pearl Rating System (PRS), BREEAM New Construction / In-Use, WELL Building Standard (v2), Fitwel, and GSAS.
Prepare credit documentation, energy calculations, simulation reports, and supporting narratives for submission to certification bodies (USGBC, BRE, IWBI, GORD, UPC).
Track credit status across all active projects, proactively identifying risks and solutions to maintain targeted rating levels.
Liaise with local authority sustainability requirements: DM Green Building Regulations (Dubai), Abu Dhabi ESTIDAMA (UPC), UPDA (Qatar), and MOMRA (KSA).
Manage relationships with certification body reviewers and ensure timely responses to RFIs and reviewer comments.

Energy Modelling & Technical Analysis

Perform whole-building energy modelling using IES VE, DesignBuilder, or eQUEST for LEED/Estidama compliance, ASHRAE 90.1 baseline comparisons, and design optimization.
Conduct parametric studies to evaluate design alternatives: glazing ratios, HVAC system types, building envelope performance, and renewable energy generation.
Carry out daylighting and glare analyses using DIVA-for-Rhino, IES VE, or Radiance to support LEED/WELL daylight credits and occupant comfort strategies.
Assess thermal comfort using PMV/PPD analysis, adaptive comfort models, and outdoor thermal comfort (UTCI, PET) for public realm and outdoor spaces.
Prepare water consumption calculations and water budget models supporting LEED and Estidama water efficiency credits.
Develop renewable energy generation assessments (PV, solar thermal) and advise on on-site and off-site renewable energy procurement strategies.

Environmental & Regulatory Compliance

Prepare Environmental Impact Assessments (EIA) and Environmental Management Plans (EMP) as required by local authority mandates.
Advice on indoor environmental quality (IEQ) strategies: low-VOC materials, ventilation rates, acoustic performance, and biophilic design integration.
Coordinate waste management frameworks, construction waste diversion plans, and operational waste strategies.
Support climate risk and resilience assessments for infrastructure and masterplan projects.

Practice & Business Development
Contribute to business development by preparing technical sustainability proposals, fee estimates, and participating in client interviews.
Represent the firm at sustainability forums, green building council events (USGBC, UKGBC, Emirates Green Building Council), and CPD sessions.
Develop and maintain internal sustainability design guidelines, calculation templates, and credit compliance checklists.
Mentor junior sustainability team members and embed a culture of sustainability across all building services disciplines.

Qualifications : Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or Architecture with a strong sustainability focus.
Master's degree in Sustainable Design, Environmental Engineering, or equivalent is advantageous.
Minimum 8 years of experience in sustainability consultancy, with at least 4 years on projects in the Middle East.
Track record of successfully achieving LEED Gold/Platinum, Estidama 2 Pearl or above, and/or BREEAM Very Good/Excellent on delivered projects.
LEED AP BD+C (USGBC) required; WELL AP, BREEAM AP, or Estidama Accredited Professional are highly desirable.
Chartered status (CEng, CEnv, or equivalent) is preferred.

Technical Skills

Energy modelling: IES VE (advanced proficiency required), DesignBuilder, eQUEST, EnergyPlus.
Daylighting & thermal comfort: DIVA-for-Rhino, Climate Consultant, Ladybug Tools (Grasshopper/Rhino).
Embodied carbon: One Click LCA, EC3 (Building Transparency), Tally.
Certification portals: LEED Online, Arc platform, BREEAM Online, Estidama Pearl portal, Fitwel portal.
BIM familiarity: Revit (sustainability data extraction), Navisworks; AutoCAD.
Advanced MS Excel (energy dashboards, data analysis), PowerPoint (stakeholder presentations).

raw.description:
Kraus Hamdani Aerospace (KHA) is an aerospace company specializing in long-endurance unmanned aerial platforms for a wide variety of industries. KHA supports a number of customers to carry out missions involving aerial reconnaissance, survey, communication relay and communications provisioning. Endurance, enabled by effective design, is key to these applications and KHA aircraft utilize cutting-edge aircraft design together with on-board intelligence to deliver value for these customers.

Kraus Hamdani Aerospace develops autonomous unmanned aircraft systems that provide persistent aerial intelligence and communications for defense, public safety, and commercial missions.

The Senior Program Manager owns delivery of assigned customer programs, from proposal planning and contract award through development, production, fielding, sustainment, and closeout. This hands-on leader is accountable for scope, schedule, cost, risk, and customer commitments, translating mission needs into executable plans and coordinating teams across Engineering, Production, Operations, Finance, and Client Success.

Work Location & Travel

This is a remote position requiring up to 25% travel to support customer engagements, program execution, and company operations.

Key responsibilities

  • PMO Development & Governance: Establish, implement, and mature the company’s Program Management Office (PMO) while concurrently managing assigned programs; develop standardized program management processes, governance, reporting, and tools to drive accountability, cross-functional alignment, predictable execution, and on-time delivery across the organization.

  • Project Manager Development & Mentorship: Train, mentor, and develop junior Project Managers by providing hands-on coaching, establishing standardized project management practices, and reinforcing best practices in planning, scheduling, risk management, stakeholder communication, and execution. Build organizational project management competency through structured training, performance feedback, and progressive delegation of responsibilities to develop a capable, accountable, and self-sufficient project management team aligned with PMO standards.

  • Lead one or more complex programs, establishing integrated schedules, budgets, milestones, deliverables, acceptance criteria, and clear ownership across functional teams.

  • Manage, train, and mentor individual Project Managers. Set clear priorities and performance expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, and develop their skills in planning, financial management, risk mitigation, and customer communication.

  • Partner with Business Development and Solutions Engineering on proposals, rough-order-of-magnitude estimates, execution assumptions, and achievable customer commitments; lead the transition from award into execution.

  • Translate contract requirements into coordinated engineering, production, test, and delivery plans. Align technical configurations, dependencies, and readiness criteria with Engineering and Operations leaders.

  • Own program financial performance with Finance, including budgets, actual costs, resource forecasts, estimates at completion, and margin risks. Develop recovery plans when performance deviates.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for program execution. Lead customer reviews, communicate progress and risks candidly, and drive resolution of delivery issues.

  • Control scope and changes with Contracts and Finance. Assess cost, schedule, resource, and technical impacts and obtain required approvals before changing commitments.

  • Coordinate deployment readiness with Operations, including staffing, training, aircraft and equipment availability, subcontractor support, logistics, and sustainment requirements.

  • Manage supplier and subcontractor deliverables with functional owners, tracking dependencies, quality, schedule, and corrective actions that affect customer commitments.

  • Maintain program risks, issues, decisions, and action plans. Escalate material concerns early with clear options, recommendations, and resource tradeoffs for leadership.

  • Track contractual reporting, customer acceptance, and billing milestones. Coordinate applicable security, export, quality, and operational requirements with accountable specialists.

  • Build practical program management processes and capture lessons learned. Coordinate handoffs to Client Success and support through the warranty period.

Required qualifications

  • Eight or more years of relevant program or project management experience, including at least three years leading complex technical programs across multiple functions.

  • Demonstrated delivery of aerospace, defense, unmanned systems, robotics, or comparable hardware and software programs from planning through customer acceptance.

  • Experience managing program budgets, forecasts, integrated schedules, contractual deliverables, risks, and changes; able to connect execution decisions to financial outcomes.

  • Ability to lead through influence, resolve competing priorities, and secure commitments from functional teams in a growing organization.

  • Strong customer-facing communication and executive briefing skills, including the ability to explain technical tradeoffs and escalate issues with actionable recommendations.

  • Working knowledge of engineering development, systems integration, verification and validation, manufacturing, and field operations.

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, business, program management, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional or military experience.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with unmanned aircraft, autonomy, intelligence and surveillance systems, payload integration, or airborne communications.

  • Experience supporting U.S. government or international defense customers, including product deliveries and contractor-operated services.

  • Familiarity with government contracting, subcontract management, and applicable export or security requirements.

  • PMP certification or equivalent training; experience introducing practical program controls and reporting in a scaling company.

What success looks like

  • Customer commitments are met against approved scope, schedule, cost, and acceptance criteria.

  • Leadership receives accurate forecasts, timely risk escalation, and clear decisions needed to keep programs on track.

  • Engineering, Production, and Operations work from coordinated plans with realistic resource requirements and accountable owners.

  • Customers receive operationally ready capabilities, responsive issue resolution, and a clear transition into ongoing support.

Kraus Hamdani Aerospace, Inc. (“Company”) collects and uses Personal Information (as defined by the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018 (“CCPA”)) for human resources, employment, health and safety, and business-related purposes and to be in legal compliance. For more information, please read the full notice.

raw.description:
Role Description

As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

Responsibilities

  • Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment.
  • Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation.
  • Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues.
  • Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate.
  • Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment.
  • Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity.
  • Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team.

Requirements

  • Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration.
  • Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies.
  • Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health.
  • Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery.
  • Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations.
  • Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift.
  • Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Production experience with FleetDM on Windows, including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps.
  • Practical osquery and SQL experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code or declarative configuration, continuous integration and delivery, and migration or coexistence between endpoint-management platforms.
  • Experience with Automox, Patch My PC, or comparable tools, and with endpoint privilege management, application control, encryption, or other security controls.
  • Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments and contributing reusable automation across Windows, macOS, or Linux.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability:Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection:Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog postfrom our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Compensation

$125,000—$170,000 CAD

raw.description:
AlphaGov is seeking a Hazard Mitigation Planner to lead a multi-jurisdictional hazard mitigation plan update, including HAZUS risk modeling. You will coordinate participating communities, assess hazard exposure, and develop mitigation priorities that local governments can carry forward into implementation.

This engagement requires someone who can manage the planning process, perform or direct the technical analysis, and produce a complete plan for state and FEMA review.

What you’ll do

  • Review the existing mitigation plan, prior review comments, available hazard data, and progress on mitigation actions.
  • Coordinate participating jurisdictions, planning committee meetings, stakeholder interviews, and public engagement.
  • Update hazard profiles, vulnerability assessments, and community capability assessments.
  • Use HAZUS and GIS to evaluate exposure and potential losses for applicable hazards, documenting data sources, assumptions, and limitations.
  • Assess risks to people, buildings, critical facilities, and infrastructure.
  • Develop and prioritize mitigation actions with jurisdiction-specific responsibilities, potential funding sources, and implementation timelines.
  • Write the updated plan and establish procedures for monitoring progress and maintaining it.
  • Address state and FEMA review comments and support participating jurisdictions through adoption and approval.

Requirements

  • Direct experience leading FEMA multi-jurisdictional hazard mitigation plan updates.
  • Hands-on experience using HAZUS for risk assessment and loss estimation.
  • Strong GIS, data analysis, and technical writing skills.
  • Experience coordinating local governments, emergency management agencies, and community stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate technical risk findings into practical mitigation actions.
  • Experience supporting plans through state review, FEMA review, and local adoption.

Certified Floodplain Manager (CFM) certification is preferred. Applicants should clearly identify their HAZUS experience and current professional certifications.

Benefits

Submit your résumé and a brief summary of relevant hazard mitigation planning engagements. Include the jurisdictions involved, your role, the HAZUS analyses completed, and the plans’ approval status.

About JustFoodForDogs:

JustFoodForDogs, the #1 vet recommended fresh food for dogs, is dedicated to helping pets live longer, healthier lives through real, whole-food nutrition. Founded in 2010, JustFoodForDogs revolutionized the fresh whole food movement for dogs when it opened the first open-to-the-public kitchen cooking food for dogs. All of our recipes are formulated by veterinarians and made with 100% human-grade ingredients. Today, consumers can find JustFoodForDogs at JustFoodForDogs retail locations, their favorite retailers and on-line at JustFoodForDogs.com. The company’s offerings include daily meals, shelf-stable products, supplements, and treats. To learn more about JustFoodForDogs, visit JustFoodForDogs.com

We’re looking for a talented Graphic Designer to help bring the JustFoodForDogs brand to life across digital and retail experiences. Reporting to the Creative Director and collaborating closely with our Senior Graphic Designer, you’ll turn creative concepts into compelling designs across social, email, web, print, and in-store environments. You’ll work alongside our marketing, retail, ecommerce and creative teams, with the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on how our brand shows up at every touchpoint.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Digital Design: Create graphics for social media, email, web, and paid ads.

raw.description:
About Smith.ai

Smith.ai runs end-to-end intake for law firms, combining AI efficiency with a network of more than 500 live, North America-based agents. Intake is a sales funnel, and most law firms aren't running it well. Smith.ai exists to fix that. We ensure every call is answered, every lead is qualified, and every opportunity that should convert, does. Built on more than 30 million calls and a decade of experience with over 4,000 small to mid-sized law firm clients, Smith.ai helps firms win more clients.

We're a lean, profitable-minded team going deep on the legal vertical, and everything we build and market is with that lens. This is a high-impact, high-ownership role for someone who moves fast, cares deeply about clients, and wants to build a Client Success function that drives meaningful retention, expansion, and long-term client relationships.

The Role

We're looking for a Manager, Client Success who cares deeply about clients, builds high-performing teams, and takes ownership of outcomes. Your goal is straightforward, even if the work to get there isn't: ensure our clients see Smith.ai as a critical partner in their business success. Success is measured by retention and expansion, and everything you build, lead, and execute should support those outcomes.

You'll own a meaningful segment of our client book, lead and develop a dedicated Client Success team, and personally manage relationships with high-value clients. You'll also work closely with leaders across Client Onboarding and Client Support, sharing accountability for the full client journey from day one through renewal and beyond.

As our customer base continues to grow, we're evolving how we segment and support clients based on their complexity and strategic value. You'll play a key role in shaping that approach, building scalable processes, and ensuring our team delivers an exceptional client experience.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-moving, growth-stage environment where clarity isn't always given and building is just as important as executing. You can think strategically, but you're equally comfortable rolling up your sleeves. You make decisions, seek feedback, and course-correct quickly. You're direct but collaborative, confident but open to being challenged, and energized by the opportunity to build something better.

What You'll Do

  • Client Retention & Expansion

    • Own retention and expansion outcomes for a defined segment of our client base, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen relationships and grow accounts.

    • Personally manage relationships with high-value clients, ensuring Smith.ai is delivering meaningful business value and operating as a trusted partner.

    • Identify at-risk accounts, understand the underlying drivers of churn, and develop strategies to improve client health and long-term retention.

    • Partner closely with Sales to ensure seamless handoffs and identify opportunities for account growth.

  • Team Leadership & Development

    • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing Client Success team, setting clear expectations and holding a high bar for performance and client outcomes.

    • Coach team members through complex client situations, helping them strengthen their judgment, communication, and account management skills.

    • Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement, where feedback flows in every direction.

    • Hire and develop talent with an equal focus on skills, performance, and values.

  • Client Success Strategy & Operations

    • Build, refine, and maintain scalable playbooks for key client scenarios, including onboarding transitions, account health management, escalations, renewals, and expansion.

    • Help shape how we segment and support clients based on complexity, business needs, and strategic value.

    • Identify gaps in the client experience and take ownership of improving the processes, tools, and workflows that address them.

    • Balance immediate client needs with longer-term operational improvements that allow the team to scale effectively.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership

    • Work closely with the Senior Manager of Client Onboarding and Senior Manager of Client Support within a shared leadership structure, ensuring a consistent and coordinated experience across the client journey.

    • Partner with Sales, Product, and Operations to surface client feedback, resolve recurring challenges, and improve the overall client experience.

    • Navigate complex client and organizational situations with sound judgment, clear communication, and a bias toward action.

  • Data, Insights & Performance

    • Use client success tooling and data to monitor retention, expansion, client health, sentiment, and team performance.

    • Translate data into actionable insights, identifying trends, surfacing risks, and prioritizing improvements.

    • Establish clear performance expectations and use metrics to drive accountability and continuous improvement.

    • Leverage Vitally and other tools to improve visibility, consistency, and effectiveness across the Client Success function.

Characteristics

Must-Haves

  • 5+ years of experience in Client Success or Account Management, including experience in a SaaS or technical product environment.

  • 2+ years of experience managing and developing teams, with a demonstrated ability to coach talent, drive accountability, and improve performance.

  • 2+ years of direct experience driving retention and expansion revenue within an existing client base.

  • Proven experience building or meaningfully improving Client Success playbooks, processes, and decision frameworks.

  • Strong business judgment and a genuine client-first mindset. You understand how to balance client needs with the long-term success of the business.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You can navigate a difficult client conversation, coach a team member, and communicate a clear plan across departments.

  • Highly analytical and comfortable using data to identify trends, assess risk, and make decisions.

  • A bias toward action. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, taking ownership, and adjusting quickly based on feedback.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and energized by the scrappiness of a growing company.

  • A collaborative leadership style. You bring conviction to your ideas while remaining open to feedback and different perspectives.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Vitally or comparable Client Success platforms such as Gainsight or ChurnZero.

  • Experience supporting SMB clients at scale, particularly across a segmented client portfolio.

  • Familiarity with legal technology or professional services businesses.

  • Experience helping build or evolve a Client Success function in an early- or growth-stage company.

What Success Looks Like

  • First 30 days: You've built trust with your team and cross-functional partners, developed a strong understanding of our client base, and started identifying the biggest opportunities to improve retention and the client experience.

  • First 60 days: You've taken ownership of your high-value client relationships, identified meaningful gaps in our processes or client engagement strategy, and begun implementing solutions.

  • First 90 days: You're operating with full ownership of your team and client segment, have implemented at least one meaningful process improvement, and have a clear plan for driving retention and expansion.

  • Year One: You've made a measurable impact on reducing churn and increasing expansion, built a stronger and more effective Client Success team, and established scalable processes that improve the experience for our clients. Your peers, direct reports, and leader can all point to the impact you've made.

Life at Smith.ai

Here at Smith.ai, we’re laser-focused on our mission of helping small and medium businesses succeed. We strive to test, learn, and improve, while continuously developing our solutions, our operations, and our team members. We’re a fast-growing and dynamic startup that values collaboration and innovative thinking. We are an equal opportunity employer and believe diversity makes teams better and that discrimination based on race, gender, or anything else is self-defeating.

This is a full-time position with a base salary that ranges between $110,000-$165,000 per year. In addition to salary, you are eligible for equity and a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401k, and a Flexible Time Off program.

Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking researchers for our real-time information team. You see the opportunity in generating alpha from real-time events. You possess a rational aptitude for interpreting how news originates, disseminates, and affects prices. You are a strategic thinker who can distinguish signal from noise. You have a growth mindset and consistently become faster and smarter. You have potential or credentials at software development or math.

Responsibilities

  • Basic science - Identify market-moving news signals by observation and querying of news and market data.
  • Historical analysis - Catalog, study, and model the market impact of news signals.
  • Scheduled event focus - Create calendar of important events, watch them live.
  • Real-Time monitoring - Watch newsfeeds and alert traders/researchers to time-sensitive updates.
  • Manage automated news alerts - Backtest, stress-test, and deploy high precision/recall automated alerts for themes of interest. Then, pay attention to changing market conditions and update as necessary.
  • Develop market competence - Internalize context and pricing for liquid crypto assets

Requirements

  • Degree in a related field (finance, engineering, math, social science with a concentration on economics/finance), or demonstrable fluency in same
  • Experience using news platforms such as X Pro, Bloomberg Terminal, discord/telegram chats, etc
  • Serious ambition to play a high-stakes, ultra-competitive game

Operational & Communication Skills:

  • Attention to detail
  • Reliability
  • Ability to articulate key insights quickly

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. Phone Interview – A discussion with the Head of HR to better understand your background, career motivations, and overall alignment.
  3. First Interview – Interview with our Senior RTI Researcher on your experience, motivation, and general technical knowledge.
  4. Second Interview – Interview with the broader RTI Research & Engineering team, with a deeper focus on technical skills and role fit.
  5. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

raw.excerpt: Welcome to DechraDechra is an international veterinary pharmaceutical business focused on specialty products.
raw.description:
Welcome to Dechra

Dechra is an international veterinary pharmaceutical business focused on specialty products. We develop, manufacture, sell and market high-quality products exclusively for veterinarians around the world.

Job Purpose

The Regulatory Affairs Senior Principal Scientist leads and delivers thoughtful, forward-looking regulatory strategies for the clinical safety and efficacy of traditional small-molecule drugs and large-molecule biotherapeutics, including monoclonal antibodies and other complex biologics, in the US.

This role identifies regulatory opportunities and risks early, develops strategic options and helps ensure regulatory pathways support successful and timely product development across all US programs.

The role may also represent Global RA on project teams and work with regional RA teams to support a global registration strategy. In addition, the Senior Principal Scientist mentors junior members of the US Innovation Regulatory Affairs team, helping them build technical regulatory skills in clinical safety and efficacy.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, lead, and deliver innovative, risk‑based regulatory strategies for drugs and biotherapeutics (e.g., monoclonal antibodies, protein therapeutics).
  • Identify regulatory risks and opportunities early and develop strategic options to address or make the most of them throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Provide scientific and regulatory guidance to cross‑functional project teams, supporting strategic decisions, regulatory readiness and continued development of regulatory expertise.
  • Represent the US region on cross‑functional drug and biotherapeutic development teams and help ensure alignment with US regulatory expectations.
  • Prepare, review, or oversee regulatory documents, including pre-submission conference requests, protocol concurrences, and Effectiveness and Target Animal Safety technical sections, helping the US Innovation RA team maintain consistent, high standards.
  • Work directly with FDA CVM/USDA CVB to discuss and agree on development pathways, protocol concurrence, labeling text and product approval.
  • Keep up to date with changing US and global drug and biotherapeutic legislation and share clear, strategic insights with senior stakeholders.
  • Represent Dechra on relevant external committees, working groups and trade associations for drugs and biotherapeutics, contributing to agency guidance and regulatory policy.
  • Provide senior-level scientific and regulatory leadership to Clinical, CMC, Safety and DRD/Biotherapeutics Development teams.
  • Serve as Global RA representative when assigned, helping ensure alignment with EU, US, and international SMEs.

Skills & Experience

  • University degree (BS, MS, PhD, DVM/VMD) in veterinary medicine, animal sciences, or a related life science discipline.
  • DVM/VMD is preferred. Candidates with other backgrounds (BS, MS, PhD) may also be considered if they have relevant animal health experience.
  • Extensive experience in animal health pharmaceutical regulatory affairs, including supporting product development, with some experience focused on safety and efficacy.
  • Demonstrated proficiency and hands-on experience with regulatory submissions and approvals, from new product development through commercialization.
  • Proven experience leading regulatory submissions for small and large‑molecule biopharmaceutical products in the US.
  • Demonstrated success obtaining approvals or advancing drug and biopharmaceutical products through FDA CVM/USDA CVB submissions.
  • Strong understanding of US clinical and safety requirements for drug and biopharmaceutical products.
  • Experience interacting directly with regulatory authorities.
  • Proven success in achieving objectives comparable to those of this position.

Ability to travel (domestic/international) approximately 10-20%.
