raw.description:
Job Summary:

As General Manager, Industrial Products & Services (IPS), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s business across Automotive, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Chemical, and Logistics clients, with full P&L and budget authority. You will identify where we can win, decide where to invest, and build the team and client relationships to deliver sustained growth. Your mandate covers winning new enterprise clients, expanding existing relationships, and increasing the value clients receive from Toptal’s capabilities.

You will bring a clear perspective on the challenges facing potential clients and where Toptal can help. Working with our Services leaders and subject matter experts, you will translate those challenges into viable sales proposals across our AI solutions, managed services, management consultancy, and talent offerings. You will choose which markets, accounts, and opportunities to pursue, allocate resources accordingly, and give your team a focused plan.

You will lead from the front: personally leading executive client conversations, shaping proposals, working through difficult commercial negotiations, and helping close critical pursuits. Your team should see the selling standard you expect in your own work. You will understand what is driving performance, where growth is constrained, and what needs to change.

You will build on established enterprise relationships to expand the problems clients trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Set and execute the industry strategy. Identify the markets, client problems, and offerings with the strongest growth potential. Build an IPS business plan with clear priorities, financial objectives, and investment decisions. Test your assumptions with clients and adjust the plan as evidence changes.
  • Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Set and manage the budget, allocate resources, and evaluate returns on investments in people and growth initiatives. Understand how pricing, delivery economics, retention, and portfolio mix affect results, and act when performance diverges from the plan. Win new enterprise clients. Lead your team in pursuing priority accounts. Develop a credible reason for each client to engage with Toptal, build relationships with decision-makers, and personally advance important opportunities through discovery, solution development, negotiation, and close.
  • Expand and retain client relationships. Work with Client Partners to understand client priorities, broaden relationships across buying centers, and develop opportunities across Toptal’s portfolio. Stay close to important engagements, resolve concerns with the responsible teams, and turn successful outcomes into further business.
  • Make account planning actionable. Establish clear priorities and ownership. Expect your team to explain why an account matters, whom they need to engage, what opportunity they are pursuing, and how they will create progress. Ensure priority accounts receive sustained attention.
  • Bring the right expertise into the sale. Work with Services leaders, solution architects, and specialists to diagnose needs and develop credible proposals across services, AI-based solutions, and talent. Coordinate with supporting functions to resolve obstacles and keep opportunities moving toward a decision.
  • Maintain a credible forecast. Challenge the evidence behind opportunity values, close dates, and expected revenue. Understand the assumptions connecting pipeline to the financial plan, identify risks early, and take specific action to address shortfalls.
  • Build and develop the team. Recruit strong commercial talent, set clear expectations, and coach people through real client situations. Review calls, account plans, and active pursuits; demonstrate stronger approaches and follow through on improvements. Address underperformance promptly and develop future leaders.
  • Accomplish work objectives through leading and supervising other Toptal team members on the Industrial Products and Services team.
  • Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team’s structure and jobs, and organize, assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work.
  • Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans, if needed.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, sales process, and client value proposition.
  • Meet your team and the leaders whose functions support the IPS business.
  • Begin reviewing the client portfolio, active opportunities, P&L, budget, and growth priorities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Meet priority clients and develop an informed view of their needs, our relationships, and the opportunities ahead.
  • Assess the team’s capabilities and identify immediate coaching, performance, and hiring priorities.
  • Establish a consistent rhythm for account planning, opportunity reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching.

  • Manage the P&L against the budget, address material variances, and refine investment priorities using evidence from sales and delivery outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Deliver against the agreed IPS revenue, profitability, and budget objectives.
  • Have built a stronger team with clear accountability, consistent execution, and emerging leadership capability.
  • Demonstrate deeper client relationships and broader adoption of Toptal’s services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities.
  • Present the next stage of the industry business plan, including the investments required to sustain profitable growth.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of proven success leading professional services sales teams specifically in Industrial Products and Services, with in-depth experience in the Energy Sector, specifically Oil & Gas is required.
  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience running and managing an industry business unit with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.
  • Deep industry relationships ranging from director-level to C-level contacts is expected.
  • A sustained record of leading enterprise SaaS or services sales teams, winning new clients, and expanding existing relationships. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to those results.
  • Industry expertise and demonstrated sales experience in at least one of Oil & Gas, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, or Defense & Aerospace.
  • Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, hiring, investment, and account priorities affected revenue, margin, and profitability.
  • Experience closing complex enterprise opportunities, including shaping a business case, coordinating technical expertise, navigating procurement, and negotiating commercial agreements.
  • Strong industry relationships and a record of earning access to senior decision-makers through relevant insight and demonstrated value.
  • Evidence of hiring strong sellers, improving individual and team performance through specific coaching, and developing future leaders.
  • Disciplined qualification and forecasting skills. You distinguish client interest from a credible buying process, assess the evidence behind a forecast, and act when an opportunity loses momentum.
  • Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently and recognize when deeper specialist expertise is needed.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex client problem into a compelling proposal and explain business performance without obscuring the issues.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.

The Opportunity

If you're a compensation professional who thrives on analysis, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you. Bring your expertise, curiosity, and strategic mindset to a role where your contributions will directly influence enterprise-wide compensation programs and talent strategies.

We are seeking a Senior Compensation Analyst to help shape and administer compensation programs that attract, motivate, and retain talent. In this highly analytical and consultative role, you will evaluate jobs, interpret market data, support salary structures and incentive plans, and deliver recommendations that promote competitive pay, internal equity, and a strong pay-for-performance culture. Working with limited supervision, you will apply advanced compensation knowledge to complex assignments, advise business partners, and contribute to enterprise-wide initiatives. This is an opportunity to turn data into meaningful insights and influence compensation decisions across the organization. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  • Serving as a key advisor in compensation decision-making by evaluating roles, analyzing market trends, and delivering data-driven insights that support competitive and equitable pay practices. Partner with Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, managers, and business leaders to provide recommendations on compensation actions, including base pay, promotions, market adjustments, and incentive awards. Leverage workforce and market data to identify opportunities, anticipate risks, and support strategic talent decisions.
  • Helping to shape and enhance compensation programs that align with business objectives, market competitiveness, and pay-for-performance principles. Support the ongoing administration and improvement of salary structures, pay ranges, incentive programs, job descriptions, and job architecture frameworks. Participate in compensation surveys and external benchmarking efforts while promoting consistent job leveling and compensation practices across the organization.
  • Playing an active role in annual compensation planning activities, including merit increases, promotions, market adjustments, and incentive planning. Develop meaningful analyses, reports, and presentations that inform compensation strategies and leadership decisions. Contribute to high-impact initiatives such as compensation program enhancements, job architecture projects, organizational changes, and merger and acquisition integration efforts.
  • Supporting the integrity and effectiveness of compensation programs by helping ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, as well as company policies. Serve as a resource for stakeholders by providing guidance, education, and support on compensation programs, processes, and best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least seven years of experience administering compensation programs and practices.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications is required, along with the ability to analyze, interpret, and present data effectively. The successful candidate will bring a strong analytical and data-driven approach, with knowledge of compensation reporting, workforce analytics, and market data analysis.
  • This role requires the ability to identify trends, draw meaningful conclusions, and develop recommendations for senior leadership. Strong organizational and project management skills are essential, including the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and successfully execute concurrent assignments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required, along with strong consultative, interpersonal, and relationship-building abilities. The successful candidate must be able to explain complex information clearly and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with job architecture, job evaluation, or career framework design is preferred. A professional compensation certification is also preferred.

This position will provide guidance and oversight of technology systems ensuring the IT systems are managed, controlled, and optimized with client’s specific needs.

This individual will act as the Resultant expert – ensuring client technology roadmaps are built and followed, that the work their team performs adheres to Resultant mission and values, and to support Resultant’s holistic approach to client service. You will help to manage and deliver assigned operational and project commitments to clients, utilizing the entire client team as necessary and as assigned by the VP of Client Success. Primarily, you will serve as the sole point of contact for your respective clients ensuring quality delivery as both a trusted advisor and point of escalation when their most important initiatives call for it.

  • Be a confidential support to clients on any challenging realities they face around people, processes or technology, with the intent of helping them overcome these challenges through creative techniques
  • Participate in sales calls, write proposals, and close opportunities for new work and expansion of existing clients

  • Provide amazing support to our clients, greatly exceeding their experience of what anyone else has ever done for them

This is a remote role with expected travel to client sites approximately 10-15% of the time. The position also includes periodic off-hours availability for client support.

  • 4+ years of experience in IT service delivery

Some of the skills we are expecting are:

  • Ability to explain just about anything technical to anyone, regardless of their background
  • Experience working in a dynamic IT environment and working on IT projects
  • Knowledge of project management in relation to the delivery of IT services
  • Ability to develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
  • Experience working with proposals for new business
  • Demonstrated ability working in a teaming/collaborative environment
  • Experience solutioning and selling additional services and projects to current clients
  • Experience with and understanding of the managed services industry with a history of roles outside of client success is preferred
  • Experience working with SMB and mid-market clients

While this position is not primarily technical, it is expected that a candidate will have familiarity with the following technologies:

  • Servers: Active Directory, Domain, SSL Certificate, Backups, Antivirus
  • Cloud: Azure, Office 365, AWS, Google

  • Identity management solutions
  • Experience with creating documentation and reports using MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Experience working and communicating with hardware and software vendors for maintenance/repair/upgrade/license management
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools and software deployment

What you should know about Resultant:

  • Rezzers are humble, hungry, and smart. We solve big problems, serve lots of clients, and are entirely committed to delivering transformative outcomes.
  • Rezzers are team players, deeply dedicated to the mission of the organization and to helping everyone around us be successful.

  • We have a great benefits package including unlimited vacation, significant 401k contributions, and several opportunities to develop yourself.
  • We pride ourselves in having the best talent in the industry and hope that you’re up for the challenge!

What our team members say about us…

  • “I love our true empathy and concern for our clients, it's very rare and appreciated. It is a pleasure to be a part of an organization like Resultant.”
  • “I learn something new every single day, and I feel like I'm a part of building an organization that has legs. I appreciate that I'm consistently humbled by the talent and caliber of our team.”

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status.

Equal Opportunity Employer

What matters to us is getting to know the real you — how you think, how you communicate, and what you genuinely bring to the table. Our interviews are designed to go deeper than any polished answer, so come curious and come as yourself without the support of an AI tool during our conversation.

Resultant is an outcomes-focused consulting firm committed to helping clients make technology a strategic asset and use data to guide better decisions. [We show compassion to heal minds.]

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatrists (MD or DO) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

🧰 Qualifications

  • An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Job Title: SNAP EBT Planning Consultant

Work Arrangement: Remote

Location: Remote, United States

Employment Type: Contract (approximately 29 months, starting on or about January 1, 2027)

Engagement Type: W-2 or 1099 ($40 to $50 per hour)

Final Interview:

Position Summary

Dhaka Technologies Limited Company is hiring a SNAP EBT Planning Consultant on behalf of its client, a state human services agency. The consultant will guide the agency through the re-procurement of its Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP) Electronic Benefits Transfer (EBT) services, from updating the EBT services RFP and preparing the federal Advance Planning Documents, through the evaluation of vendor responses, to acceptance testing of the new EBT system. The consultant will build and maintain the project timeline, keep every activity on track with U.S. Department of Agriculture, Food and Nutrition Service (USDA FNS) deadlines, and work closely with agency leadership, the state evaluation team, FNS and the EBT processor. The engagement is expected to run approximately 29 months, starting on or about January 1, 2027.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the project timeline for the EBT re-procurement and make sure all activities meet USDA FNS deadlines.
  • Review the agency's SNAP EBT Services RFP and prepare updated drafts that address current federal requirements, including SNAP EBT regulations, FNS policy guidance and procedures, provisions of the Agricultural Act of 2018 and later amendments, and industry technical standards such as the Quest Operating Rules applicable to SNAP.
  • Research and document the state's business and technical requirements and build them into the RFP.
  • Take part in project calls with USDA FNS on the re-procurement RFP and the Advance Planning Document, and help the agency evaluate and implement FNS recommendations and changes.
  • Develop the plan the agency's team will use to evaluate RFP responses, including technical and cost evaluation criteria, the pricing evaluation structure, and scoring guidelines aligned with the state's statutory RFP evaluation criteria.
  • Prepare training materials, train the evaluation team on the evaluation tools (on site or virtually), and compile scores and summary documents that support the final award decision.
  • Develop and submit for FNS approval the Implementation Advance Planning Document (IAPD), and IAPD Updates (IAPDU) as needed, in line with the current FNS Handbook 901 and all applicable federal regulations. This includes the transmittal letter, executive summary, functional requirements, general system design, capacity study, project management plan and resource requirements, security planning, training plan, schedule of activities, milestones and deliverables, cost allocation plan, and proposed budget.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Test Plan, following FNS Handbook 901, Section 3.5.24, that defines the testing types (unit, integration, performance, end-to-end, user acceptance, regression and fail-safe testing), test team roles and responsibilities, test databases, test cases and scripts, the test schedule, acceptance testing procedures, Go/No-Go criteria, and contingency plans to revert to the legacy system.
  • Manage all testing processes and coordinate testing activities with the EBT processor to confirm the system meets program requirements, design specifications, performance standards, usability expectations, capacity demands and security requirements.
  • Lead System Acceptance Testing (SAT) covering functional requirements, security, recovery, system controls and what-if scenarios; prepare all SAT documents, scenarios and evaluation materials; review specifications, interface specifications and outputs; provide written comments; attend tests and test result walk-throughs; and take part in regression testing.
  • Train state staff to perform user acceptance testing.
  • Evaluate the overall completeness and results of testing, and prepare the written evaluation of test results for FNS review and approval.

Required Qualifications

  • 10 or more years of experience in consulting, program management or procurement for state human services, public benefits or health and human services information systems.
  • Direct experience with SNAP EBT (or WIC EBT) services for a state agency, including at least one EBT procurement, re-procurement or processor conversion.
  • Working knowledge of federal SNAP EBT requirements, including 7 CFR Part 274, FNS policy guidance, the Agricultural Act of 2018 and the Quest Operating Rules.
  • Experience preparing federal Advance Planning Documents (IAPD or IAPDU) under FNS Handbook 901, or comparable federal Advance Planning Documents for state human services systems.
  • Experience writing or rewriting state government RFPs and designing proposal evaluation criteria, scoring tools and evaluator training.
  • Experience leading system or user acceptance testing for a state system, including test plans, test scripts, Go/No-Go criteria and written evaluations of test results.
  • Excellent writing skills and the ability to produce clear, federally compliant documents.
  • No current employment with, or contract to, an EBT processor.
  • Available for the full engagement, starting on or about January 1, 2027.
  • Three professional references from previous engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting an EBT processor transition, including card issuance, retailer integration and conversion planning.
  • Familiarity with eWIC, Summer EBT or other EBT-delivered benefit programs.
  • Experience working directly with FNS regional office staff.
  • Experience with state cost allocation plans and federal financial participation.
  • Experience with Medicaid Enterprise System (MMIS) procurements or CMS Advance Planning Documents.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.

How to Apply

Send your updated resume and three professional references (name, title, organization, phone number and email address) to with "SNAP EBT Planning Consultant" in the subject line. Please include your current location and your availability to start on or about January 1, 2027.

Senior Paid Search Manager (Remote)

If you’re the person other PPC managers call when an account is stuck, keep reading.

Bullseye Strategy is a fully remote digital marketing agency serving luxury real estate, travel, B2B, and restaurant brands. We’re growing fast and need a paid search expert who can hit the ground running and doesn’t need to be managed, just supported.

You’re a fit if:

  • You have 10+ years of strategic and day-to-day paid search management, handling 5+ client accounts at a time
  • You have 8+ years of experience inside a digital marketing agency
  • You’ve managed monthly budgets ranging from $5,000 to $1M and know how to make every dollar work at both ends
  • You know that great strategy and disciplined daily optimization are what drive results, and you’re equally strong at both
  • You can step into existing accounts, get your bearings fast, and be contributing by day three
  • You understand your job is to make your clients successful, which is how our agency succeeds
  • You measure your day by results, not hours on a clock
  • People in the industry consider you top of your game in paid search, and you have the account results to prove it

What you’ll own:

  • Full strategy and execution across Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, and other paid platforms
  • Budget pacing, bidding, and optimization tied to client ROI
  • Clear, confident performance reporting and recommendations clients act on

This role is not for you if:

  • You are early or mid-career in paid search
  • Your experience is mostly in-house or with a single brand
  • You need step-by-step direction to build and run campaigns
  • You need weeks of training before you’re ready to take on accounts

Location: Remote. We are only hiring in the Eastern and Central time zones.

Benefits: Health, vision, HSA, FSA, 401(k) matching, unlimited PTO, and professional development assistance.

Salary: $85,000 – $100,000 / year

raw.description:
Adlib Software | North America, remote | Full time | Reports to the Chief Commercial Officer

About Adlib

Adlib is the document-to-decision engine for regulated industries. Our AI agents turn the documents and emails work arrives as into accurate, auditable decisions, with every value traced to its source. In September 2026 Adlib acquired Paperbox, the mail-to-decision engine for insurance, trusted by more than 100 European insurers. Together we serve a global customer base across insurance and other regulated industries, backed by Diversis Capital.

The role

We are hiring a VP, Global Marketing to lead marketing across North America and Europe. You will own marketing-sourced pipeline for insurance and marketing’s retention and expansion targets for our installed base, lead the brand through the next phase of the company’s evolution, and build the North American demand engine on a proven European playbook. You are quantitative and data driven: every program has a number, every dollar has a return. You will run an AI-powered marketing function, using the latest AI tools across content, campaigns, outbound and operations, and bring creative energy to a category where most vendors sound the same. You will lead a senior team spanning marketing operations, field marketing in North America and Europe, and GTM engineering, and partner closely with Sales, Product and Customer Success.

What you will do

  • Pipeline: own marketing-sourced pipeline, coverage and conversion targets for insurance, globally
  • Installed base: own marketing’s retention and expansion targets for customers outside insurance; customer, partner and lifecycle marketing that supports renewal and growth
  • North America: build the demand engine, field and event led, replicating the European playbook that won our first 100 insurers
  • Data driven: run marketing on the numbers; test, measure and reallocate spend to what converts
  • AI-powered marketing: run the function on the latest AI tools, including Claude and Regie.ai, across content, campaigns, outbound, account intelligence and reporting; more output per person, measured
  • Creative: bring distinctive ideas to campaigns, events and content; make Adlib and Paperbox the brands buyers remember
  • Brand: lead the global brand transition to an insurance-led, agentic company for regulated industries; land one brand architecture across Adlib and Paperbox and one web presence that serves every customer segment
  • Positioning: steward company and solution messaging; ensure consistent execution across regions, channels and sales enablement
  • Team and budget: lead and develop the global team; own the marketing budget and its return
  • Measurement: run one funnel from first touch to close; report pipeline, coverage, cost per opportunity, win rate and installed base results to the executive team and board monthly

What success looks like: first 90 days

  • Know the product: Adlib and Paperbox, what we sell, to whom, and why we win
  • Know the customers: time with insurance and installed base accounts, Sales and Customer Success
  • Know the funnel: what is working and what is not, by region, channel and program, with the data to prove it
  • Know the team: one global operating cadence across ops, field and GTM engineering
  • Deliver a diagnostic and a 12-month marketing plan to the executive team, with targets by quarter for insurance and the installed base
  • North American programs live on the proven European playbook
  • First creative ideas tested in market: one campaign, one event, one piece of content
  • AI operating model in place: tools, workflows and standards across the team
  • Funnel reporting in place: pipeline, coverage, cost per opportunity, win rate
  • Brand roadmap agreed with the executive team

What you bring

Required

  • 10+ years in B2B software marketing, 5+ leading teams
  • 5+ years of Insurance technology experience: carriers, MGAs, TPAs and their ecosystem
  • Scaled marketing at a growth-stage company ($15M to $40M ARR); PE-backed experience preferred
  • Quantitative and data driven: owned a pipeline number; fluent in funnel math, attribution, unit economics, marketing automation and Salesforce
  • Hands-on with AI tools across marketing, such as Claude and Regie.ai; has rebuilt workflows around them, not just trialed them
  • A portfolio of creative work that stood out in B2B and produced pipeline
  • Field and event led demand generation, hands-on
  • Marketed to an installed base across more than one industry
  • Led marketing across North America and Europe

Preferred

  • Launched a European product in North America, or replicated a playbook across regions
  • Led a rebrand or brand integration following an acquisition
  • Claims or underwriting domain knowledge

Location and travel

Remote in the United States or Canada. Travel about 25%, including industry events and our European offices.

Compensation and benefits

Base salary, annual bonus tied to pipeline and retention targets, equity, and a full benefits package.

Adlib is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on any basis protected by law.

Accessibility and accommodation: Adlib is committed to an accessible, inclusive hiring process. Accommodations are available on request at every stage of recruitment, in line with the AODA and Ontario Human Rights Code in Canada and the ADA and applicable state and local laws in the U.S. To request an accommodation, contact .

AI in hiring

Adlib does not use artificial intelligence to screen, assess, or select applicants for this role.

Salary: $175,000-200,000 USD annually

Who we are

Moniepoint Inc. is Africa’s all-in-one financial platform, helping 20 million businesses and individuals access seamless payments, banking, credit, cross-border, and business management tools each month.

As Nigeria’s largest merchant acquirer, we power most of the country’s point-of-sale (POS) transactions. Through our subsidiaries, Moniepoint Inc. processes over $250 billion in digital payment transaction value annually.

About the role

As a Principal Mobile Engineer (POS-Terminal) at Moniepoint, you will be responsible for designing and leading the architecture of our POS terminal solutions across multiple platforms. You will ensure the scalability, security, performance, and reliability of our POS systems and related applications, including mobile apps for repair scheduling and maintenance. While the majority of our terminals are currently based on Android Native, your expertise in cross-platform solutions (e.g., Flutter, C, JavaScript) will be crucial as we expand and diversify our portfolio.You’ll play a critical role in shaping the direction of our POS-related products, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and ensuring the technical vision aligns with the company’s broader strategic goals.

Curious about what makes Moniepoint an incredible place to work? Check out posts on how we cultivate a culture of innovation, teamwork, and growth.

What you will do:

  • Lead the design and architecture of POS terminal solutions, ensuring security, scalability, performance, and integration with various hardware and payment systems.
  • Develop and maintain architectural documents and diagrams for POS terminal systems, ensuring all platforms are well documented and up to date.
  • Make architectural decisions on POS terminal software, integrating various payment technologies, EMV standards, and ensuring hardware compatibility.
  • Lead the development of POS-related applications
  • Optimize system performance and security, particularly around payment processing and EMV protocols.
  • Participate in planning sessions with product and engineering teams to ensure solutions meet market needs and business goals.
  • Conduct code reviews and ensure best practices for mobile and embedded systems development, especially for Android Native development.
  • Define and enforce software engineering best practices across the POS and related teams to improve efficiency and developer productivity.
  • Ensure the stability and reliability of POS terminal products and applications, monitoring system performance and troubleshooting as necessary.
  • Provide technical mentorship to engineering teams, helping them grow their skills and contribute to the broader technical vision.
  • Participate in the hiring process, screening engineers with expertise in POS systems, mobile, and embedded development.

To succeed in this role, we think you should have:

  • At least 8 years of experience in system design, architecture, and development, specifically in the POS terminal domain.
  • Strong expertise in Android Native development (Java/Kotlin), with a deep understanding of Android-based POS terminal solutions.
  • Experience in cross-platform mobile development, such as Flutter, and familiarity with other POS application platforms (e.g., C, JavaScript) is a plus.
  • Strong knowledge of EMV (Europay, Mastercard, and Visa) security protocols, including chip-based transactions, encryption, and key management.
  • Experience with hardware integration for POS devices, such as card readers, pin pads, printers, and other peripherals.
  • Deep understanding of payment systems architecture, including integration with payment processors and gateways.
  • Knowledge of software quality assurance principles and their application in financial systems.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills with an ability to manage complex system interactions and adapt to changing requirements.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of presenting complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Leadership abilities with a focus on mentoring engineers and driving process improvements within the team.

What we can offer you

  • Culture -We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We’ve built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning - We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation - You’ll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance,annual bonus, plus other benefits.

What to expect in the hiring process

  • A preliminary phone call with one of our recruiters
  • A Takehome Hackerrank test.
  • A Technical interview session with our Engineering Team
  • A Technical and Behavioural Interview with our Head of Mobile Engineering
  • A Behavioral and Technical interview with a member of the Executive team.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

raw.description:
About Venn

Venn is the leader in workspace security for remote and contractor workforces. Built on Venn's patented technology, Blue Border™ protects company data, applications, and AI workflows on any computer, without VDI and without fully managing the endpoint. Installing Blue Border creates a company-controlled secure enclave directly on the user's Mac or PC. All business activity, including data, applications, networking, and AI workflows, runs locally and stays isolated from personal use, while everything outside the enclave remains private.

Blue Border gives IT a simpler, device-agnostic way to secure remote work, enable contractor and BYOD workforces, govern AI usage, and replace VDI. More than 700 security and compliance-driven organizations, including Fidelity, Guardian, Whatnot, and the IMF, trust Venn to meet HIPAA, FINRA, SEC, NAIC, SOC 2, PCI, and GDPR standards.

The Opportunity

As the Revenue Operations Engineer at Venn, you'll make our go-to-market systems work as one. Our revenue stack spans HubSpot, Vitally, Nooks, Swan AI, Gong, and Zuora.You will own how those tools connect, how data flows between them, and how the business gets trustworthy reporting out of them. You'll sit in Finance and work daily with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success, so that lead generation, pipeline, and customer data tie cleanly together from first touch through renewal. This is a hands-on, builder-minded role: you'll design integrations and automations, fix the data problems behind the numbers, and give leadership a single, reliable view of revenue.

What You'll Do

  • Own the integrations and data flows between our GTM systems, including HubSpot (CRM), Vitally (customer success), Nooks (AI phone dialer), Swan AI, Gong, and Zuora so that data moves accurately and automatically between them
  • Build and maintain automations and workflows that reduce manual work for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams
  • Serve as the technical owner of HubSpot, including objects, properties, workflows, lead routing, lifecycle stages, and data hygiene
  • Design and maintain reporting and dashboards for pipeline generation, conversion, sales activity, forecasting, and customer health, working with Finance on revenue reporting
  • Define and document metrics and data definitions so Sales, Marketing, CS, and Finance all work from the same numbers
  • Partner with Marketing on lead flow, attribution, and campaign reporting from first touch through closed-won
  • Partner with Sales leadership on pipeline visibility, forecast inputs, and rep productivity reporting
  • Partner with Customer Success on connecting customer health, usage, and renewal data to the CRM
  • Audit data quality across systems, find and fix sync errors, duplicates, and gaps, and put safeguards in place to prevent them
  • Evaluate new GTM tools and AI-driven workflows, and manage vendor setup, permissions, and integrations
  • Document systems, processes, and integrations so the revenue stack is easy to maintain and scale
  • Support Finance with revenue, bookings, and pipeline data for board reporting, planning, and audits

What You Bring

  • 3-5 years of experience in revenue operations, GTM operations, marketing operations, sales operations, or a similar technical GTM role, ideally at a B2B SaaS company
  • Deep, hands-on experience with HubSpot, including workflows, custom properties and objects, reporting, and integrations
  • You know the Model Context Protocol (MCP). You can connect AI tools to business systems with MCP connectors (for example, HubSpot, Zuora, and Google Drive)
  • Experience connecting systems and building integrations through native connectors, APIs, webhooks, and iPaaS tools (e.g., Zapier, Workato, Make, n8n, or similar)
  • Strong reporting and analytics skills, with experience building dashboards and translating messy data into clear answers for leadership
  • Familiarity with the types of tools in our stack, such as customer success platforms, sales dialers and engagement tools, and conversation intelligence platforms (Vitally, Nooks, and Gong experience is a plus)
  • Comfort working across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical teammates
  • A detail-oriented, systems-thinking approach, with a habit of documenting what you build
  • Strong problem-solving instincts and the ability to prioritize competing requests from multiple stakeholders
  • Comfort in a startup or scale-up environment, with a bias toward action and a willingness to build process as you go

Nice to Have

  • Working knowledge of SQL, JavaScript or Python, or scripting for data transformation and API work
  • Experience with BI or data tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Metabase, Google Sheets or BigQuery modeling)
  • Experience supporting finance reporting, such as bookings, ARR, and revenue recognition inputs
  • Experience with AI-driven GTM tools and automation
  • HubSpot certifications

Why You'll Love Working Here

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team's health, well-being, and work-life balance, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
  • Healthcare FSA, HSA, and commuter benefits
  • Unlimited paid time off, paid sick time, NYSE company holidays, and a paid birthday off
  • The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing startup with a collaborative, high-impact team where every voice is valued and there are clear paths for growth and promotion

We operate with Trust, Humility, Relationships, Innovation, Vigor, and Empowerment, and we look for teammates who do the same.

Overview

Remote Registered Nurse (RN) – DH Direct Triage

Part-Time, 20 hours per week

Position Summary

The RN - DH Direct Triage provides high-quality, patient-centered care through telephone triage and clinical assessment. This role is 100% hands-on, responsible for assessing patient symptoms, determining the appropriate level of care, providing education, and ensuring timely communication with providers. The ideal candidate has strong triage, Med-Surg, and Primary Care experience, is proficient with Epic EMR, and thrives in an independent remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform telephone triage using established protocols and sound nursing judgment.
  • Assess symptoms, prioritize patient needs, and determine appropriate care or follow-up.
  • Provide patient education, guidance, and reassurance as appropriate.
  • Accurately document all patient encounters in Epic EMR in real time.
  • Escalate urgent or emergent situations per clinic and organizational policies.
  • Communicate effectively with on-call providers, clinic teams, and patients to ensure continuity of care.
  • Contribute to a culture of safety, quality, and patient satisfaction within the triage team.

Qualifications Required:

  • Active, unrestricted RN license (multi-state compact required).
  • Minimum 2-3 years of clinical experience with a strong background in triage, ER, and/or Primary Care.
  • Proficiency in Epic EMR and remote communication systems.
  • Excellent assessment, critical thinking, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong communication, documentation, and time management abilities.
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

Preferred:

  • Associates degree required; BSN preferred
  • Previous experience in remote triage, nurse advice lines, or outpatient/clinic settings.

Schedule & Work Environment

  • Evenings with weekends and a holiday rotation
  • 100% remote position — requires reliable internet and a secure HIPAA-compliant workspace, free from distractions.

* Eligible candidates will reside in one of the following compact eligible states: Arizona, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, New Hampshire, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, Washington.

These are just a few highlights of being a nurse at Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center and Clinics in New Hampshire.

  • We have loan repayment up to $20,000.
  • We offer Relocation Assistance and a Housing Coordinator to take on the burden of finding a home.
  • We offer generous tuition reimbursement.
  • We have a very popular "earned time" plan.
  • We have extensive CEU/Training programs.
  • Our 8,000 ft Patient Safety and Training Simulation Center is state-of-the-art.
  • Our nurses serve as central figures in the success of our system through our shared governance nursing model.
  • We offer a rigorous, research-focused environment.
  • Dartmouth Hitchcock's Nursing Continuing Education Council is accredited as a provider of continuing nursing. education by the American Nurses Credentialing Center.

Read more about Dartmouth Health and why YOU should work here.

The Dartmouth Health system stretches over New Hampshire and Vermont and offers the quintessential New England experience. With no income or sales tax, this beautiful area combines history, industry, and business and has been ranked consistently as one of the best places in the US to live and work. Anchored by the academic Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center in Lebanon, NH, the system includes the NCI-designated Dartmouth Cancer Center, Dartmouth Health Children’s; member hospitals, and 30 Dartmouth Hitchcock ambulatory clinics across the region. With destinations like Boston, New York, the seacoast, and ski country within driving distance, the opportunities - both career and personal - truly make New Hampshire the ideal place to work and play.

Applicants are encouraged to visit our nursing career site to learn more and apply:

Please visit:

Dartmouth Health is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, veteran status, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Responsibilities

The Clinical Nurse is an engaged and credentialed member of the Professional Nursing Organization and is responsible for autonomous practice directed by the professional tenets of practitioner, leader/decision maker, scientist and transferor. The Clinical Nurse is responsible for utilizing the nursing process to provide evidence-based care and to continuously monitor and evaluate practice to ensure safe passage of patients that is in the best interest of populations served.

Practitioner

  • Utilizes the nursing process to assess, diagnose, identify outcomes, plan, implement and evaluate an individualized plan of care.
  • Utilizes critical thinking and the nursing process to anticipate and recognize changes in patient status, taking action to modify the plan of care or to elevate to the care team as necessary.
  • Practices in accordance with the ANA Code of Ethics to advocate for patients, uphold their autonomy in decision-making, ensure informed consent and assist patients in families in expressing self-determination.
  • Actively seeks feedback and acts to improve performance.
  • Engages in the governance of practice.

    • Leader/Decision Maker

  • Manages interpersonal relationships for self and with others.
  • Mentors colleagues for the advancement of nursing practice and the profession.
  • Assumes authority and accountability for the nursing care of patients while appropriately delegating elements of care to others members of the care delivery team in accordance with laws, regulations and policies and procedures.
  • Prioritizes and organizes time to optimize patient outcomes.

    • Scientist

  • Actively seeks out the most current evidence and standards and applies and translates to daily practice.
  • Role models a culture of inquiry, developing new knowledge by contributing to research, quality improvement, and evidence-based practice at the local level.

    • Transferor

  • Communicates effectively in a variety of formats in all areas of practice.
  • Actively partners with others to effect change that produces positive outcomes through the exchange of knowledge.
  • Precepts the student nurse, nurse extern, nurse resident, experienced clinical nurse and other members of the healthcare team.
  • Performs other duties as required or assigned.

    • Qualifications

    • Graduate from an accredited Nursing Program required.
    • Bachelor of Science Degree in Nursing (BSN) preferred.

    Required Licensure/Certifications

    • Licensed Registered Nurse with NH eligibility
    • Basic Life Support (BLS) Certificate required upon hire.

About PERSUIT

PERSUIT is a leading legal technology company transforming how in-house legal teams engage outside counsel and manage legal spend. Our innovative platform helps some of the world's largest organizations make smarter, more strategic decisions through competitive sourcing, greater transparency, and data-driven insights. We're a collaborative, fast-growing team passionate about challenging the status quo and driving meaningful change across the legal industry.

As a Customer Success Manager at PERSUIT, you'll partner with in-house legal teams to transform how they select and manage outside counsel and control legal spend, from intake to invoice.

You'll own a portfolio of North American enterprise clients and act as a strategic advisor to General Counsel and Legal Operations leaders. Your goal is to deliver measurable value, build lasting client relationships, and make renewal a no-brainer.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise clients across the full customer lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, expansion, and renewal.
  • Build data-driven success plans and advise clients on outside counsel management best practices, including competitive sourcing, alternative fee arrangements, and spend governance.
  • Turn usage and savings data into a clear value story that drives renewal and expansion.
  • Build executive sponsorship and develop strong, multi-threaded relationships across every account.
  • Drive adoption through training, change management, and scalable self-service programs.
  • Identify risks and growth opportunities early, collaborating with the right internal experts to take action.

This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in the United States. While we welcome applicants nationwide, candidates located in the Eastern, Central, or Mountain time zones are preferred.

We're AI-friendly. Feel free to use tools like ChatGPT during your prep, but we ask that your interview responses and work samples reflect your own thinking.

Who You Are

  • Bring 2–4+ years of experience in SaaS Customer Success, Account Management, consulting, or legal operations, with a track record of managing client relationships or portfolios.
  • Confident engaging with senior stakeholders and comfortable leading high-stakes conversations.
  • A data-literate storyteller who can translate complex information into clear, actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organized, and technically curious, with an interest in leveraging technology and AI to work smarter.
  • Bring a positive, "yes, and" mindset, with a willingness to learn, adapt, and grow.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in legal operations, legal technology, fintech, or professional services.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the United States. Applicants must have current, valid authorization to work in the U.S. PERSUIT is unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position.

Benefits

Compensation & Benefits

The base salary for this position is $120,000 plus variable compensation.

PERSUIT offers a comprehensive benefits package, including:

raw.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Epilepsy Foundation is seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Senior Manager of Contracts and Procurement with deep experience in government grant compliance, contract negotiation, procurement, and regulatory reporting within the nonprofit sector.
raw.description:
Position Summary

The Epilepsy Foundation is seeking a detail-oriented and strategic Senior Manager of Contracts and Procurement with deep experience in government grant compliance, contract negotiation, procurement, and regulatory reporting within the nonprofit sector.

This role is responsible for overseeing the organization’s contracts and procurement functions while ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local requirements, including the Federal Funding Accountability and Transparency Act (FFATA), Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), and applicable state charitable registration requirements.

The ideal candidate will have demonstrated experience navigating complex regulatory requirements, managing high-stakes contracts and agreements, and partnering across departments to mitigate organizational risk and ensure compliance. This position will serve as a key subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting, and regulatory obligations while supporting the Foundation’s mission and organizational priorities.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Contracts & Procurement Management: Execute and oversee the end-to-end contracts and procurement function, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance for federally and state-funded grants.
  • Federal Grant Compliance: Ensure organizational adherence to federal grant requirements, including FFATA reporting, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR Part 200), cost principles, procurement standards, and other applicable requirements.
  • Contract Development & Negotiation: Lead the review, drafting, negotiation, and administration of contracts, memoranda of understanding (MOUs), subrecipient agreements, cooperative agreements, and vendor contracts.
  • Charitable Registration Compliance: Coordinate state charitable solicitation registrations, renewals, and related compliance requirements across applicable jurisdictions.
  • Policies & Procedures: Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve procurement and contracting policies and procedures that align with nonprofit best practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Grant & Funder Requirements: Monitor and report on compliance with funder-specific procurement requirements, contractual obligations, and reporting requirements.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Serve as the organization’s subject matter expert on grant-related procurement, contracting requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner closely with Legal, Finance, Programs, Development, and other internal stakeholders to align procurement and contracting activities with organizational goals, grant requirements, and deliverables.
  • Vendor & Subcontractor Management: Manage supplier, vendor, subcontractor, and subrecipient due diligence, contractual obligations, compliance requirements, and performance.
  • Audit Support: Play an integral role in organizational audits, including the annual Uniform Guidance Audit, by ensuring appropriate procurement and contracting documentation and compliance.
  • Training & Guidance: Develop and provide training and guidance to internal stakeholders on procurement compliance, contracting procedures, ethics, and federal and state funding requirements.
  • Risk Management: Identify and mitigate contractual, procurement, and compliance risks while ensuring appropriate documentation and internal controls.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to strengthen contracting and procurement processes, improve operational efficiency, and enhance organizational compliance.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Public Administration, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required; JD or master’s degree preferred.
  • Minimum of 8–10 years of progressive experience in contract management and procurement, including at least 5 years supporting federal and state grant compliance within a nonprofit, government, or government-funded environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of FFATA, 2 CFR Part 200 (Uniform Guidance), federal procurement requirements, cost principles, and state charitable registration requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience managing complex grant-related contracts, subrecipient agreements, cooperative agreements, subcontracts, and vendor relationships.
  • Strong contract drafting, review, negotiation, and risk assessment skills.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of procurement regulations, internal controls, audit readiness, and compliance requirements applicable to nonprofits and federal grantees.
  • Experience supporting organizational audits, including Uniform Guidance Audits.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and project management skills.
  • Ability to interpret complex regulatory and contractual requirements and communicate them clearly to internal stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across Legal, Finance, Programs, Development, and other organizational functions.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex priorities and deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail.
  • Demonstrated ability to exercise sound judgment, discretion, and ethical decision-making.
  • Proficiency with contract, grant, financial, and organizational management systems; experience with Salesforce and Sage Intacct preferred.

Key Competencies:

  • Regulatory & Compliance Expertise
  • Contract Drafting & Negotiation
  • Federal & State Grant Compliance
  • Nonprofit Legal & Regulatory Acumen
  • Procurement & Vendor Management
  • Risk Assessment & Mitigation
  • Attention to Detail
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Strategic Thinking & Process Improvement
  • Ethical & Transparent Decision-Making

Travel & Work Requirements:

  • This is a remote position with travel required approximately 4–6 times annually for organizational meetings, conferences, audits, trainings, or other business-related activities.
  • Must be able to work effectively and collaboratively in a remote work environment.
  • Occasional flexibility outside of standard business hours may be required to support audits, reporting deadlines, contract negotiations, or other time-sensitive organizational needs.

raw.title: GM, Industrial Products & Services
raw.excerpt: Job Summary:As General Manager, Industrial Products & Services (IPS), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s business across Automotive, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Chemical, and Logistics clients, with full P&L and budget authority.
raw.description:
Job Summary:

As General Manager, Industrial Products & Services (IPS), reporting directly to the EVP, Industries, you will own the strategy, growth, and profitability of Toptal’s business across Automotive, Manufacturing, Agriculture, Oil & Gas, Chemical, and Logistics clients, with full P&L and budget authority. You will identify where we can win, decide where to invest, and build the team and client relationships to deliver sustained growth. Your mandate covers winning new enterprise clients, expanding existing relationships, and increasing the value clients receive from Toptal’s capabilities.

You will bring a clear perspective on the challenges facing potential clients and where Toptal can help. Working with our Services leaders and subject matter experts, you will translate those challenges into viable sales proposals across our AI solutions, managed services, management consultancy, and talent offerings. You will choose which markets, accounts, and opportunities to pursue, allocate resources accordingly, and give your team a focused plan.

You will lead from the front: personally leading executive client conversations, shaping proposals, working through difficult commercial negotiations, and helping close critical pursuits. Your team should see the selling standard you expect in your own work. You will understand what is driving performance, where growth is constrained, and what needs to change.

You will build on established enterprise relationships to expand the problems clients trust Toptal to solve through our services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities. You will have the authority to build the team and invest in profitable growth.

This is a remote position. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

  • Set and execute the industry strategy. Identify the markets, client problems, and offerings with the strongest growth potential. Build an IPS business plan with clear priorities, financial objectives, and investment decisions. Test your assumptions with clients and adjust the plan as evidence changes.
  • Own the P&L and budget. Be accountable for revenue, profitability, and spending. Set and manage the budget, allocate resources, and evaluate returns on investments in people and growth initiatives. Understand how pricing, delivery economics, retention, and portfolio mix affect results, and act when performance diverges from the plan. Win new enterprise clients. Lead your team in pursuing priority accounts. Develop a credible reason for each client to engage with Toptal, build relationships with decision-makers, and personally advance important opportunities through discovery, solution development, negotiation, and close.
  • Expand and retain client relationships. Work with Client Partners to understand client priorities, broaden relationships across buying centers, and develop opportunities across Toptal’s portfolio. Stay close to important engagements, resolve concerns with the responsible teams, and turn successful outcomes into further business.
  • Make account planning actionable. Establish clear priorities and ownership. Expect your team to explain why an account matters, whom they need to engage, what opportunity they are pursuing, and how they will create progress. Ensure priority accounts receive sustained attention.
  • Bring the right expertise into the sale. Work with Services leaders, solution architects, and specialists to diagnose needs and develop credible proposals across services, AI-based solutions, and talent. Coordinate with supporting functions to resolve obstacles and keep opportunities moving toward a decision.
  • Maintain a credible forecast. Challenge the evidence behind opportunity values, close dates, and expected revenue. Understand the assumptions connecting pipeline to the financial plan, identify risks early, and take specific action to address shortfalls.
  • Build and develop the team. Recruit strong commercial talent, set clear expectations, and coach people through real client situations. Review calls, account plans, and active pursuits; demonstrate stronger approaches and follow through on improvements. Address underperformance promptly and develop future leaders.
  • Accomplish work objectives through leading and supervising other Toptal team members on the Industrial Products and Services team.
  • Establish objectives and initiatives for the team, recommend the team’s structure and jobs, and organize, assign, delegate, oversee, and monitor work.
  • Coach and mentor team members, provide feedback, conduct performance reviews, and implement performance improvement plans, if needed.

In the first week, expect to:

  • Learn Toptal’s business model, capabilities, sales process, and client value proposition.
  • Meet your team and the leaders whose functions support the IPS business.
  • Begin reviewing the client portfolio, active opportunities, P&L, budget, and growth priorities.

In the first month, expect to:

  • Meet priority clients and develop an informed view of their needs, our relationships, and the opportunities ahead.
  • Assess the team’s capabilities and identify immediate coaching, performance, and hiring priorities.
  • Establish a consistent rhythm for account planning, opportunity reviews, forecasting, financial management, and coaching.
  • Present your proposed IPS business plan, including priority markets and accounts, revenue and profitability assumptions, investment choices, and the first actions you will take.

In the first three months, expect to:

  • Be executing an agreed business plan with clear objectives, resource allocations, account priorities, and ownership.
  • Be personally advancing major pursuits, helping close new business, and building qualified pipeline in priority accounts.
  • Have specific expansion plans for key clients and be executing the talent decisions needed to strengthen the team.

In the first six months, expect to:

  • Demonstrate measurable commercial progress against the plan through closed new business, expansion revenue, and margin performance.
  • Show that coaching, account planning, and opportunity reviews are improving seller performance and commercial results.
  • Manage the P&L against the budget, address material variances, and refine investment priorities using evidence from sales and delivery outcomes.

In the first year, expect to:

  • Deliver against the agreed IPS revenue, profitability, and budget objectives.
  • Have built a stronger team with clear accountability, consistent execution, and emerging leadership capability.
  • Demonstrate deeper client relationships and broader adoption of Toptal’s services, AI-based solutions, and talent-based capabilities.
  • Present the next stage of the industry business plan, including the investments required to sustain profitable growth.

Qualifications and Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required. Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field preferred.
  • 5+ years of proven success leading professional services sales teams specifically in Industrial Products and Services, with in-depth experience in the Energy Sector, specifically Oil & Gas is required.
  • 12+ years of demonstrated experience running and managing an industry business unit with a strong understanding of business operations and management principles.
  • Deep industry relationships ranging from director-level to C-level contacts is expected.
  • A sustained record of leading enterprise SaaS or services sales teams, winning new clients, and expanding existing relationships. You can demonstrate your personal contribution to those results.
  • Industry expertise and demonstrated sales experience in at least one of Oil & Gas, Industrial Manufacturing, Automotive, or Defense & Aerospace.
  • Demonstrated accountability for commercial results and resource decisions. You can explain how your choices on pricing, hiring, investment, and account priorities affected revenue, margin, and profitability.
  • Experience closing complex enterprise opportunities, including shaping a business case, coordinating technical expertise, navigating procurement, and negotiating commercial agreements.
  • Strong industry relationships and a record of earning access to senior decision-makers through relevant insight and demonstrated value.
  • Evidence of hiring strong sellers, improving individual and team performance through specific coaching, and developing future leaders.
  • Disciplined qualification and forecasting skills. You distinguish client interest from a credible buying process, assess the evidence behind a forecast, and act when an opportunity loses momentum.
  • Sufficient fluency in technology, AI, and services delivery to discuss client priorities intelligently and recognize when deeper specialist expertise is needed.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex client problem into a compelling proposal and explain business performance without obscuring the issues.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, rapidly growing company and handle a wide variety of challenges, deadlines, and a diverse array of contacts.
  • You must be a world-class individual contributor to thrive at Toptal. You will not be here just to tell other people what to do.
