The Opportunity

If you're a compensation professional who thrives on analysis, collaboration, and continuous improvement, we'd love to hear from you. Bring your expertise, curiosity, and strategic mindset to a role where your contributions will directly influence enterprise-wide compensation programs and talent strategies.

We are seeking a Senior Compensation Analyst to help shape and administer compensation programs that attract, motivate, and retain talent. In this highly analytical and consultative role, you will evaluate jobs, interpret market data, support salary structures and incentive plans, and deliver recommendations that promote competitive pay, internal equity, and a strong pay-for-performance culture. Working with limited supervision, you will apply advanced compensation knowledge to complex assignments, advise business partners, and contribute to enterprise-wide initiatives. This is an opportunity to turn data into meaningful insights and influence compensation decisions across the organization. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
  • Serving as a key advisor in compensation decision-making by evaluating roles, analyzing market trends, and delivering data-driven insights that support competitive and equitable pay practices. Partner with Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, managers, and business leaders to provide recommendations on compensation actions, including base pay, promotions, market adjustments, and incentive awards. Leverage workforce and market data to identify opportunities, anticipate risks, and support strategic talent decisions.
  • Helping to shape and enhance compensation programs that align with business objectives, market competitiveness, and pay-for-performance principles. Support the ongoing administration and improvement of salary structures, pay ranges, incentive programs, job descriptions, and job architecture frameworks. Participate in compensation surveys and external benchmarking efforts while promoting consistent job leveling and compensation practices across the organization.
  • Playing an active role in annual compensation planning activities, including merit increases, promotions, market adjustments, and incentive planning. Develop meaningful analyses, reports, and presentations that inform compensation strategies and leadership decisions. Contribute to high-impact initiatives such as compensation program enhancements, job architecture projects, organizational changes, and merger and acquisition integration efforts.
  • Supporting the integrity and effectiveness of compensation programs by helping ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, as well as company policies. Serve as a resource for stakeholders by providing guidance, education, and support on compensation programs, processes, and best practices.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in human resources, business, finance, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • At least seven years of experience administering compensation programs and practices.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications is required, along with the ability to analyze, interpret, and present data effectively. The successful candidate will bring a strong analytical and data-driven approach, with knowledge of compensation reporting, workforce analytics, and market data analysis.
  • This role requires the ability to identify trends, draw meaningful conclusions, and develop recommendations for senior leadership. Strong organizational and project management skills are essential, including the ability to manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and successfully execute concurrent assignments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills are required, along with strong consultative, interpersonal, and relationship-building abilities. The successful candidate must be able to explain complex information clearly and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with job architecture, job evaluation, or career framework design is preferred. A professional compensation certification is also preferred.

An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability.

Employee-owned, RS&H is one of the nation’s leading architecture, engineering, and consulting firms, with associates who work hard every day to create tomorrow together.   • Understand the client’s technological landscape including relevant software, hardware, technical debt, risk aversion, velocity and proclivity towards change, etc.

  • Participate in sales calls, write proposals, and close opportunities for new work and expansion of existing clients
  • Act independently and lead relationships based on program requirements
  • Provide amazing support to our clients, greatly exceeding their experience of what anyone else has ever done for them
  • Track client opportunities and maintain opportunities within our CRM
  • Coordinate, or act as a point of escalation for the client service team
  • Work collaboratively with teams of smart, thoughtful people, to best meet the needs of our clients

This is a remote role with expected travel to client sites approximately 10-15% of the time. The position also includes periodic off-hours availability for client support.

  • 4+ years of experience in IT service delivery
  • 3+ years of experience managing client relationships within an IT Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment
  • Proven ability to build and maintain relationships with C-suite and senior-level stakeholders
  • Experience working in a multi-disciplinary, cross-functional technical organization with matrixed reporting structures
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Strong understanding of IT service management frameworks such as ITIL, COBIT, or similar
  • Relevant IT certifications preferred
  • Must be willing to travel as needed to client sites (approximately 10-15% of the time)

Some of the skills we are expecting are:

  • Strong analytical skills and a demonstrated ability to troubleshoot problems
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills, both written and oral
  • Ability to explain just about anything technical to anyone, regardless of their background
  • Experience working in a dynamic IT environment and working on IT projects
  • Knowledge of project management in relation to the delivery of IT services
  • Ability to develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOP)
  • Experience working with proposals for new business
  • Demonstrated ability working in a teaming/collaborative environment
  • Experience solutioning and selling additional services and projects to current clients
  • Experience with and understanding of the managed services industry with a history of roles outside of client success is preferred
  • Experience working with SMB and mid-market clients

While this position is not primarily technical, it is expected that a candidate will have familiarity with the following technologies:

  • Servers: Active Directory, Domain, SSL Certificate, Backups, Antivirus
  • Cloud: Azure, Office 365, AWS, Google
  • Network: Firewalls, Switches, Wireless, Voice, DHCP, TCP/IP, DNS, Routing
  • Computers: Computer deployment, printer deployment
  • Applications and Products: Office 365, Common Line of Business Apps, Barracuda, Fortinet, Cisco, HP
  • Windows Server, server virtualization, and Desktop operating systems
  • Anti-virus and antispam products
  • Identity management solutions
  • Experience with creating documentation and reports using MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint
  • Experience working and communicating with hardware and software vendors for maintenance/repair/upgrade/license management
  • Knowledge of configuration management tools and software deployment

What you should know about Resultant:

  • Rezzers are humble, hungry, and smart. We solve big problems, serve lots of clients, and are entirely committed to delivering transformative outcomes.
  • Rezzers are team players, deeply dedicated to the mission of the organization and to helping everyone around us be successful.
  • Resultant compensates well, rewarding performance that delivers positive outcomes for our clients and ensuring incentives are aligned to achieve our goals.
  • Resultant leaders work hard, serving as a shining example of what it means to be a great Rezzer. They are servant leaders, helping their team to be successful in all possible ways.
  • We have a great benefits package including unlimited vacation, significant 401k contributions, and several opportunities to develop yourself.
  • We pride ourselves in having the best talent in the industry and hope that you’re up for the challenge!

What our team members say about us…

  • “I love our true empathy and concern for our clients, it's very rare and appreciated. It is a pleasure to be a part of an organization like Resultant.”
  • “I learn something new every single day, and I feel like I'm a part of building an organization that has legs. I appreciate that I'm consistently humbled by the talent and caliber of our team.”
  • “The culture of the company is amazing, and the climate of my team is great. The benefits that employees are offered are better than competitors, and the one-on-one presence that my team lead gives is extremely beneficial to me.”

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, sex, disability, national origin, race, religion, or veteran status.

Equal Opportunity Employer

We embrace AI across everything we do, and that includes how you prepare for this interview. Feel free to use AI tools to research the role, practice your responses, and put your best foot forward. What matters to us is getting to know the real you — how you think, how you communicate, and what you genuinely bring to the table. Our interviews are designed to go deeper than any polished answer, so come curious and come as yourself without the support of an AI tool during our conversation.

Resultant is an outcomes-focused consulting firm committed to helping clients make technology a strategic asset and use data to guide better decisions. But we’re not just data and tech experts; we are problem solvers and industry experts who work alongside our clients to help them achieve their mission.

We don’t solve problems for our clients. We solve problems with them.

We take the time to deeply understand goals and roadblocks to drive toward outcomes that serve organizations, people, and communities. Through outcomes driven by data analytics, technology solutions, digital transformation, and beyond, our team works with clients in both the public and private sectors to solve their most complex challenges. We start by learning as much as we can about who they are, how they work, and what they’re striving for so we can feel their problems as our own. Partnering with our clients means their desired outcomes are always top of mind, their challenges and strengths guiding our efforts. We build client-focused relationships before we build unique solutions that blaze past expectations.

Originally founded in Indianapolis in 2008, Resultant now employs more than 450 team members who operate remotely and from offices and hubs around the United States including Indianapolis, IN; Fort Wayne, IN; Denver, CO; Atlanta, GA; and Dallas, TX.

We’re Resultant. Clients partner with us to see a difference. People join us to make one.

[We show compassion to heal minds.]

🧠 About Legion Health

Legion Health is a technology-forward psychiatry company delivering world-class outpatient mental health care while expanding access for patients through insurance.

We are seeking exceptional Psychiatrists (MD or DO) across the United States who are passionate about evidence-based psychiatry and want the time, support, and clinical autonomy needed to provide exceptional patient care.

Our innovative model combines the stability of a traditional hospital position with the flexibility of a private practice. We prioritize our clinicians' well-being and professional growth, offering a competitive compensation package and fostering a vibrant, collaborative culture.

Quality and patient experience are paramount to us. This means recruiting exceptional providers, championing evidence-based protocols, and displaying compassion in every patient interaction. Our exceptional psychiatrists operate with clinical autonomy, supported by experienced peers.

Our vision is to pioneer a new era of medicine by delivering world-class psychiatry. We believe in a future where every person can access the compassionate, high-quality care they need.

🚀 About the Role

Practice at the top of your license, from wherever you do your best work. This role is designed for psychiatrists who want meaningful clinical autonomy without having to build and operate a private practice alone.

We are looking for clinically excellent, patient-centered psychiatrists to provide psychiatric care through telehealth. Full-time and part-time positions are available.

💙 Benefits

Legion’s model is built to give clinicians more time for patients, fewer administrative distractions, and the support of a high-caliber psychiatric community.

  • Flexibility: Set your own schedule for optimal work-life balance.

  • Work from Home: See patients from the comfort of your home via telehealth.

  • Significant Administrative Support: You focus on patient care, and we’ll handle scheduling, insurance verification, billing, prior authorizations, pharmacy coordination, etc.

  • Patient Acquisition: Unlike with a private practice, we’ll work to fill your schedule, so you don’t have to do your own marketing.

  • Competitive Pay: We compensate our providers at market-leading rates.

  • Weekly Pay: We pay our providers every week for immediate financial benefit and planning ease.

  • Legal Protection: We provide full malpractice insurance coverage.

  • Clinical Autonomy: We hire the most skilled providers and trust them to do what’s best for patients.

  • Technical Support: We cover the costs for you to have best-in-class EHR, e-Prescribe, and AI tools.

  • Credentialing Support: We handle all aspects and costs of credentialing with a large number of insurance plans, including commercial, ACA, and government, ensuring your legal and effective authorization within insurance networks.

  • Licensure and DEA Coverage: We’ll reimburse you for all fees associated with getting licensed in other states as required by Legion.

  • Commitment to Responsible Prescribing and High-Quality Care: We have rigorous, evidence-based protocols and provide objective diagnostic tools to ensure responsible and ethical prescriptions of controlled substances.

  • Community of Clinical Excellence: You will work alongside the most talented psychiatrists in the world. Our current psychiatrists have trained at some of the country’s most prestigious institutions.

  • Opportunities for Professional Growth: As we expand, we intend to promote clinical leadership from the best of our active providers.

  • Culture of Excellence through Innovation: Actively participate in ushering in a new era of mental health care through superior clinical care and technology.

  • Resources: We provide premium subscriptions to resources such as UpToDate and Carlat.

  • Exclusive Events: Engage with your colleagues through exclusive in-person and virtual events.

✅ Responsibilities

  • Provide excellent patient care for conditions including depression, anxiety, ADHD, insomnia, PTSD, bipolar disorder, etc.

  • Perform comprehensive psychiatric assessments, including mental-health history, medical history, diagnostic evaluation, and risk analysis.

  • Create and execute individualized treatment plans that may combine medication management and brief psychotherapy.

  • Provide compassionate, respectful, and patient-centered care.

  • Use evidence-based clinical protocols and responsible prescribing practices.

  • Collaborate with other psychiatrists through consultations and case reviews.

  • Use technology and operational systems effectively to deliver reliable telehealth care.

🧰 Qualifications

  • An active, unrestricted license to practice medicine in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.

  • Strong clinical assessment, diagnostic, and medication-management skills.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Comfort providing care remotely and using electronic health record systems.

  • Commitment to patient-centered, compassionate, evidence-based care.

📍 Role Logistics

  • Location: Fully remote within the United States.

  • Schedule: Full-time or part-time positions are available.

  • Expected annual compensation: $300K–$500K, depending on completed patient-care hours.

🤝 Clinical Advisory Board

Legion’s Clinical Advisory Board brings together nationally recognized psychiatrists, physician executives, telepsychiatry pioneers, and primary-care leaders. Working closely with Legion’s medical leadership, they help shape our clinical quality standards, evidence-based care protocols, prescribing safeguards, risk-management practices, and continuous quality-improvement efforts as the company scales.

Members of our clinical advisory board include:

  • Madhukar Trivedi, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Professor of Psychiatry and Distinguished Chair in Mental Health at UT Southwestern

  • Alexander Ruvalcaba, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Physician Executive at MultiCare Behavioral Health Network

  • Jon Kole, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Senior Medical Director at Headspace

  • Liberty Eberly, D.O. — Psychiatrist; Co-Founder and Former Chief Medical Officer at innovaTel Telepsychiatry

  • John Lusins, M.D. — Psychiatrist; Founder and President at South Texas Mental Health Associates

  • Jacqueline Champlain, M.D. — Family Medicine Physician; Lead Physician at WellMed and Fellow of the American Academy of Family Physicians

✨ Bring Your Best Clinical Work to Legion

If you are a thoughtful, evidence-based psychiatrist who wants the flexibility of remote practice, meaningful clinical autonomy, robust operational support, and a community committed to excellent psychiatric care, we would be excited to learn more about you.

🤝 Equal Employment Opportunity

Legion Health is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees, contractors, and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation Range: $300K - $500K

raw.description:
Concierge Manager | Remote | Luxury Travel Leadership

About Ascend

Ascend helps founders, investors, and executives book international business and first-class flights at rates that are typically 30-80% below what you would find on a regular booking site. We combine smart, proprietary booking methods with round-the-clock personal service delivered over WhatsApp.

We have grown from 12 to 60+ people in just over a year, backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, and 5x'd our revenue year-over-year. We are at $22M+ ARR and growing fast. Our mission is to make first-class travel accessible to the people who are shaping the world.

Our clients are founders, investors, and senior executives who expect fast, accurate, and polished service. They do not chase confirmations. They trust us to get it right every time.

The Role

We are looking for an experienced luxury service leader who wants to build world-class operations and grow their impact at a fast-moving company.

As Concierge Manager, you own shift-level operations across three core functions: Client Service, Ticketing, Trip Fulfillment. You lead Team Leads who manage specialists across each function. You are responsible for making sure every client receives a five-star experience, every shift runs smoothly, and every team member is growing under your leadership.

This is a role for someone who thinks in systems but leads with people. Process without empathy is just bureaucracy. You bring both.

What You'll Do

Lead and Develop Your Team

  • Manage 3 Team Leads across Client Service, Ticketing and Trip Fulfillment,
  • Coach Team Leads daily with direct, specific feedback that builds their judgment and confidence as leaders
  • Build a shift culture where ownership, accuracy, and client empathy are the baseline, not the exception
  • Conduct regular performance reviews that give team members clarity on where they stand and what comes next

Own Shift Operations

  • Direct all client-facing operations during your shift with real-time decisions and clear priorities
  • Allocate team resources, manage escalations from Team Leads, and resolve complex situations before they reach the client
  • Ensure clean, complete handovers between shifts so the incoming manager has everything they need
  • Maintain 95%+ SLA adherence and 98%+ data accuracy through effective team management and systems

Deliver Exceptional Client Experiences

  • Own the end-to-end client experience for your shift: every request, every quote, every booking, and every follow-up
  • Personally handle VIP clients and high-complexity situations that require senior judgment
  • Ensure clients receive proactive updates, creative solutions, and service that consistently exceeds their expectations
  • Turn service recovery moments into opportunities to deepen client relationships

Drive Process Excellence

  • Submit at least two documented process improvements per month that increase efficiency or quality for the team
  • Spot patterns across client feedback, system performance, and team errors, and address them systematically rather than reactively
  • Partner with the Process Management team and other functions to streamline workflows across the operation
  • Use data to make decisions, validate improvements, and demonstrate impact

Collaborate Across Ascend

  • Work closely with Product, Operations, and Leadership to implement new systems and maintain consistency as we scale
  • Represent the voice of both your clients and your team in strategic conversations
  • Contribute insights that shape how Ascend grows globally while maintaining the quality standard clients expect

What You Bring

Must Have

  • 4+ years in luxury travel, hospitality, or high-touch service operations. Apply even if you do not have every year listed but are confident in your skillset
  • 2+ years in a leadership or management role where you coached and developed a team, not just managed tasks and deadlines
  • Strong Sabre GDS proficiency: you are comfortable with fare rules, complex routing, and ticketing at a level that lets you support and QA your team's work
  • A data-driven approach to leadership: you use metrics to spot trends, validate changes, and hold the team to clear standards
  • Excellent written and verbal communication: you can coach with clarity, write polished client messages, and present confidently to leadership
  • Composure under pressure: when everything is happening at once, you are the calm and steady presence the team needs

Nice to Have

  • Experience with international business class or first-class bookings, or award travel programs
  • Familiarity with tools like Asana, Periskope, Stripe, or similar workflow and CRM platforms
  • A track record of building or improving operational processes, SOPs, or training programs
  • Experience managing remote, global teams across time zones
  • Background in luxury hospitality brands such as premium hotels or high-end concierge services

You do not need to check every box. If you have 80% of the skills and the drive to learn, we want to hear from you.

What Makes You Stand Out

We are especially interested in candidates who:

  • Have turned around an underperforming team or operation and can speak to the specific changes they made and the results they drove
  • Are known as the manager people want to work for because they genuinely develop the people around them
  • Have a reputation for spotting problems early and solving them before they reach the client
  • Think in systems but are not rigid: you improve processes without losing the human element that makes a service feel premium
  • Are comfortable being hands-on when the situation calls for it while consistently pushing ownership down to the team

Why Ascend

Clear Growth Path

The progression here is: Concierge Manager to Senior Concierge Manager to Associate Director to Director. We promote from within based on demonstrated performance and impact, not politics or tenure.

Build, Don't Just Maintain

We are implementing our concierge framework and career systems right now. You are not inheriting a rigid legacy structure. You are helping build how Ascend's operations scale globally. Your insights will have a direct and visible effect on how we work.

Real Support

  • We hire proficient people: you will not be carrying underperformers
  • Regular performance reviews with clear metrics and honest feedback
  • A Head of People who understands operations and partners with you
  • A Process Management team dedicated to making your job easier

Work-Life Balance

  • Predictable scheduling: you will know your shift in advance
  • Structured handovers so the incoming manager receives everything they need without you staying late
  • A global team with talented colleagues across continents
  • Merit-based performance incentives

Learn While You Lead

  • Advanced travel optimization strategies used by elite professionals in the industry
  • How to lead global teams using shared metrics and real-time decision-making
  • Cross-functional collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Operations
  • Operational leadership at a venture-backed company growing 5x year-over-year

What Success Looks Like

First 90 days: You have learned our core systems and tools, including Sabre, Asana, and our booking platforms. You are leading shifts independently with 95%+ SLA adherence. You are coaching your Team Leads with specific, useful feedback and you have identified your first improvement opportunity.

Within 6-12 months: You are consistently delivering 95%+ SLA and 98%+ accuracy. Your team sentiment scores are at 8/10 or above. You have led at least one initiative that measurably improved client satisfaction or team efficiency. Your Team Leads are stronger leaders because of your coaching.

Our Values

  • Customer Obsession: We win when our customers win
  • Urgency with Impact: Clients expect answers in minutes, not hours
  • Radical Candor: Honest, direct, respectful feedback builds trust
  • Ownership: If something breaks, we fix it
  • Relentless Excellence: Good enough is never enough

Should You Apply?

If you are thinking that you may not have all the experience listed, apply anyway. We are looking for people with 80% of the skills and 100% of the drive to learn. What we care about most:

  • Have you led teams or operations in a high-touch service environment?
  • Do you have a track record of meeting or exceeding operational targets?
  • Can you coach, give feedback, and genuinely develop other people?
  • Are you excited about building something excellent rather than maintaining something average?

If the answer to these questions is yes, we want to hear from you.

Why You'll Love This Role

This is perfect for someone who:

  • Wants to work directly with founders, investors, and global business leaders
  • Sees themselves at Ascend for years, building toward senior leadership
  • Takes genuine pride in building something excellent and watching their team grow
  • Values both high performance and sustainable, respectful working practices
  • Wants to lead a high-performing team that holds itself to a standard most operations never reach

Ascend is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Engagement Structure, Compensation, Shifts, and Benefits

Ascend is a remote-first, global team. For candidates based in India, employment will be through Ascend's designated Employer of Record (EOR), which will be the legal employer and administer payroll, applicable statutory deductions, tax deductions and employment-related compliance.

Compensation will be stated in USD and paid in INR through the EOR's payroll, based on the applicable conversion arrangement. The salary breakup, statutory contributions, deductions and payment terms will be detailed in the employment offer. Any personal income tax return filing obligations remain the employee's responsibility.

This role is part of Ascend's 24/7 client service operations and involves rotating shifts to support clients across different time zones. This may include overnight shifts, weekends or public holidays, depending on business and team scheduling needs. Weekly offs and shift schedules are planned in advance wherever possible and managed fairly across the team.

The monthly compensation accounts for the rotating shifts and operational coverage requirements of the role. Separate allowances for night shifts, weekends, holidays, overtime or additional hours are not provided unless required by applicable law or specified in the employment terms.

Ascend does not currently provide additional employer-sponsored medical insurance or mediclaim for this role beyond any applicable statutory coverage. Details of leave entitlements, schedules and employment policies will be shared during the offer and onboarding process.

Ascend values work-life balance and aims to distribute schedules thoughtfully. At the same time, because this is a client-facing operational role, some flexibility and responsiveness may be required from time to time.

raw.title: Senior Head of Organic Content Marketing
raw.excerpt: Are you a senior content operator and leader? And when you hear of the challenge of building and leading a world-class organic media machine that needs to grow from 1.
raw.description:
Are you a senior content operator and leader?

And when you hear of the challenge of building and leading a world-class organic media machine that needs to grow from 1.5M followers to 10M followers in the next 24 months... does that excite you?

If so - working alongside our founder Richard Yu and our company Impact Clients might just be your dream role...

Now, to be clear:

This is not a social media manager role.
This is not a “make posts and schedule content” job.
This is not a gig or a short-term contractor position.

We're looking for a true executive, owner of tasks, and team builder who can grow to become a partner in our portfolio of companies.

Our Company Mission: To help ordinary people build extraordinary businesses online, and teach them the mindset and skills necessary to not just to make money, but more importantly to improve in all aspects of their lives.

Who We Are: We are an online education company that teaches people (9-5ers, busy parents, university students, etc) how to build thriving online digital product businesses.

Why We Are Looking For This Role: Richard and our team have grown our social media accounts to 1.5M+ followers (Over 1 million on Instagram @richardyuzee (feel free to look), Richard Yu on Youtube (150K+ subscribers)... and we use organic content (meaning NO advertising or boosting posts) to drive leads (customers and qualified booked calls) to our coaching programs and digital software services that we offer.

You are essentially building the "Traffic Engine" that will supply our company with unlimited amounts of leads so our company can continue to serve and impact more and more people through the coaching and software products that we offer.

Our Founder’s Story: Richard Yu began documenting his life at age 19 from his college dorm room in UCLA. Within 2 years, he launched a $500 productivity course (teaching college students how to wake up early and be productive), that ended up doing $500K in sales in 8 months. So many of his peers asked him “how did you do it?!” so he began to teach others how to monetize their knowledge and sell digital products (courses, PDFs, coaching, etc).

That grew into a consulting and education company that has now done over 30 million in sales and a team of 62 full time staff.

Feel free to reference a documentary made about his life here (1 hr documentary series):

Also - Richard's TedX talk about how we get our clients results, and transform their lives:

Our mission is to build one of the most influential organic-first personal media brands in the world with 10M+ followers across platforms while driving massive, profitable traffic into our software companies and education businesses.

We strongly believe that income is a reflection of the impact we make on this world, and so through our content we aspire to positively impact 10M followers in the next 24 months.

We are intentionally shifting away from paid growth on social and moving 100% organic-first.

This role will own that transformation as the key leader, operator, and soon business partner in our company.

Current Context

  • Instagram account with ~1M followers, generating multiple seven figures per year
  • Two YouTube channels:

Personal brand / vlog-style channel (~150K subs)

Business education channel (~40K subs in <90 days), Alex Hormozi–style sit-down teaching content, already driving meaningful revenue

  • Existing team members:
    • Dedicated Instagram copywriter
    • Dedicated Instagram video editor
    • YouTube scriptwriter / channel owner
    • Graphic Designer (for all platforms)
    • Two Video Editors
  • Marketing Leadership Team (that will support you, you will work alongside us)
    • CEO and Founder (and actor talent in this case): Richard Yu
    • COO
    • Head of Marketing (on the paid media side, so he leads every initiative and team of 10 people on the paid advertising side, this individual will be your accountability peer since you be the equivalent of him, but on the ORGANIC team side)

You will lead, not replace, these people, and then build an even more talented team on top of it.

The perfect example of this role is this individual Sam that we respect, that is the Head of Organic Content for another company in our industry.

Please watch this 60 second IG reel to understand what he does (and what we are looking for):

More context, full Youtube interview (extremely valuable where he breaks down their 8-figure/year media company:

Your Mission

Build, scale, and lead the entire organic content ecosystem—starting with Instagram, then expanding outward into YouTube, short-form platforms, and written platforms—while earning the trust, respect, and performance of a growing content team.

Operator FIRST Responsibilities:

First off - this is not a "creative first" type of role. If you just want to write copy all day for writing viral IG reels, please apply to be our copywriter (which we are always hiring for), not this role.

You will running L10 meetings (reference the book Traction, by Gino Wickman).

You will be sharing screen and typing NAS (next action steps) for every individual that shows up to meetings, and host Mon/Wed/Fri stand-ups for 30-60 min as an organized disciplined operator and cut people off on the meeting (politely :-)) when they ramble to make sure meetings are efficient.

You will be reading end of week reports that are both quantitative AND qualitative, and adding comments on the google doc to provide coaching and feedback to the Head of IG and Head of YT (and other team members).

Again - you're an operator FIRST, logical thinker, highly organized and disciplined, with a strong understanding of organic content.

ALL channel leaders (Head of IG, Head of YT, Head of Linkedin, and any outside agencies/vendors will all report to you. Think of yourself as a COO of the media company, an extremely detailed project manager making sure everyone is getting their responsibilities done on time, and ensuring overall growth.

Richard wants to be fully removed from ALL day to day operations, so examples of things that Richard is doing that he does NOT want to be doing and you will take over completely are:

  • If the videographer uploaded the footage late 2 days and therefore IG content goes out late because the editors didn't get the raw footage in time... Richard is NOT calling this out. You are. And you are immediately creating an SOP/process (and tough conversation with the videographer if needed) so Richard does NOT have to do it.
  • If the content word-for-word scripts, which are due by 5 PM EST every Monday are submitted LATE by a copywriter, YOU are the one getting ahead of this and calling it out.
  • If one video editor is approaching his 12 month term and is asking for a compensation bump, YOU are the one that is conducting the salary negotiation and structuring the comp structure so that it motivates the copywriter, and is sustainable for our P&L.

Phase 1: Instagram Organic (Immediate Priority)

You will work directly with our Head of Instagram to achieve 100,000 NET NEW followers gained per month (current growth: 70K/month followers)

This includes:

  • Leading the team of Instagram (Head of Instagram, 2 IG copywriters, 2 dedicated video editors for IG)
  • You must fundamentally understand how to do each one of the below tasks (even if you're not the one directly doing it):
    • Conducting viral content research to find the most viral and trending content that exists
    • Writing word for word teleprompter scripts for Richard to read off of when filming content that match his brand voice truly and sound like him
    • Writing or approving copy
    • Exceeding existing KPIs of: views, new followers, and up front cash collected

You must deeply understand Instagram before you can lead it.

Phase 2: Instagram + YouTube

Once Instagram is operating at a high level:

  • You will oversee both Instagram and YouTube
  • The YouTube channel owner and scriptwriter will report to you
  • You must understand:
    • Long-form retention
    • Thumbnails and titles
    • Watch time and session growth
    • Content packaging for education-based channels

We do not believe in leaders who “manage” channels they don’t understand.

Phase 3: External Traffic - Podcast Interviews and Speaking

Once IG and Youtube systems are set up and growing at a consistent pace of 100K/month new followers on IG and 30K/month new subscribers on Youtube, you will own the expansion to getting Richard on well known top 50 podcasts to be interviewed by key thought leaders.

  • This is key to helping Richard cross-pollinate with the audiences of other people's YT channels, podcasts, etc.,
  • This way, we are able to gain 10,000 + new followers per month from OTHER people's audiences instead of relying only on our own growth
  • Taking all of the content and "mining" it into tactical 20-60 second long clips to be used for short form content that can go insanely viral by themselves.

Phase 4: Short-Form Expansion (FB + TikTok)

You will expand organic distribution to:

  • Facebook (organic, not ads)
  • TikTok

This is not copy-paste repurposing from Instagram videos. Each platform has unique nuances, and you must be able to understand what they are and build a team, realistically growing or hiring a Head of FB/TK and coaching them up to excellence.

You must understand:

  • Platform-native hooks
  • CTA differences
  • Formatting nuances
  • Audience psychology differences

Phase 5: Written Platforms (X + LinkedIn)

You will eventually oversee:

  • X (Twitter)
  • LinkedIn (a major priority)

This includes ghostwriting in the founder’s voice, narrative-based authority content, and business storytelling.

Leadership Expectations

We hire top-down.

You must be able to:

  • Hire and negotiate compensation
  • Train and develop talent
  • Run effective meetings
  • Hold people accountable to output and performance
  • Work with agencies short-term (3–6 months), learn from them, then build in-house

This is an operator role, not an individual contributor role—though you must still have a strong personal content skillset.

Who This Role Is For

  • You have led organic growth before
  • You’ve worked with creators or brands at hundreds of thousands to millions of followers
  • You want to build something massive—not just manage tasks
  • You’re comfortable with ownership, accountability, and pressure
  • You want to be a long-term partner, not a short-term hire

Requirements

Required: A Content Superpower

You must clearly know your core creative superpower, such as:

  • Cinematic videography / shooting
  • Elite video editing / storytelling
  • High-conversion copywriting / ghostwriting
  • Visual direction / creative strategy

You do not need to be great at everything—but you must be exceptional at something.

In-Person Preference (Strongly Preferred, Not Mandatory)

We strongly prefer candidates who:

  • Can travel 1–2x per month to shoot content with Richard
  • Are comfortable being on-location for filming
  • Can work closely with editors and/or an on-site videographer who does the shooting.

*NOTE: If you are not able to travel at all - this is totally understandable, and you will own the end to end hiring, training, and ongoing management of an onsite videographer. We are okay if we have to fly in a videographer every week, though it would be ideal to have someone local in Puerto Rico to shoot with Richard.

Richard's expectations is that we shoot a full day every single week on Tuesdays with a videographer so we always have sufficient content.

Richard is based in Dorado Beach, Puerto Rico (you’re encouraged to look it up).

Travel is not mandatory, but it is a major advantage.

Benefits

Compensation is flexible and merit-based.

  • Performance-based growth expected

This role is designed to evolve into a partner-level position:

  • Potential profit share
  • Potential equity discussions after ~12 months
  • Exposure to software companies already valued at multiple eight figures

This is performance-dependent, not guaranteed.

If you're still here.... this means you're interested. To apply, this is how it goes.

STEP 1: Fill out all the questions below, answering with as much detail as possible. One word vague answers will instantly be disqualified. For the loom, try to demonstrate what you've done before in the past.

STEP 2: Interview process is simple. Round 1 is with our Head of Ops and/or our Head of Marketing, and then round 2 will be with our COO. Final round (Round 3) will be with our founder/CEO Richard Yu.

Finally, we'll give you a paid test assignment to demonstrate your work, leadership, and capabilities, and this can be discussed on the 2nd and 3rd round interview.

That's it!

So go ahead and apply below!

P.S. If you know of anyone that is the perfect fit for this role, please send this form to them and tell them to list you as the "referral" (which is one of the questions belowed). If they are hired and stay on till day 45 with us, we'll personally wire/paypal/venmo (or however you'd like) $3,000.00 USD as a thank you for sending us our way.

Position Summary:

Under the direct supervision of the Marketing Manager, the Creative Marketing Specialist is responsible for developing and managing Native Forward Scholars Fund’s visual brand, creative assets, website content, digital advertising, and marketing analytics. This position combines creative design, digital marketing, website management, and data analysis to strengthen Native Forward’s visibility, engagement, and organizational impact across print and digital channels.

The Creative Marketing Specialist leads the development of branded materials and campaign assets; manages website updates, SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) efforts; supports paid digital advertising; monitors marketing performance; and translates organizational data and stories into compelling visual communications. The position works collaboratively with the Marketing Manager, PR & Digital Marketing Specialist, internal departments, contractors, and vendors to ensure marketing initiatives are strategic, consistent, accessible, and results driven.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Lead creative design and brand execution for organizational campaigns, advertisements, publications, presentations, social media, executive communications, events, fundraising initiatives, and other print and digital marketing materials while ensuring consistent application of Native Forward’s visual identity and brand standards.
  • Conceptualize and develop campaign creative, including graphics, digital advertisements, social media assets, videos, motion graphics, infographics, photography selections, and supporting collateral that advance organizational priorities and audience engagement.
  • Manage and maintain Native Forward’s website, including designing and updating webpages, campaign and event landing pages, website forms, images, digital assets, and content while monitoring functionality, accessibility, user experience, and overall brand consistency.
  • Lead website optimization efforts, including Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), keyword strategy, metadata, alt text, linking, readability, technical optimization, and digital ranking performance to increase organizational visibility and discoverability.
  • Support and execute paid digital advertising strategies, including Google Ads, display advertising, remarketing, paid social media, and boosted content; conduct audience and keyword research, establish campaign structures, monitor performance, and recommend optimization based on results.
  • Monitor and analyze marketing performance across campaigns, social media, website traffic, advertising, SEO/AEO, media placements, and other digital channels; track established KPIs and benchmarks and prepare regular reports and strategic recommendations for the Marketing Manager and leadership.
  • Lead creative production and vendor coordination for printed and digital materials, including preparing production-ready files, reviewing proofs, managing specifications and timelines, and coordinating with printers, advertising partners, photographers, videographers, and other vendors as needed.
  • Manage the development and production of the organization’s Annual Report, including creative direction, data and content collection, storytelling, layout and design, graphics and infographics, production files, printing, digital publication, distribution support, and performance evaluation.
  • Maintain organized libraries of approved creative assets, including graphics, photography, video, templates, website assets, organizational statistics, and other marketing resources to support efficient and consistent department-wide use.
  • Support annual and ongoing marketing planning by analyzing performance trends, researching emerging digital and creative best practices, monitoring peer organizations and industry trends, identifying opportunities for increased visibility, and recommending improvements to marketing strategies and tactics.
  • Collaborate across the organization and with external partners to translate programmatic, fundraising, scholarship, executive, and organizational priorities into effective visual and digital communications while managing multiple projects, deadlines, and competing priorities.
  • Maintains strict student confidentiality and compliance with the Family Education Right to Privacy Act.
  • Embodies Native Forward Core Values and promotes the Native Forward organization, staff, and programs, in a positive and professional manner.
  • Contributes to team effort and accomplishes related results.
  • Perform other duties as required.
Salary: $59,339-$75,216 per year

raw.title: Program Officer
raw.excerpt: Health Resources in Action, Inc.  (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health.
raw.description:
Health Resources in Action, Inc. (HRiA) is a non-profit organization working to improve and reimagine public health. We connect, consult, and collaborate to solve complex challenges of access and equity in our health and social systems. Together with our partners, clients, and collaborators, we create actionable solutions so that all people can thrive.

HRiA seeks sustainable solutions for complex problems using an anti-racist approach. We aim to be adaptable and flexible in meeting clients and partners where they are, offering our decades of knowledge and resources to collectively realize our dream of equitable, sustainable health for all. The foundation of this work is centered on our values:

  • Health and racial equity by identifying and addressing the root causes of health inequities, intentionally working to shift narratives and power imbalances and disrupt all systems of oppression.
  • Leading with heart by demonstrating our passionate commitment to our work, continuously challenging ourselves with humility and vulnerability while pursuing and holding ourselves accountable to our mission.
  • Collaboration by intentionally and respectfully leading, partnering, and following to strengthen relationships, uplift different voices and build trust.
  • Innovation by driving toward new strategies, questioning norms, and continuously learning and evolving to support the needs of our clients and communities.

Biomedical Research Grantmaking is a department within the broader Grantmaking Cluster at HRiA that facilitates biomedical sciences grantmaking services. The Biomedical Research Grantmaking team provides strategic advising of the design and administration of investments in biomedical sciences to a range of clients and partners. With a team of eleven staff members situated across the country, Biomedical Research Grantmaking works with private individuals, bank trusts and family foundations to provide biomedical and life science consulting services, program evaluation, and customized grant programs designed to accelerate medical discoveries. In 2025, we facilitated biomedical research grant programs that awarded over $22 million to outstanding investigators across the United States.

HRiA offers exciting, engaging, and challenging employment opportunities for facilitators, trainers, researchers, analysts, policy specialists, grant managers, and more. People come to HRiA because of our commitment to advancing health equity and inspiring work; they stay for our wonderful clients, partners, and dedicated and dynamic staff. With our growing portfolio of high-impact work, person-centered policies, and generous benefits, our team continually invests in making HRiA a great place to work. Our diverse staff of over 300 people hail from 30+ states, with a homebase in Boston’s Chinatown neighborhood.

Position Description

The Program Officer, Biomedical Research Grantmaking (Program Officer) seeks to advance health by working as part of a team to create, manage, and evaluate grant programs that support biomedical research. This project management role includes responsibility for developing, executing, managing, and evaluating competitive award programs and other ad hoc activities. The position requires the ability to develop and maintain relationships with awardees, scientific advisory committees, staff, clients, biomedical societies, and institutions. The Program Officer will also need to occasionally travel on behalf of HRiA.

The Program Officer will help the HRiA team achieve the goals of its partners in philanthropy by drawing upon their scientific training/background to support the strategic research program oversight of the Grantmaking team. This includes understanding and translating biomedical research (e.g., datasets, primary research articles, and reviews) to a wide range of audiences to support the development of deliverables such as landscape scans, program evaluations, and documentation of meeting outcomes. They will also work with Grantmaking leadership and staff to design and implement approaches that leverage strengths and overcome barriers in the advancement of health equity across multiple life sciences funding initiatives and projects.

The Program Officer will work as part of a grantmaking team that includes Executive and Senior Leadership, Directors, Grants Officers, Scientific Officers, Grants Associates, and Grants Coordinators for both Biomedical Research Grantmaking (biomedical focus) and Community Health Grantmaking projects. This is a full-time, exempt position. This position is fully remote.

General Responsibilities

Management: The Program Officer will serve as a project manager for multiple projects within the Grantmaking portfolio. They will manage timelines and deliverables for grantmaking processes, including peer review and pre- and post-award activities. In doing so, the Program Officer may provide programmatic/project oversight of Grants Coordinators and Associates.

Project Work:The Program Officer works with team members to apply their scientific knowledge to the creation and implementation of tools and materials for biomedical research funding opportunities, evaluations, and landscape scans. The Program Officer will help to ensure that applicants and awardees of funding opportunities advance the mission of their philanthropic funders. The Program Officer is expected to be a clear, timely, and professional communicator in serving as a liaison with external stakeholders including clients, applicants, awardees, and reviewers.

Business Development: The Program Officer will support the writing of proposals, blog posts, and client communications. They will help develop the scope of work and associated budgets for new business and existing projects.

Thought Leadership: The Program Officer is expected to keep abreast of advances in biomedical research and share trends with the Grantmaking team. They will actively participate in professional networks relevant to biomedical research and in professional development activities to develop skills and expertise that align with evolving approaches in biomedical research grantmaking. They may be asked to help build content for the HRiA website or participate in relevant workgroups in grantmaking.

Benefits

This is a full-time, exempt position at 35-40+ hours per week. The salary range for this position is $65,000-$72,000 and is commensurate with experience and credentials.

HRiA offers an attractive benefits package including employer-funded medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, and employer contributions to a tax-deferred annuity. Additionally, employees enjoy flexible work schedules and other policies that promote work/life balance, vacation starting at four weeks, paid family and medical leave, 13 paid holidays, plus office closure time for the last week of December. HRiA seeks candidates nationally. The Program Officer will be required to travel for various programmatic activities, including regular Massachusetts-based events.

Duties & Responsibilities

The below described duties and responsibilities are intended to indicate the kinds of work that will be required in this position. It is not intended to limit, or in any way modify, the rights of any supervisor to assign, direct, and contract work of staff under their supervision. The use of a particular illustration describing duties shall not be held to exclude other duties, not mentioned, that are of a similar level or difficulty.

Project Management

  • Develop timelines and comprehensive project or workplans to ensure timely completion of deliverables using tools such as Asana and Microsoft Suite Products;
  • Ensure accurate tracking of project progress, effective scheduling of meetings, and prioritization of activities;
  • Maintain organization of all project materials throughout the duration of the project period;
  • Develop and uphold communication coordination for project teams, clients, and other external stakeholders;
  • Liaise with vendors as needed for events management, video production, catering, etc.;
  • Assist with oversight of project budgets;
  • Ensure timely completion of requests related to post-award reporting, funding distribution, client related inquiries, and applicant/awardee questions.

Scientific Activities

  • Work with the senior Science Officer to curate biomedical research content for grant programs such as Requests for Applications, application guidelines, reviewer guidance, funding opportunity marketing, and awardee announcements;
  • Conduct research including literature reviews, key informant interviews, and survey development to support the completion of research landscape and funding scans;
  • Work with the Science Officer to identify potential scientific reviewers to serve on panels and committees;
  • Support the development of reports for clients and other external-facing materials such as blogs, publications, and lay summaries of scientific reports;
  • Manage and complete due diligence and first tier review of grant applications and review grantee reporting requirements such as progress reports and final reports;
  • Co-facilitate office hours, scientific peer review meetings, and strategic discussions.

Relationship Management

  • Serve as a liaison for applicants, awardees, and reviewers in providing technical assistance, guidance, and problem resolution;
  • Serve and maintain client communications; providing clear, concise, and accurate information as requested to develop trusted relationships;
  • Maintain relationships with organizations engaged in overlapping professional networks;
  • Be an active contributor to internal organizational committees and staff meetings as appropriate.

General Activities

  • Research potential opportunities and contribute to proposal development (help identify potential new clients and projects, support the writing of proposals, etc.);
  • Assist in the development of proposed scope of work and associated budgets for new business and existing projects

Candidate Qualifications

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in a related field such as philanthropy, development, or biomedical research;
  • A master’s degree in a biomedical related field such as biology, chemistry, neuroscience, genetics, etc. is preferred;
  • A PhD in biomedical research and/or previous experience in grants management is advantageous but not required;
  • A demonstrated understanding and commitment to operationalizing health and racial equity principles in grantmaking practices and/or approaches to biomedical research;
  • A commitment to value diversity of thought, backgrounds, and perspectives;
  • A commitment to a growth mindset, flexibility, and iteration and learning in their approach to solving problems;
  • Ability to manage multiple projects;
  • Proficiency in or capability of learning new software, including Asana, Adobe Acrobat, Microsoft Suite including Excel, SmartSimple grants management software, WordPress, Video Conferencing/Calling;
  • Ability to work as part of a team and self-starter;
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to high-quality work;
  • Excellent organizational, critical thinking, and interpersonal skills;
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Procedure for Candidacy

HRiA is actively seeking to build a diverse and experienced staff. The organization encourages multiple perspectives and experiences, supports a multicultural environment, and strives to hire and retain a diverse work force that reflects the populations we work with and the communities where we work. Diversity is a core value of HRiA resulting in culturally competent services, materials, resources, and programs. Our hiring and business practices appreciate the strengths offered through different backgrounds.

HRiA is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer and is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or genetic information.

Iovance Biotherapeutics aims to be the global leader in innovating, developing and delivering tumor infiltrating lymphocyte (TIL) therapy for people with cancer. We are pioneering a transformational approach to treating cancer by harnessing the ability of the human immune system to recognize and attack diverse cancer cells in each patient. The Iovance TIL platform has demonstrated promising clinical data across multiple solid tumors. We are committed to continuous innovation in cell therapy, including gene-edited cell therapy, which may be a promising option for patients with cancer.

Overview

Iovance is seeking a Contract Statistical Programmer to support clinical development programs by developing, validating, and maintaining statistical programming deliverables for clinical studies and regulatory submissions. This role will work closely with statisticians, data management, and other cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality and timely delivery of datasets, tables, listings, and figures in a GxP-compliant environment. The ideal candidate combines strong programming expertise with a solid foundation in statistics or quantitative sciences and thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced biotech setting.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities

  • Develop, validate, and maintain SAS and/or R programs for the creation of SDTM, ADaM datasets, and TLFs in accordance with CDISC standards.
  • Support statistical analyses for periodic safety reports, publications, conference presentations, IDMC/DSMB reviews, clinical study reports (CSRs), regulatory submissions, health authority requests and other ad hoc analyses and reporting needs.
  • Ensure all programming activities comply with FDA 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, and internal SOPs.
  • Collaborate with biostatisticians, data managers, and clinical teams to define analysis specifications and resolve data issues.
  • Perform quality control and detailed review of statistical programs and outputs.
  • Develop and maintain reusable macros, templates, and automation tools to improve programming efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and implementation of emerging technologies and modern programming approaches, including AI-based tools and agents, to enhance statistical programming workflows.
  • Participate in development and review programming data specifications.
  • Maintain clear, thorough documentation to support audit readiness and regulatory inspection.
  • Must adhere to Iovance Biotherapeutics’ core values, policies, procedures, and business ethics.
  • Perform miscellaneous duties as assigned.

Required Education, Skills, and Knowledge

  • Master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, biostatistics, data science or a related quantitative field with 5+ years of relevant industry experience; or bachelor’s degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, biostatistics, data science or a related quantitative field with 8+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Strong proficiency in SAS and/or R for clinical trial data analysis and reporting.
  • Working knowledge of CDISC standards (SDTM, ADaM, Define-XML) and regulatory submission requirements.
  • Experience producing TLFs and SDTM/analysis datasets in a pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or CRO setting.
  • Experience with oncology clinical trials or cell/gene therapy programs.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Familiarity with regulatory guidelines (FDA, ICH) and GxP-compliant programming practices.

Preferred Education, Skills, and Knowledge

  • Master’s degree in mathematics, statistics, or computer science is strongly preferred.
  • Hands-on experience developing AI agents or applying AI/ML-based automation tools to streamline data analysis, programming workflows, or reporting processes is a significant plus.
  • Experience supporting regulatory submissions (NDA, BLA, MAA, or equivalent)

Physical Demands and Activities Required

Work Environment

This role operates in a professional office or remote work environment and requires routine use of standard office equipment and technology. Employees working remotely are expected to maintain a safe workspace free from recognized hazards.

Sales Team Leadership

Nice to Have

  • Experience building sales training or enablement programs.
  • Background in B2B, SaaS, or service-based businesses.
  • Strong forecasting and pipeline management experience.

Tools & Technology

  • Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar CRM platforms.

What Success Looks Like

  • Sales team consistently achieves or exceeds revenue targets.

Interview Process

  1. Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)

After submitting your application, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record a short 3–5 minute Intro Video. This is the first step in our hiring process and can be completed whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of multiple screening calls, you’ll have one opportunity to introduce yourself, discuss your sales leadership experience, and highlight your background in team management, coaching, forecasting, CRM systems, and revenue growth. Your video will be reviewed before moving forward in the interview process.

You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final version will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after applying.

If you’re passionate about leading sales teams, developing top performers, and driving measurable revenue growth, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and help build a high-performing sales organization.

The Junior DevOps Engineer builds foundational DevOps skills by supporting the maintenance of CI/CD pipelines, assisting with monitoring and alerting, and helping with basic infrastructure, access, and security administration tasks, all under the close supervision of more senior engineers. The role is expected to grow steadily in independence and technical scope as competence and confidence increase across the toolchain and internal platforms.

CI/CD Pipeline Support

  • Assists with the maintenance and minor configuration changes of existing CI/CD pipelines under guidance from senior engineers.

  • Monitors pipeline runs, flags failures, and helps triage straightforward build/deploy issues.

  • Follows documented runbooks and change procedures when making pipeline adjustments.

  • Escalates ambiguous or higher-risk pipeline changes to a senior engineer before proceeding.

Monitoring & Alerting Assistance

  • Helps configure and maintain basic monitoring dashboards and alert rules under supervision.

  • Performs first-line review of alerts and escalates genuine incidents promptly to senior engineers.

  • Documents recurring alert patterns and contributes observations to runbook improvements.

  • Learns the organisation's monitoring stack (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) and standard thresholds.

Basic Infrastructure & Environment Tasks

  • Assists with routine infrastructure tasks (e.g., environment provisioning support, configuration updates) under close supervision.

  • Follows infrastructure-as-code templates and change processes rather than making ad-hoc changes.

  • Documents steps taken and outcomes for tasks performed, to support knowledge transfer.

  • Builds working familiarity with core cloud services and infrastructure tooling used by the team.

Access, Security & Platform Administration Support

  • Assists with routine access management tasks (e.g., user provisioning/de-provisioning) following approved processes.

  • Supports basic security hygiene tasks such as patch tracking and access reviews under supervision.

  • Helps administer internal platforms (e.g., Bitrix24 and similar internal collaboration/CRM tools) for routine, well-defined requests.

  • Escalates any anomalous access requests or potential security concerns immediately.

Ramp-Up and Learning Velocity

  • Actively works through onboarding materials, toolchain documentation, and internal platform guides.

  • Pairs frequently with senior DevOps engineers to build understanding of pipelines, infrastructure, and security practices.

  • Tracks own learning goals and progress with support from a mentor or the DevOps Lead.

  • Builds toward taking on progressively larger and less-supervised tasks.

Adherence to Standards and Process

  • Follows documented change management, security, and operational procedures without bypassing approval gates.

  • Uses agreed tools and ticketing systems consistently and accurately.

  • Applies feedback from senior engineers and the DevOps Lead consistently in subsequent work.

  • Raises process gaps or unclear documentation to the team rather than working around them.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field, OR a completed relevant bootcamp/certification path with a demonstrable practical portfolio.

  • 0-2 years' experience in a DevOps, systems administration, or software development support capacity.

  • Basic understanding of version control (e.g., Git) and branching workflows.

  • Exposure to Linux/Windows server environments and basic scripting (e.g., Bash, PowerShell, Python).

  • Some exposure to CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps Pipelines).

  • Basic understanding of networking fundamentals (DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS).

Jij maakt het mogelijk

Een CEO die met 80 mensen een reorganisatie in moet en jou belt voordat hij het zijn MT vertelt. Een leiderschapsteam dat jouw hulp inroept omdat het na twee jaar hard groeien merkt dat de oude manier van werken vastloopt. Een collega-VIE'er die bij een eerste groot veranderproject even met je wil sparren over hoe ze de weerstand in het team aanpakt. En dat is slechts een deel van je werkweek.

Als Senior HR Business Consultant ben je de sparringpartner van founders, CEO's en MT's van ambitieuze groeibedrijven en werk je voor meerdere bedrijven tegelijkertijd. Je weet wat er speelt als een organisatie van 40 naar 150 mensen gaat en je helpt ze daar doorheen: organisatie-inrichting, leiderschap, cultuur, performance. Vooral verandering is jouw ding. Je weet dat een nieuwe structuur bedenken makkelijk is en dat het echte werk begint zodra mensen er iets van gaan vinden.

Je kijkt ook verder dan je eigen opdrachten: waar kunnen we een klant nog beter helpen, welke nieuwe klant past bij ons, wat hebben we nodig om te groeien? VIE staat voor een volgende stap en we willen dat jij een van de mensen bent die mee gaat bouwen aan onze organisatie.

Requirements

Jij hebt het

Je hebt ruime ervaring in HR, als HR-lead , HR-manager, coach, veranderkundige of consultant, en je hebt aan tafel gezeten bij een MT. Je hebt organisaties zien groeien, krimpen of veranderen en kan goed tegen verandering. Verder herken je jezelf hierin:

  • Je hebt mensen aangestuurd en je vindt het oprecht leuk om anderen beter te maken. Je geeft feedback die ergens over gaat en je trekt je team mee zonder alles zelf te willen doen.

  • Je denkt commercieel. Je ziet kansen bij klanten, je durft het gesprek over een vervolgopdracht aan te gaan en je vindt het niet vies om over omzet te praten.

  • Je hebt verandertrajecten geleid en weet hoe je een organisatie meekrijgt.

  • Je bent ondernemend en wacht niet tot iemand je vertelt wat er moet gebeuren.

  • Je gelooft meer in de waarde van een goede confrontatie dan in de status quo behouden. Daarom stel je de vraag achter de vraag, ook als dat ongemakkelijk is. En als je vastloopt, vraag je hulp.

  • Je gebruikt tech en AI in je werk omdat je snapt dat het je tijd geeft voor wat er echt toe doet.

  • Je begrijpt hoe organisaties werken en kan HR-overstijgend meedenken en kijken.

  • Je voelt je thuis bij onze kernwaarden: samen doen, oprecht direct en beter maken.

Dit verdien jij

  • Een team collega's met samen honderden jaren People & Culture-ervaring, en een plek waar je die ervaring zelf ook doorgeeft

  • Werk bij uiteenlopende groeibedrijven, met ondernemers die weten wat ze willen (of juist niet, en daar help je dan bij)

  • Regie over je eigen agenda en de vrijheid om nationale feestdagen op te nemen wanneer het voor jou belangrijk is en autonomie over je eigen werk

  • Tijd om je in te zetten voor een goed doel of vrijwilligerswerk. We zijn niet voor niets een B Corp

  • Een salaris dat past bij je ervaring en bij deze rol binnen de range van € 5.083 - € 6.877, plus de rest van onze voorwaarden die je hier vindt

Hoe verder?

Nieuwsgierig? Laten we koffie drinken, gerust eerst gewoon om kennis te maken. Neem direct contact op met Wouter, CEO van VIE People, via of +31 (0) 6 506 025 72.
