raw.description:
🌟 Exciting Remote Opportunity! We're Hiring a GoHighLevel Dashboard & Automation Developer! 🌟

Are you an experienced GoHighLevel developer with strong web/internal tool building skills, API/webhook expertise, and workflow automation mastery? InsideOut Hiring is seeking a GoHighLevel Dashboard & Automation Developer to build a custom, two-way synced internal dashboard that serves as the single workspace for our global recruiting team!

🚨 IMPORTANT - Watch this quick Loom video on how to get hired: 🔗

🗣️ C1 ENGLISH LEVEL IS REQUIRED. The selected candidate will be speaking strictly in English during their whole shift. 🎙️ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR RESUME AND AUDIO RECORDING IN ENGLISH.

📋 Job Details at a Glance

  • Job Title: GoHighLevel Dashboard & Automation Developer

  • Job ID: IOHGHL1

  • Industry: Recruitment & Headhunting

  • Location: Fully Remote (Open globally, including India, Pakistan, South Africa, LATAM, PH)

  • Job Status: Full Time / Contract

  • Work Schedule: US Eastern Time (EST) business hours

  • Salary: $1,500 USD / month 💰

  • Target Start Date: ASAP 🚀

🏢 About the Client

InsideOut Hiring is a fully remote recruitment company. GoHighLevel (GHL) functions as our core CRM engine holding candidates, clients, pipelines, and communications. To maximize team efficiency, we are building a streamlined, purpose-built internal dashboard interface on top of GHL so our recruiters, sourcers, and admin staff can execute 100% of their daily work without ever having to log directly into GHL.

💼 About the Role

You will own this project end-to-end—from requirements gathering to launch, documentation, and ongoing enhancement. You will connect the dashboard to GHL via API v2 and webhooks to ensure two-way data sync, design role-based screens for recruiters and management, and build automated workflows (GHL, Make, n8n, Zapier) that eliminate manual work.

🎯 Key Responsibilities

  • 🖥️ Dashboard Development: Map team workflows; build role-based views for recruiters, sourcers, and management; create custom screens for candidates, job orders, client pipelines, tasks, calendars, and multi-channel messaging; set up KPI reporting dashboards.

  • 🔄 GoHighLevel API Integration: Connect the custom dashboard using GHL API (v2), OAuth, webhooks, and custom fields/objects; structure data architectures and handle rate limits/error logging cleanly.

  • 🤖 Workflow Automation: Build workflows in GHL, Make, n8n, or Zapier for candidate intake, CV parsing, automated interview scheduling, reminders, and candidate/client status updates.

  • 📚 Documentation & System Ownership: Maintain system documentation, train internal team members, and continually optimize performance based on feedback.

🗓️ First 90-Day Success Milestones

  • Days 1–30: Audit current GHL setup, interview the team, and deliver a written build plan with wireframes, data flows, and automation maps.

  • Days 31–60: Launch a working V1 dashboard for the recruiter team with two-way GHL sync and core automations live.

  • Days 61–90: Roll out to the entire team, deploy management KPI reporting, complete documentation/training, and transition day-to-day staff completely off GHL.

✅ Qualifications & Skills

⭐ Core Requirements:

  • GoHighLevel Mastery: 2+ years of hands-on GHL experience (workflows, pipelines, custom fields, custom objects, snapshots).

  • API & Integration Expertise: Proven experience using GHL API (v2), OAuth, and webhooks for real-time two-way syncing.

  • Dashboard Development: Experience building custom web apps or internal tools via code (React, Next.js, Node.js, Python) or low-code platforms (Retool, Softr, Bubble, WeWeb, Glide).

  • Automation Platforms: Advanced automation skills using Make, n8n, or Zapier.

  • Data & Communication: Strong data structuring skills, self-directed project execution, and clear written/spoken English.

🌟 Preferred / Nice-to-Haves:

  • Prior experience in recruitment/staffing or ATS platforms (Bullhorn, JobAdder, Recruit CRM).

  • Experience with CV parsing tools, job board APIs (LinkedIn, Indeed), or AI candidate screening.

  • Familiarity with data protection compliance (POPIA, GDPR) and basic UI/UX design.

🚀 Submit your application today and take the first step toward your next great opportunity!

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Commercial Account Executive in our South Korea team, you'll drive GitLab's growth by helping Commercial organizations adopt, implement, and expand our AI-powered DevSecOps platform. You'll also elevate your impact through team leadership and mentoring. You'll primarily focus on commercial accounts across South Korea, guiding customers through their digital and DevSecOps journeys and driving pipeline generation that translates into measurable new ARR and long-term expansion. In this role, you'll act as a key connector between customer stakeholders and GitLab's field organization so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner across the full sales cycle. You'll also mentor and coach fellow team members, sharing knowledge and learnings to elevate team performance. In your first year at this level, you'll deepen executive-level customer relationships, continue building a healthy book of business, and demonstrate consistent top-tier performance while supporting the growth of your peers.

What you'll do

  • Own and grow a book of commercial accounts in your primary territory across South Korea, focusing on organizations that can benefit from GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform.
  • Drive the full sales cycle with commercial customers by generating and qualifying pipeline through outbound prospecting, then leading discovery, negotiation, and close to create new ARR.
  • Work with your key customers to drive adoption and consumption in new products.
  • Meet or exceed quota by building strong, long-term customer relationships and acting as the primary point of contact for all commercial opportunities in your territory.
  • Articulate the value of GitLab to Commercial prospects and customers, clearly connecting our platform to their business outcomes, productivity goals, and security needs.
  • Manage your territory by documenting buying criteria and processes, defining next steps and owners, and keeping opportunity information accurate and up to date. Create clear quarterly forecasts against your plan through regular pipeline and deal reviews.
  • Collaborate closely with partners, Sales Development, Customer Success, Renewals, and Solutions Architects to drive new business, ensure adoption, and support expansion while minimizing churn and contraction.
  • Represent GitLab in customer meetings and events by driving attendance and delivering compelling presentations, proposals, and reports that communicate value and outcomes. Contribute customer ideas to our public issue tracker and apply MEDPICC and Command of the Message on all opportunities.
  • Mentor and coach fellow Commercial Account Executives, sharing sales strategies, customer insights, and lessons learned to help elevate team performance and contribute to team goal achievement.
  • Regularly meet on-site with key customers to develop and strengthen executive-level relationships, ensuring GitLab is viewed as a strategic, long-term partner at the highest levels of the organization.

What you'll bring

  • Ability to drive complex B2B software sales cycles and build trusted relationships with commercial and Commercial customers, ideally in a Commercial Account Executive or similar role serving Commercial customers.
  • Ability to quickly learn and sell a complex SaaS or DevSecOps platform to commercial and Commercial accounts, including identifying and breaking into new customers.
  • Excellence in operational rigor for deal management in Salesforce and Clari (or similar CRM and forecasting tools), with the ability to create reliable forecasts and manage your territory using both insight and data.
  • Skill in managing and closing larger, more complex deals in the Commercial segment using proven multi-threading, negotiation, and executive coverage strategies.
  • Self-starter who is a manager of one when it comes to territory account planning, quarterly and annual KPI execution, and driving new business acquisition and expansion through consultative, multi-stakeholder sales motions.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and coach peers, share knowledge and learnings across the team, and take on additional team-level responsibilities that elevate team performance and collective goal achievement.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to articulate value at all levels of the customer organization, lead clear and compelling customer conversations, and remain calm and solutions-focused under pressure.
  • Experience driving adoption and consumption with customers whilst leading your account team.
  • Outbounding: Not afraid to email, call, prospect into prospective accounts whilst building value narratives that land.
  • Adaptability, flexibility, creativity and a desire to build something new!


About the team

The Commercial Sales team is responsible for driving growth, adoption, and long-term value for GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform with our customers. As a Commercial Account Executive, you'll be part of a distributed, all-remote team that works asynchronously across regions and partners closely with GitLab's sales engineering, marketing, Sales Development, Customer Success, Renewals, and partner teams. We value transparency, collaboration, and a consultative approach, and we support one another through shared territory planning, regular deal reviews, and knowledge sharing focused on winning new customers, expanding existing accounts, and helping commercial organizations get the most value from GitLab.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. raw.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Software Quality Operations (SWQOPS) team is at the heart of ensuring the safety, reliability, and quality of the Waymo Driver. Our mission is to build an adaptable and scalable operation, increasingly powered by AI, to deliver the crucial insights necessary to confidently deploy and grow Waymo's autonomous vehicle service.

Waymo is experiencing unprecedented growth, rapidly expanding into new cities and launching new vehicle platforms. SWQOps, particularly our TechnicalSpecialists, are critical to this expansion, enabling us to scale safely and efficiently.

Why this team is Essential to Waymo's Success:

In this role you will:

  • Partner with Engineering to design, test, and deploy cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (Gen-AI) models and tools to drive step-change improvements in issue discovery & detection, triage efficiency, and quality assurance.
  • Leverage AI-powered insights and traditional triage signals to proactively identify emerging on-road issue trends, new risk scenarios, and edge cases. Develop and refine data-driven strategies for issue discovery and monitoring, enhanced by ML model outputs
  • Serve as the key link between AI/ML development and operational execution. Define and document new policies, guidelines, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that integrate AI tools and insights into daily vendor workflows.
  • Design and implement robust quality control processes for both human and AI-generated outputs. Perform meta-quality checks, validate the integrity of vendor work, and provide feedback to improve both human and model performance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for our Software Quality Operations, working closely with stakeholders, program leads, and vendor teams to ensure seamless adoption and maximum impact of AI/ML advancements in our quality processes. Be the trusted source for creating and updating technical policies, guidelines, and standard operating procedures for new scopes, platforms, and driving signals
  • Provide technical leadership and consultation to stakeholders to enhance our workflows and quality. You'll be at the forefront of identifying and escalating issues with our tools, providing technical requirements to engineering, and driving user testing to support the development and deployment of new tooling features.
  • A proven ability to work in a fast-paced, high-stress environment while maintaining good judgment.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with a wide range of individuals in a diverse and dynamic work environment.

You have:

  • BS/BA degree or 4 years of relevant work experience in AV Software Quality Operations
  • Increased competency in supporting all phases of the machine learning development lifecycle, from data preparation and training to validation, deployment, and continuous monitoring.
  • Experience with ML testing and validation, including dataset quality assurance, bias detection, edge-case scenario testing, and performance evaluation using statistical metrics.
  • Ability to quickly learn and implement new concepts and utilize proprietary tools. Strong understanding of driving rules and regulations.
  • Must have the ability to provide occasional on-call availability for evenings, weekends, and holidays, as well as the flexibility to attend meetings outside of standard hours to collaborate with our global team.

We prefer:

  • Demonstrated strong execution with ability to drive outcomes.
  • Experience working with offshore teams / multiple local operations hubs.
  • Basic SQL querying.
  • Competency in LLM / transformer models, and / or ML for robotics domain experience.
  • A greater focus on using your subject matter expertise for results analysis and direct customer consultation in the development of new and improved. solutions.
  • Self-motivated with basic skills in task planning and time management.

In accordance with Washington state law, we are highlighting our comprehensive benefits package, which is available to all eligible US based employees. Benefits for this role include:

  • Health, dental, vision, life, disability insurance
  • Retirement Benefits: 401(k) with company match
  • Paid Time Off: 20 days of vacation per year, accruing at a rate of 6.15 hours per pay period for the first five years of employment
  • Sick Time: 40 hours/year (statutory, where applicable); 5 days/event (discretionary)
  • Maternity Leave (Short-Term Disability + Baby Bonding): 28-30 weeks
  • Baby Bonding Leave: 18 weeks
  • Holidays: 13 paid days per year

This is a remote position.

(Remote jobs only - Please note that Waymo may not be able to employ remotely in all locations. Please speak with your recruiter about your preferred location for remote work when you begin the interview process.))

About the Role

Turner & Townsend is seeking an experienced Change Management Manager to support the successful delivery of organizational transformation initiatives across our financial services client's facility construction programs and projects. The successful candidate will lead the development and execution of change management strategies that drive stakeholder engagement, business readiness, user adoption, and sustainable outcomes.

The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in commercial construction project management, organizational change management, business transformation, stakeholder engagement, communications, and adoption planning. This role requires close collaboration with project teams, business leaders, and key stakeholders to ensure the people side of change is effectively managed and aligned with project objectives.

As a key member of the Program Management Office, the Change Management Manager will help navigate delivery partner integration, ensure workstream cohesion, and achieve business objectives while promoting Turner & Townsend's values, methodologies, and commitment to delivering better outcomes.

What you'll do

Lead the development and execution of change management strategies, plans, and initiatives to support organizational transformation across multiple workstreams.

Engage and influence executive sponsors, project teams, and stakeholders to build alignment and drive successful change outcomes.

Conduct stakeholder assessments, change impact assessments, organizational readiness evaluations, and adoption planning activities.

Bring retail and corporate banking construction industry insight and best practices to shape the transformation agenda and ensure a consistent and repeatable change management approach is embedded across multiple service providers.

Develop and implement communication, engagement, and business readiness strategies to support project objectives.

Partner with leadership teams to identify change risks, opportunities, and mitigation strategies.

Design and deliver change management materials, presentations, workshops, and stakeholder engagement activities.

Monitor adoption, readiness, and benefits realization metrics to measure the effectiveness of change initiatives.

Support business process improvements and transformation initiatives through analysis and continuous improvement activities.

Facilitate workshops, focus groups, training sessions, and stakeholder meetings to drive awareness and engagement.

Collaborate with communications, training, project management, and business teams to ensure an integrated delivery approach.

Develop and maintain stakeholder management plans, communication plans, and change roadmaps.

Support user acceptance testing, operational readiness, and transition activities for new processes, systems, and technologies.

Manage multiple change initiatives simultaneously while ensuring alignment with project schedules and business priorities.

Prepare executive-level reporting, dashboards, and change performance updates for key stakeholders.

Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned, and continuous improvement across programs and projects.

What You'll Need

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Organizational Development, Communications, Project Management, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in organizational change management, business transformation, program management, or related disciplines.
  • Experience with construction project management programs. Experience with financial services client facility construction desired.
  • Proven experience supporting large-scale transformation, technology implementation, or business process improvement initiatives.
  • Experience conducting stakeholder analysis, change impact assessments, readiness assessments, and adoption planning.
  • Experience developing executive communications, training materials, and engagement strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Prosci Change Management Certification, PMP, or equivalent certification preferred.

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

*On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

raw.title: Senior RTI Researcher - Americas Timezone
raw.excerpt: Company Overviewhermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm.
raw.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

We are seeking senior researchers for our real-time information flows team. We believe there is an unexploited opportunity in crypto markets reacting to real-time market moving news.

  • You have experience generating alpha from real-time events, either at an established proprietary trading firm or your own personal account.
  • You have an intuitive sense where news is likely to originate and which sources/platforms will be the first to disseminate it.
  • You enjoy being the first to read and react to breaking news and can accurately filter signal from noise.
  • You are a crypto-native and preferably have also been exposed to TradFi.
  • You have a sufficient technical background to prototype ideas prior to involving development resources.

This opening is for an RTI Researcher to cover the Americas timezone.

Responsibilities

    1. Ideation
      • Work with traders and researchers to identify potential news-driven trading opportunities.
      • Maintain core themes updated by communicating material information.
      • Maintain a detailed calendar of material events.
    2. Sourcing, monitoring
      • Identify key sources of breaking news for all tracked themes.
      • Work with developers to streamline the ingestion of key sources.
      • Monitor content flows in real-time and alert traders, researchers to potential trading opportunities.
    3. Build and maintain high-quality alerts
      • Build high precision, recall automated alerts for themes of interest. Prioritize, enable, disable, and update alerts as market conditions change.
      • Constantly review alerts to ensure they are relevant, robust, and resilient
    4. Working with our technical team
      • Direct product development of our real-time event monitoring and alerting system
      • QA/UAT and test all releases of alerts and product to ensure they meet the firm’s high standards of quality.

Requirements

Experience & Knowledge:

  • Prior experience working in trading firms, hedge funds, market intelligence, or financial news organizations: experience in identifying and generating alpha from news.
  • Deep understanding of real-time information flows and their impact in the price formation process.
  • Familiarity with news dissemination, tracking high-impact sources, individuals, and topics in real-time.
  • Familiarity with precision/recall scoring methods for optimizing alert systems.

Technical & Analytical Skills:

  • Experience using social media aggregation platforms such as X Pro (TweetDeck).
  • Experience working with unstructured data, text analytics.
  • Experience with market data, financial data charting, analytics.
  • Proficiency in scripting, query languages, e.g., Python, Rust, SQL.

Operational & Communication Skills:

  • High attention to detail with the ability to keep track of various market themes simultaneously.
  • Ability to make quick, informed decisions in high-pressure situations, including analyzing and reacting to critical market-moving events accurately.
  • Excellent communication skills to articulate key insights and findings to traders and researchers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with TradMedia platforms such as Bloomberg, LSEG/Refinitiv, Dow Jones.
  • Strong network within the ecosystem and familiarity with key influencers, news sources, and information channels.

Interview Process

After you apply, you can expect the following interview process:

  1. CV Screening - Against the criteria above.
  2. (Optional) Recruiter Call - If your CV needs additional screening.
  3. Interview with our Senior RTI Researcher
  4. Interviews with additional RTI Research & Engineering colleagues
  5. Additional rounds may be conducted as necessary with other team members or our partners.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

raw.description:
Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.

We unite popular brands such as foreUP, myFitApp, Vermont Systems, Momence, Exerp, Mariana Tek, Resamania, FieldEdge, CampBrain and many more.

Join our Cubessential Brand under the Golf & Club vertical as Product Designer to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every interface we design, and every new feature we ship is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve.

As our Product Designer, you will be a designer and design ambassador across our product families, working in an AI-optimized software development lifecycle (AI SDLC) where product, engineering, QA and design build together, with AI part of how everyone works. On an AI-optimized team, designers spend less time on repetitive production work and more on problem framing, customer insight and quality. You will use AI across discovery, design, prototyping and build, and you stay accountable for the quality of what ships.

You will combine qualitative and quantitative data with your talent and instincts to turn customer insight into delightful product designs, using AI to explore faster and test sooner. A key focus of the role is maintaining our design system and the AI skills that support prototyping. We expect you to lead with judgment, taste and customer empathy, and to work in a way that reflects our company values.

Some of the things you'll do:

  • Understand customers and shape the problem
    • Set design requirements based on input from internal teams and user research.
    • Collect and interpret qualitative and quantitative feedback, and use AI tools to synthesize research, support themes and usage data at speed, while checking the output against the source.
    • Identify new product improvement opportunities, and analyze how a new product meets market needs and customer preferences.
  • Design and validate
    • Produce UX/UI to support the product roadmap across our family of products.
    • Use AI-assisted workflows to explore more options, build prototypes and cover edge cases and states earlier, then bring your own judgment to choose the best direction.
    • Present design ideas to Product Managers and Owners, Engineers, QA, other cross-functional teams, customers and prospects, and use their feedback to validate and refine designs.
    • Modify and revise existing designs as customer preferences change.
  • Build alongside engineering
    • Work closely with Product Management, Engineers and QA to suggest improvements to products and processes.
    • Review AI-assisted builds for design fidelity, accessibility and consistency, and give clear, specific feedback early.
    • Provide support to Product Management and Engineers whenever it helps the team move faster.
  • Maintain the design system and AI skills
    • Maintain and evolve the design system and design library across our family of products, keeping components, tokens and guidelines organized, current and consistent.
    • Build and maintain the AI skills, prompts and templates that support prototyping, so the team can move from idea to working prototype quickly and stay true to the design system.
    • Document design principles, patterns, components and research so people and AI tools can both use them. A well-structured design system and knowledge base is what lets AI-assisted teams build consistently.
    • Share reusable workflows and coach the wider team on using AI well for design tasks.
  • Design for AI-powered experiences
    • Design the experience of AI-powered product features, including how they set expectations, show their reasoning, let people stay in control, handle mistakes and build trust.
    • Follow company policy on responsible AI use, including how customer and company data is handled in AI tools.
    • Stay up to date on industry trends, market conditions and new AI design tools and techniques, and recommend the ones worth adopting.

Working arrangements:

  • Fully Remote in United States: You can work remotely in this position, provided you reside in United States,have full working rights and do not require sponsorship.

Qualifications

What would make me a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

You'll need:

  • Proven experience in all phases of the design process: user research, wireframing, prototyping, visual design, interaction design and usability testing.
  • A well-rounded portfolio that shows a strong understanding of customer and business objectives.
  • An intuitive eye for customer needs beyond the obvious.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate and persuade around design concepts and to engage and influence a variety of audiences.
  • Ability to collaborate with cross-functional team members, and to be autonomous and a team player when needed.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with varying deadlines and scopes of work.
  • Creative, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for design. You are never satisfied with the status quo and always looking for ways to improve and innovate.

Accertify enables commerce by doing one thing extraordinarily well: pinpointing fraud. The company's Predictive Yes Platform helps businesses say yes to more - more good customers, more revenue, and more growth - without getting burned. It's a precise, confident, data-backed yes, made possible by joining signals across the entire customer lifecycle through unmatched data volume, layered AI-powered models, and a consortium approach that protects clients from bad actors spotted anywhere in the network while unlocking business with good actors verified anywhere in the network. With more than 10 billion transactions and over $1 trillion in commerce processed in 2025 alone, Accertify delivers the intelligence and precision that fraud and payments teams need to say yes confidently and enable growth. That's the More Yes difference.

We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Engineerto lead the design, development, and deployment of intelligent systems that drive business impact. You will own end-to-end AI solutions, set technical direction, and mentor other engineers, working across machine learning, LLMs, retrieval systems, agentic workflows, and the data layers that feed them. This role requires deep technical expertise and a track record of shipping production AI systems at scale.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • AI Architecture: Architect AI systems end-to-end. Set technical direction. Review and mentor on others’ designs.
  • LLM Strategy: Define how we use LLMs, routing, agentic orchestration, prompt patterns, fine-tune vs. prompt trade-offs, model selection.
  • Production Ownership: Own deployment patterns across on-prem and cloud (Kubernetes, container infrastructure, secure integration). Drive operational excellence.
  • Data Architecture: Consult on the data layer, medallion design (bronze/silver/gold), RAG retrieval stores, schema evolution, drift detection, and query performance at scale.
  • Evaluation Framework: Define how we measure AI quality, golden datasets, judge-based eval, production observability (OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or similar), behavior testing.
  • Technical Leadership: Mentor AI Engineers, lead code and design reviews, set engineering standards for the AI team, and drive cross-team initiatives with Data Science and Data Engineering teams.
  • Security & PII: Set the bar for handling sensitive customer data, secure system design, authentication, PII safety, and compliance-aware patterns.
  • Collaboration: Partner with product managers, data scientists, engineers, and stakeholders to align AI solutions with business needs.

Skills & Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 5+ years of production software experience.
  • Strong proficiency with AI/ML frameworks (OpenAI SDK, FastMCP, agentic orchestration frameworks).
  • Strong Python AND strong SQL; both are first-class requirements. Comfortable with query optimization, indexing strategy, and data modeling.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and operating medallion architectures (bronze/silver/gold) at scale.
  • Experience handling data at scale, partitioning, batch pipeline design, query performance, schema evolution.
  • Production LLM experience, prompt engineering, retrieval (RAG), agentic orchestration, fine-tuning trade-offs.
  • Experience with vector databases (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.) and production RAG patterns.
  • Experience with AI observability and evaluation frameworks, OpenTelemetry, Phoenix or equivalent, golden-set eval, judge-based eval methodology.
  • Strong understanding of secure system design, authentication, API integrations, and handling PII-sensitive data.
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and shipping cross-team initiatives.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to explain technical solutions to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Skills:

  • Hands-on experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP), building tools, OAuth flows, or MCP server integrations.
  • Experience leading data engineering or data platform initiatives end-to-end.
  • Experience with agentic AI frameworks (e.g., the OpenAI Agents SDK) in production.
  • Experience deploying production systems across both cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) and on-prem environments.
  • Experience in fraud detection, financial services, or other PII-sensitive domains.
  • Knowledge of MLOps tools and CI/CD for AI.
  • Open-source contributions, conference talks, or technical writing in the AI/ML space.

At Accertify, we offer more than just a paycheck—we invest in our people through competitive rewards, meaningful benefits, professional development opportunities, flexible ways of working, and programs that support your overall well-being. The Lead Technician serves as the primary on-site representative for assigned projects, coordinating installation activities, managing field personnel, ensuring quality workmanship, and maintaining strong customer relationships throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Participate in meetings, respond to RFIs, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Promote continuous improvement through project reviews and lessons learned.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 10 years of hands-on low-voltage cabling experience.
  • Minimum 5 years leading commercial telecommunications or structured cabling installation projects.
  • Strong knowledge of structured cabling standards and industry best practices.
  • Experience installing commercial structured cabling systems.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, wiring diagrams, and scopes of work.
  • Experience building and organizing MDFs and IDFs.
  • Proficient in terminating patch panels, keystone jacks, RJ45 connectors, and fiber optic systems.
  • Experience with professional cable and fiber testing equipment.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent organization, documentation, and labeling skills.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead teams effectively.
  • Valid driver's license.
  • Authorized to work in the United States without restriction.
  • Willingness to attend training and maintain required certifications.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Journeyman or Master Electrician License or completion of an electrical apprenticeship.
  • BICSI certification or other industry-recognized certifications.
  • Experience with fiber optic termination, fusion splicing, and testing.
  • Experience with greenfield and brownfield commercial construction projects.
  • Experience working in occupied hotels or similar operating facilities.
  • Experience performing site surveys.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, Bluebeam Revu, and Smartsheet.
  • Experience using Microsoft Teams and cloud-based construction management platforms.
  • Experience operating scissor lifts and one-man lifts.
  • Strong conflict resolution, decision-making, and leadership skills.
  • Ability to remain professional under changing priorities and tight deadlines.

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Ability to climb ladders and work at heights.
  • Ability to bend, kneel, crawl, and work in active construction environments.
  • Ability to lift and carry up to 100 pounds.
  • Ability to work in varying environmental conditions including heat, cold, and humidity.

Travel Requirements

This position requires extensive travel to customer job sites throughout the United States and is ideal for individuals who enjoy working in a dynamic, project-based environment.

  • Extensive nationwide travel required, up to 90% of the time.
  • Travel assignments may last several weeks depending on project scope and customer requirements.

  • Rich HSA company-funded options and Flexible Spending accounts

About the Role

We are looking for a Graphic Designer with strong packaging and production design experience to join a fast-paced consumer products environment.

In this role, you will create and update packaging, retail assets, product imagery, and production-ready design files, while ensuring strong visual consistency across multiple products and brand materials.

You’ll work closely with marketing, product, operations, photographers, retouchers, and other creative partners. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong design skills with exceptional attention to detail and can confidently manage several projects at the same time.

This is a remote, full-time contractor opportunity for candidates based in LATAM, initially for 3 months with potential for renewal.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, update, and prepare production-ready packaging cartons and retail assets.

  • Create and maintain accurate design files using Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and InDesign.

  • Work with packaging layouts, typography, imagery, color, and written content while maintaining strong attention to detail.

  • Maintain and apply brand and design guidelines across multiple products and assets.

  • Create and support 2D and 3D product and packaging visualizations.

  • Perform image retouching and coordinate with external retouchers when needed.

  • Review and proofread design files to ensure accuracy before production.

  • Ensure visual and color consistency across product imagery, packaging, and retail materials.

  • Independently manage multiple projects, priorities, and tight deadlines.

  • Coordinate with photography studios and other external creative partners.

  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and operations teams.

  • Identify and resolve design or production issues proactively.

  • Support evolving creative workflows, including AI-assisted design processes where appropriate.

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of professional graphic design experience.

  • Strong experience in packaging, consumer products, retail, print production, or similar environments is highly preferred.

  • Advanced proficiency in:

    • Adobe Illustrator

    • Adobe Photoshop

    • Adobe InDesign

  • Strong hands-on experience with InDesign for multi-page layouts and production files.

  • Experience preparing artwork for print or packaging production.

  • Strong image retouching skills.

  • Ability to create high-quality 2D and 3D product or packaging renderings.

  • Strong understanding of typography, layout, color consistency, and visual hierarchy.

  • Excellent attention to detail and proofreading skills.

  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple projects simultaneously.

  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and deadline-management skills.

  • Experience collaborating with external photographers, retouchers, printers, or creative vendors is a plus.

  • Exposure to or training in AI-assisted design workflows is a plus.

English Level

Professional English proficiency – B2 or higher.

You should feel comfortable participating in meetings and collaborating with English-speaking stakeholders.

You May Be a Great Fit If You Have Worked As

  • Packaging Designer

  • Graphic Designer with packaging experience

  • Production Designer / Production Artist

  • Retail Graphic Designer

  • Consumer Products Designer

  • Brand Designer with packaging responsibilities

Experience working with consumer products, home goods, furniture, toys, lifestyle products, retail, or other high-volume product environments is especially valuable.

Working Conditions

  • Location: Remote – LATAM

  • Schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–6:00 PM EST

  • Engagement: Independent Contractor

  • Dedication: Full-time

  • Initial contract: 3 months, with potential for renewal

  • Equipment: You must have your own computer and equipment suitable for professional graphic design work.

  • Holidays: Based on your country of residence.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll be successful in this role if you consistently deliver accurate, polished, production-ready creative work on time, while maintaining strong visual consistency across products and adapting quickly when requirements or priorities change.

You’ll combine creativity with a production mindset—carefully checking typography, layout, color, imagery, copy, and specifications while taking ownership of your projects from design through final delivery.

Hiring Process

Our selection process includes:

Recruiter Interview → Design Challenge → Client Interview

The role spans block, file, and object storage across data center, edge, and cloud environments, with strong attention to performance, data protection, and cost.   • Experience with storage integration for VMware and Kubernetes (CSI).

  • Strong understanding of storage performance, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across storage, network, and host layers.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
